en.s: The siege of Acre took place in May 1104. It was of great importance for the consolidation of the Kingdom of Jerusalem, which had been created five years earlier. With the help of a Genoese fleet, King Baldwin I forced the surrender of the important port city after a siege that lasted 20 days.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 阿卡围城战于1104年5月举行，对巩固五年前建立的耶路撒冷王国十分重要。在热那亚舰队协助下，鲍德温一世围攻这座重要港口城市20天，最终迫使守军投降。
zh.n: 本条记录的是源信息框标注的事件开始日期。

en.s: On 6 May of 1405, a French army under the command of Waleran III, Count of Ligny and Saint-Pol besieged the English castle at Mercq in Pas-de-Calais.

zh.s: 1405年5月6日，利尼和圣波尔伯爵瓦勒朗三世率领的法国军队围攻位于加来海峡省梅尔克的英格兰城堡。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The Battle of Grotniki took place either on 4 or 6 May 1439 in the vicinity of Grotniki Duże, a village near Nowy Korczyn, currently in Świętokrzyskie Voivodeship. The battle was fought between the Hussite confederates under Spytko III of Melsztyn against the royal forces of King Władysław III of Poland under Hińcza of Rogów and the Polish regent, bishop Zbigniew Oleśnicki.

zh.s: 格罗特尼基战役发生于1439年5月4日或6日，地点在格罗特尼基杜热附近。该村位于新科尔钦附近，现属圣十字省。胡斯派同盟军由梅尔什滕的斯皮特科三世率领，迎战波兰国王瓦迪斯瓦夫三世的王军；王军由罗戈夫的欣恰和波兰摄政主教兹比格涅夫·奥莱希尼茨基指挥。

en.s: The Sack of Rome, then part of the Papal States, followed the capture of Rome on 6 May 1527 by the mutinous troops of Charles V, Holy Roman Emperor, during the War of the League of Cognac. Charles V only intended to threaten military action to make Pope Clement VII accept his terms. However, the Imperial army (14,000 Germans, including Lutherans, 6,000 Spaniards and some Italians) were largely unpaid and mutinied.

zh.s: 罗马当时属于教宗国。1527年5月6日，神圣罗马帝国皇帝查理五世麾下的叛变军队攻占罗马，随后发生罗马之劫，是干邑同盟战争的一部分。查理五世原本只打算以军事行动相威胁，迫使教宗克莱孟七世接受他的条件。然而，帝国军队大多长期未领军饷，最终发动哗变；这支军队包括14,000名德意志士兵（其中有路德宗信徒）、6,000名西班牙士兵和一些意大利士兵。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current lead via MediaWiki API

en.s: The Battle of Ghaghra, fought in 1529, was a major battle for the conquest of India by the Mughal Empire. It followed the first Battle of Panipat in 1526 and the Battle of Khanwa in 1527. The forces of Mughal Emperor Babur of the emerging Mughal Empire were joined by Indian allies in battle against the Eastern Afghan Confederates under Sultan Mahmud Lodi and the Sultanate of Bengal under Sultan Nusrat Shah.

zh.s: 1529年发生的加格拉战役是莫卧儿帝国征服印度过程中的一场重要战役，先后于1526年和1527年发生的第一次帕尼帕特战役、坎瓦战役之后爆发。新兴莫卧儿帝国皇帝巴布尔的军队与印度盟友并肩作战，对抗马哈茂德·洛迪苏丹率领的东阿富汗联盟军，以及努斯拉特·沙阿苏丹统治下的孟加拉苏丹国军队。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 10-month siege of Cusco by the Incan army under the command of Sapa Inca Manco Inca Yupanqui started on 6 May 1536 and ended in March 1537. The city was held by a garrison of Spanish conquistadors and Indian auxiliaries led by Hernando Pizarro. The Incans hoped to restore their empire (1438–1533) with this action, but it was ultimately unsuccessful.

zh.s: 1536年5月6日，萨帕·印加曼科·印加·尤潘基率领印加军队开始围攻库斯科，战事持续10个月，至1537年3月结束。城内由埃尔南多·皮萨罗率领的西班牙征服者及印第安辅助部队驻守。印加人希望借此恢复其1438年至1533年的帝国，但最终未能成功。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current lead via MediaWiki API

en.s: The siege of Coevorden was a thirty-one-week siege of the city of Coevorden in the province of Drenthe by the Spanish general Francisco Verdugo during the Eighty Years' War and the Anglo–Spanish War. The siege first commenced in October 1593, but winter and shortages of food and supplies forced the Spanish into winter quarters.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1593年，西班牙将领弗朗西斯科·贝尔杜戈在八十年战争和英西战争期间围攻德伦特省的科沃尔登城，这场围城持续了31周。围城于1593年10月开始，但冬季来临、粮食和补给短缺，迫使西班牙军队进入冬季营地。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The Battle of Wimpfen was a battle in the Bohemian Revolt period of the Thirty Years' War on 6 May 1622 near Wimpfen. The forces of the Holy Roman Empire and Catholic League under Marshal Tilly and Gonzalo de Córdoba defeated the Protestant forces of General Ernst von Mansfeld and Georg Friedrich, Margrave of Baden-Durlach. After the fall of the Bohemian capital of Prague following the Battle of White Mountain, Georg Friedrich decided to continue the battle and oppose Tilly and Cordoba at Wimpfen. By early May, the forces of Christian of Brunswick had arrived to the north of the Neckar River and were prepared to assist the Protestant forces.

zh.s: 温普芬战役是三十年战争波希米亚起义时期的一场战役，于1622年5月6日在温普芬附近发生。蒂利元帅和贡萨洛·德·科尔多瓦率领的神圣罗马帝国与天主教联盟军队，击败了恩斯特·冯·曼斯菲尔德将军和巴登-杜拉赫藩侯格奥尔格·腓特烈率领的新教军队。布拉格在白山战役后陷落，格奥尔格·腓特烈决定继续作战，在温普芬迎战蒂利和科尔多瓦。5月初，克里斯蒂安·冯·布伦瑞克的部队已抵达内卡河北岸，准备支援新教军队。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: During the First English Civil War Lincoln was besieged between 3 May and 6 May 1644 by Parliamentarian forces of the Eastern Association of counties under the command of the Earl of Manchester. On the first day, the Parliamentarians took the lower town. The Royalist defenders retreated into the stronger fortifications of the upper town, which encompassed and incorporated Lincoln Castle and Lincoln Cathedral. The siege ended four days later when the Parliamentarian soldiers stormed the castle, taking prisoner the Royalist governor, Sir Francis Fane, and what remained of his garrison.

zh.s: 第一次英国内战期间，议会军东部联盟部队在曼彻斯特伯爵指挥下，于1644年5月3日至6日围攻林肯。第一天，议会军攻占下城区。保王党守军撤入防御更坚固的上城区，其中包括林肯城堡和林肯大教堂。四天后，议会军攻入城堡，俘虏了保王党总督Francis Fane爵士及其残余守军，围城战由此结束。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: In the Battle of Prague or Battle of Štěrboholy on May 6, 1757 Frederick the Great's 67,000 Prussians forced 60,000 Austrians to retreat, but having lost 14,300 men, decided he was not strong enough to attack Prague.

zh.s: 1757年5月6日，在布拉格战役（又称斯特尔博霍利战役）中，腓特烈大帝率领的67,000名普鲁士军队迫使60,000名奥地利军队撤退。但普军损失14,300人，腓特烈因此认为兵力不足以进攻布拉格。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The Konbaung–Hanthawaddy War (Burmese: ကုန်းဘောင်-ဟံသာဝတီ စစ်) was the war fought between the Konbaung Dynasty and the Restored Hanthawaddy Kingdom of Burma (Myanmar) from 1752 to 1757. The war was the last of several wars between the Burmese-speaking north and the Mon-speaking south that ended the Mon people's centuries-long dominance of the south. The war began in April 1752 as independent resistance movements against Hanthawaddy armies which had just toppled the Toungoo Dynasty.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.t: 贡榜王朝—复兴勃固王朝战争
zh.s: 贡榜王朝—复兴勃固王朝战争（缅甸语：ကုန်းဘောင်-ဟံသာဝတီ စစ်）是 1752 至 1757 年贡榜王朝与复兴勃固王国之间的战争。这是缅甸语北方与孟语南方之间的最后一场战争，结束了孟人在南部数百年的统治。战争始于 1752 年 4 月，当时独立抵抗运动反抗刚刚推翻东吁王朝的勃固军队。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Battle of Lenud's Ferry was a battle of the American Revolutionary War that was fought on May 6, 1780 in present-day Berkeley County, South Carolina. The Loyalist British Legion, under the command of Lieutenant Colonel Banastre Tarleton, surprised and scattered a company of Patriot militia at Lenud's Ferry, a crossing point on the Santee River, north of which lies present-day Georgetown County.

zh.s: 莱努兹渡口战役是美国独立战争期间的一场战斗，于1780年5月6日在今美国南卡罗来纳州伯克利县发生。班纳斯特·塔尔顿中校指挥的保王党英军军团在萨蒂河渡口莱努兹渡口突袭并击溃了一支爱国者民兵连。渡口以北是今乔治敦县。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The Grand Palace (Thai: พระบรมมหาราชวัง, RTGS: Phra Borom Maha Ratcha Wang, pronounced [pʰrá bɔ̄ː.rōm má.hǎː râːt.tɕʰá wāŋ] lit. 'The Supreme Grand Palace') is a complex of buildings at the heart of Bangkok, Thailand. The palace has been the official residence of the Kings of Siam (and later Thailand) since 1782. The king, his court, and his royal government were based on the grounds of the palace until 1925.
en.n: The construction of the Grand Palace began on 6 May 1782, at the order of King Phutthayotfa Chulalok (Rama I).

zh.s: 大皇宫（泰语：พระบรมมหาราชวัง，皇家转写：Phra Borom Maha Ratcha Wang，意为“至高无上的大皇宫”）是位于泰国曼谷市中心的一组建筑。自1782年以来，这里一直是暹罗（后称泰国）历代国王的正式居所。1925年以前，国王、宫廷和王室政府都设在宫内。
zh.n: 帕佛陀约华朱拉洛（拉玛一世）下令，大皇宫于1782年5月6日动工。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 1800 Kentucky gubernatorial election was held on May 6, 1800, in order to elect the governor of Kentucky. Incumbent Democratic-Republican governor James Garrard won re-election against fellow Democratic-Republican candidates Benjamin Logan, Thomas Todd and Christopher Greenup in the first election decided by popular vote.

zh.s: 肯塔基州于1800年5月6日举行州长选举。民主共和党现任州长詹姆斯·加勒德赢得连任，击败同党候选人本杰明·洛根、托马斯·托德和克里斯托弗·格林纳普。这是肯塔基州首次由普选决定结果的州长选举。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The Action of 6 May 1801 was a minor naval engagement between the 32-gun xebec-frigate El Gamo of the Spanish Navy under the command of Don Francisco de Torris and the much smaller 14-gun brig HMS Speedy under the command of Thomas, Lord Cochrane. El Gamo was subsequently captured. The skirmish is notable for the large disparity between the size and firepower of El Gamo and Speedy - the former was around four times the size, had much greater firepower and a crew six times the size of Speedy, which had a reduced crew of 54 at the time of the engagement.

zh.s: 1801年5月6日海战是西班牙海军32炮快速帆船护卫舰El Gamo与英国海军小型14炮双桅横帆船HMS Speedy之间的一场小规模海战。El Gamo由Don Francisco de Torris指挥，Speedy由Thomas Cochrane勋爵指挥。西班牙舰船最终被俘。两舰在规模和火力上差距悬殊，因此这场交战尤其引人注目：El Gamo约有Speedy四倍大、火力更强，船员人数是其六倍；交战时Speedy只有54名船员。

en.s: The Battle of Fort Oswego was a partially successful British raid on Fort Ontario and the village of Oswego, New York on May 6, 1814 during the War of 1812.

zh.s: 1812年战争期间，英国于1814年5月6日突袭奥斯威戈堡、安大略堡和纽约州奥斯威戈村，取得部分成功。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The Battle of Balakot was the final battle fought between the Sikh forces under prince Sher Singh and mujahideen under Syed Ahmad Barelvi at Balakot on 6 May 1831. Barelvi had declared jihad against the Sikhs and had made Peshawar Valley the centre of his Tariqah-i-Muhammadiyah movement. After the betrayal and massacre of his companions on the hands of Pashtun tribesmen in November 1830, Barelvi left Peshawar and shifted to Hazara, intending to move to the Kashmir Valley.

zh.s: 1831年5月6日，谢尔·辛格王子率领的锡克军队与赛义德·艾哈迈德·巴雷尔维率领的圣战者在巴拉科特展开最后一场战斗。巴雷尔维曾向锡克人宣布圣战，并将白沙瓦谷设为其穆罕默迪亚教团运动的中心。1830年11月，他的同伴遭普什图部族武装背叛并被屠杀后，巴雷尔维离开白沙瓦，转往哈扎拉，计划继续前往克什米尔谷地。

en.s: The 1833 Mississippi gubernatorial election was held on May 6, 1833, to elect the governor of Mississippi. Hiram Runnels, a Democrat, defeated incumbent Governor Abram Scott, a National Republican.

zh.s: 密西西比州于1833年5月6日举行州长选举。民主党候选人海勒姆·朗内尔斯击败现任州长、国家共和党人亚伯拉姆·斯科特。

en.s: The city of Peshawar was formally annexed on 6 May 1834 by the Sikh Empire. Peshawar was being governed by the Barakzai Sardars — Yar Mohammed Khan, Sultan Mohammed Khan, Sayeed Mohammed Khan and Pir Mohammed Khan. They were collectively referred to as the Peshawar Barakzais. The Peshawar Barakzais had broken free of their half-brothers ruling Kabul.

zh.s: 1834年5月6日，锡克帝国正式吞并白沙瓦城。当时该城由巴拉克宰部族首领雅尔·穆罕默德汗、苏丹·穆罕默德汗、赛义德·穆罕默德汗和皮尔·穆罕默德汗统治，他们合称白沙瓦巴拉克宰。白沙瓦巴拉克宰家族此前已摆脱在喀布尔统治的同父异母兄弟的控制。

en.s: The battle of Santa Lucia was an episode in the First Italian War of Independence. On 6 May 1848, when the king of Sardinia, Carlo Alberto, sent I Corps of the Sardinian army to assault the fortified positions held before the walls of Verona by the Austrian army under field marshal Josef Radetzky. The Austrian army, though outnumbered, managed to withstand the attack and hold their positions. The battle is named after the Santa Lucia district of Verona. Franz Joseph (then only 17 years old) assisted at the battle.

zh.s: 圣卢西亚战役是第一次意大利独立战争的一场战斗。1848年5月6日，撒丁国王卡洛·阿尔贝托派遣撒丁军第一军团，进攻维罗纳城墙外由奥地利军队驻守的防御阵地；奥军由约瑟夫·拉德茨基元帅指挥。奥军虽然人数较少，仍顶住进攻并守住阵地。战役以维罗纳圣卢西亚区命名。弗朗茨·约瑟夫（当时年仅17岁）也参加了战斗。

en.s: The Battle of Lockridge Mill or the Battle of Lockridge's Mills, also called Skirmish near Lockridge's Mill was a skirmish fought on May 6, 1862, in the Western Theater of the American Civil War. The skirmish took place near modern-day Palmersville, Tennessee. The skirmish derives its name from the ford and gristmill on the nearby northern fork of the Obion River owned by Marshall Lockridge.

zh.s: 洛克里奇磨坊战役又称洛克里奇磨坊交火，是美国内战西部战场上的一次小规模交战，于1862年5月6日在田纳西州帕尔默斯维尔附近发生。战役名称来自附近奥比恩河北支流上的浅滩和磨坊，该磨坊由马歇尔·洛克里奇拥有。

loc: 波兰卢布林省博罗维茨

en.s: The Battle of Kobylanka, one of many skirmishes of the January Uprising, took place on May 1 and May 6, 1863, in the Kobylanka Forest, located near the village of Borowiec, which at that time belonged to Russian-controlled Congress Poland. A Polish insurgent party of some 800, under Antoni Jezioranski, clashed here with a 1000-strong unit of the Imperial Russian Army. On April 28, an insurgent party from Galicia, commanded by General Jasinski crossed Austrian - Russian border near the village of Ruda Rozaniecka. Russian Army Colonel Georgi Mednikov, who was military commandant of Janow Lubelski County, decided to send a detachment towards Ruda.

zh.s: 科比兰卡战役是1863年一月起义期间多场小规模冲突之一，于1863年5月1日和6日发生在科比兰卡森林，靠近当时属于俄属波兰会议王国的博罗维茨村。安东尼·耶日兰斯基率领约800名波兰起义军，在此与一支约1,000人的俄帝国军队交战。4月28日，雅辛斯基将军率领一支来自加利西亚的起义军，在鲁达·鲁扎涅茨卡附近越过奥俄边境。扬努夫卢贝尔斯基县军事指挥官、俄军上校格奥尔吉·梅德尼科夫决定派出一支分遣队前往鲁达。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The Battle of Chancellorsville, April 30 – May 6, 1863, was a major battle of the American Civil War (1861–1865), and the principal engagement of the Chancellorsville campaign. Confederate General Robert E. Lee's risky decision to divide his army in the presence of a much larger enemy force resulted in a significant Confederate victory, described by some historians as Lee's "perfect battle".
en.n: American Civil War: The Battle of Chancellorsville ends with a major defeat of the Union's Army of the Potomac under Joseph Hooker by the Confederate Army of Northern Virginia under Robert E. Lee.

zh.s: 钱瑟勒斯维尔战役于1863年4月30日至5月6日进行，是美国内战（1861至1865年）中的一场重要战役，也是钱瑟勒斯维尔战役行动中的主要交战。南方邦联军将领罗伯特·E·李冒险分兵，在兵力远多于己方的敌军面前仍取得重大胜利。一些历史学家称之为李的“完美战役”。
zh.n: 美国内战：约瑟夫·胡克率领的波托马克联邦军遭罗伯特·E·李率领的北弗吉尼亚邦联军重创，战役结束。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained event introduction and exact dated calendar entry

en.s: The Battle of Calcasieu Pass was a minor skirmish fought on May 6, 1864, at the mouth of the Calcasieu River in southwestern Louisiana, during the American Civil War. The engagement was between the forces of Confederate Col. W. H. Griffin and Union Lieutenants Benjamin Loring and C. W. Lamson. In the battle, Confederates fought and captured two Union gunboats (Wave and Granite City) and later converted them into blockade runners.

zh.s: 卡尔克苏隘口战役是美国内战期间的一次小规模交战，于1864年5月6日在路易斯安那州西南部卡尔克苏河河口发生。交战双方分别是南方邦联军上校W·H·格里芬，以及联邦军中尉本杰明·洛林和C·W·拉姆森。邦联军在战斗中击败联邦军并俘获两艘炮艇“浪潮号”和“花岗岩城号”，后来将其改装成突破封锁的船只。

en.s: The Battle of Miyako Bay (宮古湾海戦, Miyako-wan Kaisen) was a naval action on 6 May 1869, in which samurai loyalists of the former Tokugawa shogunate under the flag of the newly formed Republic of Ezo failed to take over the Kōtetsu, the flagship of the Imperial forces of the new Meiji government. It was part of the overall Battle of Hakodate at the end of the Boshin War.

zh.s: 宫古湾海战（日语：宮古湾海戦，Miyako-wan Kaisen）于1869年5月6日爆发。效忠前德川幕府的武士在新成立的虾夷共和国旗帜下作战，未能夺取新明治政府军的旗舰“甲铁”号。这场海战是戊辰战争末期函馆战役的一部分。

en.s: General elections were held in Liberia on 6 May 1873. Incumbent President Joseph Jenkins Roberts of the Republican Party was the only candidate in the presidential elections, and was re-elected unopposed.

zh.s: 利比里亚于1873年5月6日举行大选。共和党现任总统约瑟夫·詹金斯·罗伯茨是总统选举中的唯一候选人，因而在无人竞争的情况下连任。

en.s: The Chinese Exclusion Act of 1882 was a United States federal law signed by President Chester A. Arthur on May 6, 1882, prohibiting all immigration of Chinese laborers for 10 years. The law made exceptions for travelers and diplomats. The Act also denied Chinese residents already in the US the ability to become citizens and Chinese people traveling in or out of the country were required to carry a certificate identifying their status or risk deportation.

zh.s: 1882年《排华法案》是美国联邦法律，由总统切斯特·A·阿瑟于1882年5月6日签署，规定10年内禁止中国劳工移民。法律对旅客和外交官设有例外。该法还剥夺了当时已居住在美国的华人申请公民身份的权利，并要求出入美国的华人随身携带身份证明，否则可能被驱逐出境。

en.s: The Battle of Veertien Strome (Battle of Fourteen Streams, Battle of Veertienstrome, Vaal River, 4–6 May 1900) was a military engagement in the Second Boer War fought near Warrenton, Northern Cape, by Boer troops under Sarel du Toit and British troops under Paul Methuen. Du Toit failed to prevent the British from crossing the Vaal River and entering the South African Republic from the southwest.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.t: 维尔蒂恩斯特罗姆战役
zh.s: 维尔蒂恩斯特罗姆战役也称十四溪战役、瓦尔河战役，于1900年5月4日至6日在第二次布尔战争期间爆发。战斗发生在北开普省瓦伦顿附近，布尔军由萨雷尔·杜托伊指挥，英军由保罗·梅休指挥。杜托伊未能阻止英军渡过瓦尔河，从西南方向进入南非共和国。
zh.n: 本条记录的是源信息框标注的事件结束日期。

en.t: The first issue of Gorkhapatra, the oldest still running state-owned Nepali newspaper, is published
en.s: Gorkhapatra (Nepali: गोरखापत्र) is the oldest Nepali language state-owned national daily newspaper of Nepal. It was started as a weekly newspaper in May 1901 and became a daily newspaper in 1961. It is managed by the Gorkhapatra Sansthan. The Rising Nepal is an English-language sister newspaper of Gorkhapatra. It is the sixth oldest newspaper in continuous publication in South Asia and the oldest in Nepal.

zh.t: 尼泊尔历史最悠久、仍在发行的国有报纸《廓尔喀报》创刊
zh.s: 《廓尔喀报》（尼泊尔语：गोरखापत्र）是尼泊尔历史最悠久的国有尼泊尔语全国性日报。它于 1901 年 5 月以周报形式创办，1961 年改为日报，由廓尔喀报社管理。《新尼泊尔报》是其英文姊妹报。该报是南亚持续出版历史第六悠久的报纸，也是尼泊尔历史最悠久的报纸。

en.s: The Battle of Holkrans or Holkrantz (6 May 1902) took place at Holkrans, near Vryheid in KwaZulu-Natal, South Africa during the second Anglo-Boer War.

zh.s: 霍尔克兰斯战役（也称霍尔克兰茨战役）于1902年5月6日在南非夸祖鲁-纳塔尔省弗赖海德附近的霍尔克兰斯爆发，发生于第二次布尔战争期间。

en.s: The Russian Constitution of 1906 refers to a major revision of the 1832 Fundamental Laws of the Russian Empire, which transformed the formerly absolutist state into one in which the emperor agreed for the first time to share his autocratic power with a parliament. It was enacted on 6 May [O.S. 23 April] 1906, on the eve of the opening of the first State Duma.
en.n: The Russian Constitution of 1906 is adopted (on April 23 by the Julian calendar).

zh.s: 1906年俄罗斯宪法是对1832年《俄罗斯帝国基本法》的重大修订，使原本专制的国家转变为皇帝首次同意与议会分享专制权力的体制。宪法于1906年5月6日（儒略历4月23日）颁布，时间在第一届国家杜马开幕前夕。
zh.n: 1906年俄罗斯宪法获通过（儒略历4月23日）。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained event introduction and exact dated calendar entry

en.t: George V becomes King of Great Britain, Ireland, and many overseas territories, on the death of his father, Edward VII
en.s: George V (George Frederick Ernest Albert; 3 June 1865 – 20 January 1936) was King of the United Kingdom and the British Dominions, and Emperor of India, from 6 May 1910 until his death in 1936. George was born during the reign of his paternal grandmother, Queen Victoria, as the second son of the Prince and Princess of Wales (later King Edward VII and Queen Alexandra).

zh.t: 爱德华七世去世后，乔治五世继承英国、爱尔兰及多个海外领地的王位
zh.s: 乔治五世（乔治·弗雷德里克·欧内斯特·阿尔伯特；1865年6月3日—1936年1月20日）自1910年5月6日起担任英国及其自治领国王和印度皇帝，直至1936年去世。他出生于祖母维多利亚女王在位期间，是威尔士亲王和王妃（后来的爱德华七世国王和亚历山德拉王后）的次子。

en.s: The 1911 Barnstaple by-election was a Parliamentary by-election held on 6 May 1911. It returned one Member of Parliament (MP) to the House of Commons of the Parliament of the United Kingdom, elected by the first past the post voting system.

zh.s: 1911年巴恩斯特珀尔补选于1911年5月6日举行，选出1名英国下议院议员，采用“先到先得”制。

en.s: The 1913 Los Angeles mayoral election took place on May 6, 1913, with a run-off election on June 3, 1913. George Alexander had retired from the job and police judge Henry H. Rose was elected over Los Angeles City Attorney John W. Shenk. Municipal elections in California, including Mayor of Los Angeles, are officially nonpartisan; candidates' party affiliations do not appear on the ballot.

zh.s: 1913年洛杉矶市长选举于1913年5月6日举行，第二轮选举于同年6月3日举行。乔治·亚历山大卸任，警察法官亨利·H·罗斯击败洛杉矶市检察官约翰·W·申克当选。加利福尼亚州的市政选举（包括洛杉矶市长选举）正式上均为无党派选举，候选人的党派不会列在选票上。

en.s: The Imperial Trans-Antarctic Expedition (abbreviated as ITAE) of 1914–1917 is considered to be the last major expedition of the Heroic Age of Antarctic Exploration. Conceived by Sir Ernest Shackleton, the expedition was an attempt to make the first land crossing of the Antarctic continent. After Roald Amundsen's South Pole expedition in 1911, this crossing remained, in Shackleton's words, the "one great main object of Antarctic journeyings".
en.n: Imperial Trans-Antarctic Expedition: The SY Aurora breaks loose from its anchorage during a gale, beginning a 312-day ordeal.

zh.s: 帝国横贯南极远征（简称ITAE）于1914年至1917年进行，被认为是英雄时代南极探险的最后一次大型远征。欧内斯特·沙克尔顿爵士提出这项计划，目标是首次横穿南极大陆。在罗尔德·阿蒙森1911年远征南极点后，沙克尔顿称横穿南极是南极探险“尚待完成的一项重大目标”。
zh.n: 帝国横贯南极远征期间，“极光号”在风暴中挣脱锚地，开始了长达312天的艰难漂流。

en.t: Vietnamese Emperor Duy Tân is captured while calling upon the people to rise up against the French, and is later deposed and exiled to Réunion island
en.s: Emperor Duy Tân (Hanoi: [zwi˧ tən˧], chữ Hán: 維新, lit. "renovation"; 19 September 1900 – 26 December 1945), born Nguyễn Phúc Vĩnh San, was the 11th emperor of the Nguyễn dynasty in Vietnam, who reigned for nine years between 1907 and 1916.

zh.t: 越南皇帝维新帝号召民众起义反抗法国时被捕，之后遭废黜并流放至留尼汪岛
zh.s: 维新帝（河内音：[zwi˧ tən˧]；汉字：维新，意为“革新”；1900 年 9 月 19 日—1945 年 12 月 26 日），本名阮福永珊，是阮朝第十一位皇帝，1907 至 1916 年在位九年。

en.s: The 1919 Los Angeles mayoral election took place on May 6, 1919, with a run-off election on June 3, 1919. Incumbent Frederic T. Woodman was defeated by Meredith P. Snyder. Snyder, the mayor of Los Angeles from 1896–98 and 1900–04, was elected to a third non-consecutive term. Municipal elections in California, including Mayor of Los Angeles, are officially nonpartisan; candidates' party affiliations do not appear on the ballot.

zh.s: 1919年洛杉矶市长选举于1919年5月6日举行，第二轮选举于同年6月3日举行。现任市长弗雷德里克·T·伍德曼败给梅雷迪思·P·斯奈德。斯奈德曾于1896至1898年及1900至1904年担任洛杉矶市长，这次当选第三个非连续任期。加利福尼亚州的市政选举（包括洛杉矶市长选举）正式上均为无党派选举，候选人的党派不会列在选票上。

en.s: The 1919 Baltimore mayoral election saw the election of William Frederick Broening.

zh.s: 1919年巴尔的摩市长选举最终选出威廉·弗雷德里克·布罗宁。

en.s: The Kachak Movement was a series of Albanian uprisings in Albanian-populated territories in Kosovo, Vardar Macedonia and Sandžak from 1919 to 1927. The uprisings began after the end of the First World War when Kosovo became part of the new Kingdom of Serbs, Croats, and Slovenes (also known as Yugoslavia).
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 卡查克运动是 1919 至 1927 年间发生于科索沃、瓦尔达尔马其顿和桑扎克等阿尔巴尼亚人聚居地区的一系列起义。第一次世界大战结束后，科索沃并入新成立的塞尔维亚人、克罗地亚人和斯洛文尼亚人王国，此后起义陆续爆发。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件开始日期。

en.s: The Stratford by-election, 1920 was a by-election during the 20th New Zealand Parliament for the rural Taranaki seat of Stratford. The by-election was called following the previous election being declared void, invalidating the preceding 1919 general election results. It was held on 6 May 1920.

zh.s: 1920年斯特拉特福选区补选是新西兰第20届议会的一场补选，选区覆盖塔拉纳基乡村地区。此前一次选举被宣布无效，导致1919年大选结果作废，因此举行本次补选。投票于1920年5月6日进行。

en.s: The 1923 Coupe de France final was a football match held at Stade Pershing, Paris on May 6, 1923, that saw Red Star Olympique defeat FC Sète 4–2 thanks to goals by Marcel Naudin (2), Lucien Cordon and Robert Joyaut.

zh.s: 1923年法国杯决赛于1923年5月6日在巴黎珀欣体育场举行。红星奥林匹克队凭借马塞尔·诺丹（2球）、吕西安·科尔东和罗贝尔·茹约的进球，以4比2击败塞特足球俱乐部。

en.s: The 1927 Coupe de France final was a football match held at Stade Olympique, Colombes on May 6, 1927, that saw Olympique de Marseille defeat US Quevilly 3–0 thanks to goals by Raymond Durand, Maurice Gallay and Jules Dewaquez.

zh.s: 1927年法国杯决赛于1927年5月6日在科隆布的奥林匹克体育场举行。马赛奥林匹克队凭借雷蒙·迪朗、莫里斯·加莱和朱尔·德瓦凯兹的进球，以3比0击败奎维伊美国人队。

en.s: The 1928 Coupe de France final was a football match held at Stade Olympique Yves-du-Manoir, Colombes on May 6, 1928, that saw Red Star Olympique defeat CA Paris 3–1 thanks to goals by Paul Wartel, Brenna Egil Lund and Juste Brouzes.

zh.s: 1928年法国杯决赛于1928年5月6日在科隆布的伊夫·迪马努瓦尔奥林匹克体育场举行。红星奥林匹克队凭借保罗·瓦尔特尔、布伦纳·埃吉尔·伦德和朱斯特·布鲁兹的进球，以3比1击败巴黎竞技俱乐部。

en.s: The 1931 Invercargill mayoral election was part of the New Zealand local elections held that same year. The polling was conducted using the standard first-past-the-post electoral method. Incumbent mayor John D. Campbell was narrowly defeated by the former mayor John Miller.

zh.s: 1931年因弗卡吉尔市长选举是新西兰当年地方选举的一部分。投票采用标准的“先到先得”制。现任市长约翰·D·坎贝尔以微弱差距败给前任市长约翰·米勒。

en.s: The 1931 Dunedin mayoral election was part of the New Zealand local elections held that same year. In 1931, elections were held for the Mayor of Dunedin plus other local government positions including twelve city councillors. The polling was conducted using the standard first-past-the-post electoral method.

zh.s: 1931年达尼丁市长选举是新西兰当年地方选举的一部分。1931年除选举达尼丁市长外，还选举了其他地方政府职位，包括12名市议员。投票采用标准的“先到先得”制。

en.s: The 1934 Coupe de France final was a football match held at Stade Olympique Yves-du-Manoir, Colombes on May 6, 1934, that saw FC Sète defeat Olympique de Marseille 2–1 thanks to goals by Istvan Lukacs.

zh.s: 1934年法国杯决赛于1934年5月6日在科隆布的伊夫·迪马努瓦尔奥林匹克体育场举行。塞特足球俱乐部凭借伊什特万·卢卡奇的进球，以2比1击败马赛奥林匹克队。

en.t: Creation of the Works Progress Administration
en.s: The Works Progress Administration (WPA; from 1935 to 1939, then known as the Work Projects Administration from 1939 to 1943) was an American New Deal agency that employed millions of jobseekers (mostly men who were not formally educated) to carry out public works projects, including the construction of public buildings and roads. It was set up on May 6, 1935, by presidential order, as a key part of the Second New Deal.

zh.s: 工程振兴署（WPA）是美国新政时期的一家机构，1935年至1939年称为工程振兴署，1939年至1943年改称工程项目管理局。该机构雇用了数百万求职者（多数是未接受过正规教育的男性）参与公共工程，包括修建公共建筑和道路。1935年5月6日，总统通过行政命令成立该机构，使其成为第二次新政的重要组成部分。

en.s: The Hindenburg disaster occurred on May 6, 1937, as the German passenger airship LZ 129 Hindenburg caught fire and was destroyed during its attempt to dock with its mooring mast at Naval Air Station Lakehurst in Manchester Township, New Jersey, United States. Of the 97 people on board (36 passengers and 61 crewmen), there were 35 fatalities (13 passengers and 22 crewmen). One worker on the ground was also killed, making a total of 36 fatalities. The disaster was the subject of spectacular newsreel coverage, photographs, and Herbert Morrison's recorded radio eyewitness reports from the landing field, which were broadcast the next day.

zh.s: 1937年5月6日，德国客运飞艇LZ 129「兴登堡号」在美国新泽西州曼彻斯特镇的莱克赫斯特海军航空站试图靠泊时起火并被焚毁。机上97人（36名乘客和61名机组人员）中有35人死亡，包括13名乘客和22名机组人员。地面还有一名工作人员遇难，总计36人死亡。灾难现场的新闻影片、照片和Herbert Morrison的广播目击报道引发广泛关注；报道于次日播出。

en.s: The 1941 Los Angeles mayoral election took place on April 1, 1941, with a run-off election on May 6, 1941. Incumbent Fletcher Bowron was re-elected in the runoff election, defeating councilmember Stephen W. Cunningham. Municipal elections in California, including Mayor of Los Angeles, are officially nonpartisan; candidates' party affiliations do not appear on the ballot.
en.n: This entry records the listed event date, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1941年洛杉矶市长选举的首轮投票于1941年4月1日举行，第二轮于同年5月6日举行。现任市长弗莱彻·鲍伦在第二轮中击败市议员斯蒂芬·W·坎宁安，成功连任。加利福尼亚州的市政选举（包括洛杉矶市长选举）正式上均为无党派选举，候选人的党派不会列在选票上。

en.t: The first flight of the Republic P-47 Thunderbolt
en.s: The Republic P-47 Thunderbolt (nicknamed the "Jug") is a monoplane fighter aircraft designed and produced by the American aircraft manufacturer Republic Aviation. Designed around the powerful Pratt & Whitney R-2800 Double Wasp 18-cylinder radial engine and produced from 1941 through to 1945, it became the foremost American fighter-bomber in the ground-attack role during World War II.

zh.t: 共和 P-47 雷电式战斗机首飞
zh.s: 共和 P-47 雷电式战斗机（绰号“Jug”）是美国飞机制造商共和航空设计和生产的单翼战斗机。它以强劲的普惠 R-2800 Double Wasp 18 缸星形发动机为核心设计，生产于 1941 至 1945 年间，并在第二次世界大战中成为美国主要的对地攻击战斗轰炸机。

en.s: The Battle of Corregidor (Filipino: Labanan sa Corregidor; Japanese: コレヒドールの戦い), fought on 5–6 May 1942, was the culmination of the Japanese campaign for the conquest of the Commonwealth of the Philippines during World War II. The fall of Bataan on 9 April 1942 ended all organized opposition by the United States Army Forces in the Far East to the invading Japanese forces on Luzon, in the northern Philippines.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 科雷希多岛战役（菲律宾语：Labanan sa Corregidor；日语：コレヒドールの戦い）于1942年5月5日至6日进行，是第二次世界大战期间日军征服菲律宾联邦行动的最后阶段。4月9日巴丹陷落后，美国远东陆军在菲律宾北部吕宋岛对入侵日军的有组织抵抗已告结束。
zh.n: 本条记录的是源信息框标注的事件结束日期。

en.s: ONS 5 was the 5th of the numbered ON/ONS convoys of Slow trade convoys Outbound from the British Isles to North America. The North Atlantic battle around it in May 1943 is regarded as the turning point of the Battle of the Atlantic in World War II. The battle ebbed and flowed over a week and involved more than 50 Allied ships and their escorts, against more than 30 U-boats.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: ONS 5是从不列颠群岛驶往北美的编号ON/ONS慢速商船队中的第5支。1943年5月，围绕这支船队发生的北大西洋海战被视为二战大西洋战役的转折点。战斗持续了一周多，参战方包括50多艘盟军舰船及其护航舰艇，以及30多艘德国潜艇。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The battle of Graużyszki took place on 6 May 1944 near the Villages of Graużyszki, Adamowszczyzna and Sieńkowszyzna. Polish forces from the 8th and 13th Oszmiana Brigade of the Home Army (Armia Krajowa) under the command of Adam Walczak engaged units of the Lithuanian Territorial Defense Force under the command of Antanas Andriunas. The battle ended with a Polish victory.

zh.s: 格劳日什基战役于1944年5月6日在格劳日什基、阿达莫夫什奇兹纳和谢恩科夫什奇兹纳村附近爆发。波兰家乡军第8和第13奥什米亚纳旅在亚当·瓦尔查克指挥下，与安塔纳斯·安德里乌纳斯指挥的立陶宛地方防卫部队交战。战役以波兰方面获胜告终。

en.s: The 1945 Coupe de France final was a football match held at Stade Olympique Yves-du-Manoir, Colombes on 6 May 1945, that saw RC Paris defeat Lille OSC 3–0 thanks to goals by André Philippot, Pierre Ponsetti and Oscar Heisserer.

zh.s: 1945年法国杯决赛于1945年5月6日在科隆布的伊夫·迪马努瓦尔奥林匹克体育场举行。巴黎竞赛俱乐部凭借安德烈·菲利波、皮埃尔·庞塞蒂和奥斯卡·海瑟勒雷的进球，以3比0击败里尔奥林匹克体育俱乐部。

en.s: The Prague offensive (Russian: Пражская стратегическая наступательная операция, romanized: Prazhskaya strategicheskaya nastupatel'naya operatsiya, lit. 'Prague Strategic Offensive Operation') was the last major military operation of World War II in Europe. The offensive was fought on the Eastern Front from 6 May to 11 May 1945. Fought concurrently with the Prague uprising, the offensive significantly helped the liberation of Czechoslovakia in 1945.
en.n: World War II: The Prague Offensive, the last major battle of the Eastern Front, begins.

zh.s: 布拉格攻势（俄语：Пражская стратегическая наступательная операция，罗马化：Prazhskaya strategicheskaya nastupatel'naya operatsiya，意为“布拉格战略攻势行动”）是第二次世界大战欧洲战场最后一次重大军事行动。攻势于1945年5月6日至11日在东线展开，与布拉格起义同时发生，并大力推动捷克斯洛伐克于1945年获得解放。
zh.n: 第二次世界大战：东线最后一场大战布拉格攻势开始。

en.s: The Moravia–Ostrava offensive operation (Russian: Моравско-Остравская наступательная операция) was an offensive by the Red Army during World War II that lasted from March 10 to May 6, 1945, and was the Soviet conquest of present-day Eastern Czech Republic (Moravia also part of Polish and Czech Silesia).
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.t: 摩拉维亚—俄斯特拉发攻势
zh.s: 摩拉维亚—俄斯特拉发攻势是红军在第二次世界大战期间发起的一场进攻，于1945年3月10日至5月6日进行。苏军借此征服了现今捷克东部的地区，包括摩拉维亚以及部分波兰和捷克西里西亚。

en.s: The last actions of the Battle of the Atlantic in American waters took place on 5–6 May 1945. There were two such actions, against U-853 off the Rhode Island coast and U-881, south of Cape Race, both sunk during the same period.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 大西洋战役在美洲水域的最后几次军事行动于1945年5月5日至6日发生，共有两次：美国罗得岛海岸外的U-853号潜艇，以及卡普雷斯以南的U-881号潜艇，两艘潜艇都在这段时间内被击沉。

en.s: The siege of Breslau, also known as the battle of Breslau, was a three-month-long siege of the city of Breslau in Lower Silesia, Germany (now Wrocław, Poland), lasting to the end of World War II in Europe. From 13 February 1945 to 6 May 1945, German troops in Breslau were besieged by the Soviet forces which encircled the city as part of the Lower Silesian Offensive Operation.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 布雷斯劳围城战也称布雷斯劳战役，是二战欧洲战场结束前围攻德国下西里西亚布雷斯劳（今波兰弗罗茨瓦夫）的一场持续三个月的战事。1945年2月13日至5月6日，苏军在下西里西亚攻势中包围布雷斯劳，围城中的德军因此被困。

en.s: The 1946 Bulgarian Cup final was the 6th final of the Bulgarian Cup (in this period the tournament was named Cup of the Soviet Army), and was contested between Levski Sofia and Chernolomets Popovo on 6 May 1946 at Yunak Stadium in Sofia. Levski won the final 4–1.

zh.s: 1946年保加利亚杯决赛是该赛事第6届决赛；当时赛事名为苏联军队杯。索菲亚列夫斯基队与波波沃切尔诺洛梅茨队于1946年5月6日在索非亚尤纳克体育场争夺冠军，列夫斯基以4比1获胜。

en.s: The 1947 Baltimore mayoral election saw the election of Thomas D'Alesandro Jr.

zh.s: 1947年巴尔的摩市长选举最终选出托马斯·德亚历山德罗二世。

en.t: EDSAC, the first practical electronic digital stored-program computer, runs its first operation
en.s: The von Neumann architecture—also known as the von Neumann model or Princeton architecture—is a computer architecture based on the First Draft of a Report on the EDVAC, written by John von Neumann in 1945, describing designs by John Mauchly and J. Presper Eckert at the University of Pennsylvania's Moore School of Electrical Engineering.

zh.t: EDSAC 首次运行程序，成为第一台实用的电子数字存储程序计算机
zh.s: 冯·诺伊曼架构又称冯·诺伊曼模型或普林斯顿架构，是一种计算机架构，依据冯·诺伊曼于 1945 年撰写的《EDVAC 报告初稿》。该报告描述了宾夕法尼亚大学摩尔电气工程学院约翰·莫奇利和 J·普雷斯珀·埃克特提出的设计。

en.s: The 1950 Tasmanian state election was held on 6 May 1950 in the Australian state of Tasmania to elect 30 members of the Tasmanian House of Assembly. The election used the Hare-Clark proportional representation system — six members were elected from each of five electorates. Following the 1948 election, Premier Robert Cosgrove and the Labor Party remained in government with the support of independent MHA Bill Wedd.

zh.s: 塔斯马尼亚州于1950年5月6日举行州选举，选出塔斯马尼亚众议院30名议员。选举采用黑尔-克拉克比例代表制，五个选区各选出6名议员。1948年选举后，州长罗伯特·科斯格罗夫领导的工党在独立议员比尔·韦德的支持下继续执政。

en.s: General elections were held in Bolivia on 6 May 1951. Víctor Paz Estenssoro of the opposition Revolutionary Nationalist Movement (MNR) received the most votes in the presidential election, but as he did not obtain an absolute majority, the National Congress was constitutionally obliged to elect a President on 6 August from the three candidates who received the most public votes. However, on 16 May a military junta assumed responsibility for the Government with Brigadier General Hugo Ballivián as President. The National Congress was ultimately dissolved by Supreme Decree of 7 June, 1951, which annulled the results of the elections.

zh.s: 玻利维亚于1951年5月6日举行大选。总统选举中，反对党民族革命运动党（MNR）的维克托·帕斯·埃斯登索罗得票最多，但未获绝对多数，按宪法规定，国民议会必须在8月6日从得票最多的三名候选人中选出总统。然而，5月16日军政府接管政府，由准将乌戈·巴利维安出任总统。1951年6月7日，国民议会最终依据最高法令解散，选举结果也被撤销。

en.s: The 1951 Coupe de France final was a football match held at Stade Olympique Yves-du-Manoir, Colombes on 6 May 1951, that saw RC Strasbourg defeat US Valenciennes-Anzin 3–0 thanks to goals by René Bihel, Raymond Krug and André Nagy.

zh.s: 1951年法国杯决赛于1951年5月6日在科隆布的伊夫·迪马努瓦尔奥林匹克体育场举行。斯特拉斯堡竞赛俱乐部凭借勒内·比埃尔、雷蒙·克鲁格和安德烈·纳吉的进球，以3比0击败瓦朗谢讷-昂赞体育联盟。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Austria in 1951, the first time that the President of Austria had been elected by popular vote. A first round of voting was held on 6 May, and with no candidate achieving a majority of the votes, a second round was held on 27 May between the top two candidates, Mayor of Vienna, Theodor Körner representing the Socialist Party's, and Upper Austria Governor Heinrich Gleißner of the Austrian People's Party.
en.n: This entry records the first round, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 奥地利于1951年举行总统选举，这是奥地利总统首次由民众投票选出。首轮投票于5月6日举行，由于没有候选人获得多数票，第二轮于5月27日举行，由得票最高的两名候选人角逐：社会党候选人、维也纳市长西奥多·克尔纳，以及奥地利人民党候选人、上奥地利州州长海因里希·格莱斯纳。
zh.n: 本条记录的是源信息框标注的首轮投票日期。

en.s: An election to the Aberdeen Corporation was held on 6 May 1952, alongside municipal elections across Scotland. 36 of the corporation's 37 seats were up for election. The election saw a large swing in favour of Labour, ending with a majority of 5 on the council. All seats were up for election as ward boundaries were redrawn and previously elected councilors' terms were cut short.

zh.s: 阿伯丁市政议会选举于1952年5月6日举行，与苏格兰各地的市政选举同日进行。议会37个席位中有36席改选。工党得票大幅上升，最终在议会取得5席多数。由于选区边界重划，全部席位都进行改选，原任议员的任期也提前结束。

en.s: 1952 Emperor's Cup Final was the 32nd final of the Emperor's Cup competition. The final was played at Fujieda Higashi High School Ground in Shizuoka on May 6, 1952. All Keio won the championship.

zh.s: 1952年日本天皇杯决赛是第32届天皇杯决赛，于1952年5月6日在静冈藤枝东高中球场举行。庆应义塾大学队赢得冠军。

en.s: 1956 Emperor's Cup Final was the 36th final of the Emperor's Cup competition. The final was played at Omiya Velodrome in Saitama on May 6, 1956. Keio BRB won the championship.

zh.s: 1956年日本天皇杯决赛是第36届天皇杯决赛，于1956年5月6日在埼玉大宫自行车赛车场举行。庆应BRB队赢得冠军。

en.s: The Election Commission of India held indirect 2nd presidential elections of India on May 6, 1957. Dr. Rajendra Prasad won his re-election with 459,698 votes over his rivals Chowdhry Hari Ram who got 2,672 votes and Nagendra Narayan Das who got 2,000 votes. Dr. Rajendra Prasad, has been the only person, to have won and served two terms, as President of India.

zh.s: 印度选举委员会于1957年5月6日举行第二次间接总统选举。拉金德拉·普拉萨德博士以459,698票连任，击败获得2,672票的Chowdhry Hari Ram和获得2,000票的Nagendra Narayan Das。普拉萨德是唯一一位当选并担任两届印度总统的人。

en.s: 1957 Emperor's Cup Final was the 37th final of the Emperor's Cup competition. The final was played at Hiroshima Kokutaiji High School Stadium in Hiroshima on May 6, 1957. Chudai Club won the championship.

zh.s: 1957年日本天皇杯决赛是第37届天皇杯决赛，于1957年5月6日在广岛国泰寺高中体育场举行。中大俱乐部赢得冠军。

en.s: 1959 Emperor's Cup Final was the 39th final of the Emperor's Cup competition. The final was played at Koishikawa Football Stadium in Tokyo on May 6, 1959. Kwangaku Club won the championship.

zh.s: 1959年日本天皇杯决赛是第39届天皇杯决赛，于1959年5月6日在东京小石川足球场举行。关学俱乐部赢得冠军。

en.s: 1960 Emperor's Cup Final was the 40th final of the Emperor's Cup competition. The final was played at Utsubo Football Stadium in Osaka on May 6, 1960. Furukawa Electric won the championship.

zh.s: 1960年日本天皇杯决赛是第40届天皇杯决赛，于1960年5月6日在大阪宇津保足球场举行。古河电工队赢得冠军。

en.s: The 1961 FA Cup final was the 80th final of the FA Cup. It took place on 6 May 1961 at Wembley Stadium and was contested between Leicester City and Tottenham Hotspur. Tottenham won the match 2–0, with Bobby Smith and Terry Dyson scoring the goals. Having already won the League, Spurs became the first club to achieve the Double since Aston Villa in 1897.

zh.s: 1961年英格兰足总杯决赛是第80届决赛，于1961年5月6日在温布利球场举行，由莱斯特城对阵托特纳姆热刺。热刺以2比0获胜，博比·史密斯和特里·戴森攻入两球。热刺此前已赢得联赛冠军，成为1897年阿斯顿维拉之后首支赢得双冠王的球队。

en.s: 1962 Emperor's Cup Final was the 42nd final of the Emperor's Cup competition. The final was played at Nishikyogoku Athletic Stadium in Kyoto on May 6, 1962. Chuo University won the championship.

zh.s: 1962年日本天皇杯决赛是第42届天皇杯决赛，于1962年5月6日在京都西京极运动场举行。中央大学队赢得冠军。

en.s: The 1962 Italian presidential election was held in Italy on 2–6 May 1962. Only members of Parliament and regional delegates were entitled to vote, most of these electors having been elected in the 1958 general election. As head of state of the Italian Republic, the President has a role of representation of national unity and guarantees that Italian politics comply with the Italian Constitution, in the framework of a parliamentary system.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 意大利于1962年5月2日至6日举行总统选举。这是意大利总统首次由民众投票选出。只有议员和各大区代表有投票权，其中多数人在1958年大选中当选。作为意大利共和国国家元首，总统承担代表国家团结、确保意大利政治遵守宪法的职责，国家实行议会制。
zh.n: 本条记录的是源信息框标注的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Election Commission of India held the indirect 4th presidential elections of India on May 6, 1967. Zakir Husain, with 471,244 votes, won the presidency over his rival Koka Subbarao, who garnered 363,971 votes.

zh.s: 印度选举委员会于1967年5月6日举行第四次间接总统选举。扎基尔·侯赛因以471,244票当选，击败获得363,971票的对手Koka Subbarao。

en.s: Elections to Hale Council were held on Saturday, 6 May 1967. One third of the councillors were up for election, with each successful candidate to serve a three-year term of office. The Conservative Party retained overall control of the council.

zh.s: 黑尔议会选举于1967年5月6日（星期六）举行，议员三分之一席位进行改选，胜选者任期三年。保守党继续掌控议会。

en.s: The 1967 Indian vice presidential election was held on 6 May 1967 to elect vice president of India. V. V. Giri was elected for the post.

zh.s: 印度于1967年5月6日举行副总统选举，选出印度副总统。V·V·吉里当选。

en.s: The Battle of An Bao took place from 5 to 6 May 1968 in Bình Định province during the Vietnam War when elements of the People's Army of Vietnam (PAVN) 3rd Division ambushed a unit of the 1st Battalion, 50th Infantry Regiment (Mechanized).
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 安保战役于1968年5月5日至6日在越南战争期间发生于平定省。越南人民军第3师部队伏击了美国陆军第50步兵团第1营（机械化）的一支部队。

en.s: An Election to the Edinburgh Corporation was held on 6 May 1969, alongside municipal elections across Scotland. Of the councils 68 seats, 23 were up for election. Following the election, with two by-elections pending, Edinburgh Corporation was composed of 29 Progressives, 17 Labour councillors, 10 SNP councillors, 7 Conservatives, 2 Liberals, and 2 independents. The Conservatives in particular did well, gaining 4 councillors. Two of these gains were at the expense of Labour, in mainly working class wards. The SNP, in contrast, who had done so well at the previous election, only gained Sighthill.

zh.s: 爱丁堡市政公司选举于1969年5月6日举行，与苏格兰各地市政选举同时进行。68个席位中有23席改选。选举后有两场补选尚未举行，议会由29名进步党议员、17名工党议员、10名苏格兰民族党议员、7名保守党议员、2名自由党议员和2名独立议员组成。保守党表现尤其出色，增加4席，其中两席从主要是工人阶级选区的工党手中赢得。苏格兰民族党在上次选举中表现突出，本次只在西特希尔增加一席。

en.s: The 1970 European Cup final was an association football match played between Feijenoord of the Netherlands and Celtic of Scotland on 6 May 1970 at the San Siro, Milan, Italy. The showpiece event was the final match of the 1969–70 season of Europe's premier cup competition, the European Cup. Feyenoord were appearing in their first final, while Celtic were appearing in their second final, after winning the competition in 1967.

zh.s: 1970年欧洲冠军杯决赛于1970年5月6日在意大利米兰的圣西罗球场举行，由荷兰费耶诺德队对阵苏格兰凯尔特人队。这是欧洲顶级俱乐部杯赛1969至1970赛季的决赛。费耶诺德首次打入决赛；凯尔特人第二次闯入决赛，此前曾于1967年夺冠。

en.s: Elections to Hale Council were held on Saturday, 6 May 1972. One third of the councillors were up for election, with each successful candidate to serve a two-year term of office. These were the final elections held in Hale before it became part of Trafford. The Conservative Party retained overall control of the council.

zh.s: 黑尔议会选举于1972年5月6日（星期六）举行，议员三分之一席位进行改选，胜选者任期两年。这是黑尔并入特拉福德之前举行的最后一次选举。保守党继续掌控议会。

en.s: The 1972 FA Cup final took place on 6 May 1972 at Wembley Stadium. It was the centenary final (although only the 91st final due to the world wars) and the 44th to be played at Wembley. It was contested between cup holders Arsenal, who had won the Football League and the FA Cup the previous season, and Leeds United, who had won the Inter-Cities Fairs Cup and finished second in the league the previous season, but had never won the FA Cup.

zh.s: 1972年英格兰足总杯决赛于1972年5月6日在温布利球场举行。这是足总杯百年纪念决赛（由于两次世界大战中断，实际为第91届），也是在温布利举行的第44届决赛。参赛双方是卫冕冠军阿森纳和利兹联。阿森纳在上个赛季赢得英格兰足球联赛和足总杯；利兹联则赢得城际博览会杯并在联赛中排名第二，但此前从未赢得足总杯。

en.t: Deniz Gezmiş, Yusuf Aslan and Hüseyin İnan are executed in Ankara after being convicted of attempting to overthrow the Constitutional order
en.s: Deniz Gezmiş (Turkish pronunciation: [deˈniz ɟezˈmiʃ], 27 February 1947 – 6 May 1972) was a Turkish Marxist-Leninist revolutionary, student leader, and political activist in Turkey in the late 1960s. He was one of the founding members of the People's Liberation Army of Turkey (THKO). He was born to an inspector of primary education and syndicalist Cemil Gezmiş and a primary school teacher Mukaddes Gezmiş.

zh.t: 德尼兹·格兹米什、优素福·阿斯兰和侯赛因·伊南因被判企图推翻宪政秩序而在安卡拉遭处决
zh.s: 德尼兹·格兹米什（土耳其语发音：[deˈniz ɟezˈmiʃ]；1947 年 2 月 27 日—1972 年 5 月 6 日）是土耳其马克思列宁主义革命者、学生领袖，也是 20 世纪 60 年代末土耳其的政治活动家。他是土耳其人民解放军（THKO）的创始成员之一。他的父母分别是小学督学、工会活动人士杰米尔·格兹米什和小学教师穆卡德斯·格兹米什。

en.s: The 1973 Ipswich Borough Council election was the first election to the new Ipswich Borough Council which had been established by the Local Government Act 1972 in England and Wales. It took place as part of the 1973 United Kingdom local elections. There were 14 wards returning between 2 and 5 councillors each.

zh.t: 1973年伊普斯维奇自治市议会选举
zh.s: 1973年伊普斯维奇自治市议会选举是英格兰和威尔士依据《1972年地方政府法》成立的新伊普斯维奇自治市议会首次举行的选举，也是1973年英国地方选举的一部分。14个选区各选出2至5名议员。

en.s: Local elections were held in the United Kingdom on 6 May 1976. Elections were for one third of the seats on Metropolitan borough councils and for all seats on Non-Metropolitan district councils in England; and for all seats on the Welsh district councils. The elections were the first electoral test for the new Prime Minister James Callaghan, and were a major reverse for the ruling Labour Party. The opposition Conservative party made large gains of seats and control of councils at the expense of both Labour and the Liberal Party. The Conservatives easily gained control of their principal target council, Birmingham.

zh.s: 英国于1976年5月6日举行地方选举。英格兰的大都会自治市议会有三分之一席位改选，非大都会区议会全体席位改选；威尔士区议会也全部改选。这是新任首相詹姆斯·卡拉汉上任后的首次选举考验，执政工党遭遇重大挫败。反对党保守党大幅增加席位，并从工党和自由党手中夺得多个议会的控制权。保守党轻松赢得其主要目标伯明翰议会的控制权。

en.s: Elections to Manchester Council were held on Thursday, 6 May 1976. One third of the council was up for election, with each successful candidate to serve a four-year term of office, expiring in 1980. The Labour Party retained overall control of the Council.

zh.s: 曼彻斯特市议会选举于1976年5月6日星期四举行。议会通常应改选的三分之一席位在此次选举中改选，当选者任期四年，至1980年届满。工党继续控制议会。

en.s: Elections to Sheffield City Council were held on 6 May 1976. One third of the council was up for election.

en.s: Elections to Trafford Council were held on Thursday, 6 May 1976. One third of the council was up for election, with each successful candidate to serve a four-year term of office, expiring in 1980. The Conservative Party retained overall control of the council.

zh.s: 特拉福德议会选举于1976年5月6日星期四举行。议会通常应改选的三分之一席位在此次选举中改选，当选者任期四年，至1980年届满。保守党继续控制议会。

en.s: The 1976 Bristol City Council election took place on 6 May 1976 to elect members of Bristol City Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. Labour retained overall control of the council despite losing 9 seats to the Conservatives.

zh.s: 1976年布里斯托尔市议会选举于5月6日举行，选出英格兰布里斯托尔市议会成员，与其他地方选举同日进行。工党失去9席给保守党，但仍继续控制议会。

en.s: The 1976 Breckland District Council election took place on 6 May 1976 to elect members of Breckland District Council in Norfolk, England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

en.s: The 1976 Southend-on-Sea Borough Council election took place on 6 May 1976 to elect members of Southend-on-Sea Borough Council in Essex, England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.t: 1976年滨海绍森德自治市议会选举
zh.s: 1976年滨海绍森德自治市议会选举于5月6日举行，选出英格兰埃塞克斯郡滨海绍森德自治市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。

en.s: The 1976 Tendring District Council election took place on 6 May 1976 to elect members of Tendring District Council in England. This was the same day as other local elections held across the United Kingdom.

zh.s: 1976年滕德林区议会选举于5月6日举行，选出英格兰滕德林区议会议员，与英国各地其他地方选举同日进行。

en.s: Elections to Stockport Council were held on Thursday, 6 May 1976. One third of the council was up for election, with each successful candidate to serve a four-year term of office, expiring in 1980. The Conservative Party retained overall control of the council.

zh.t: 1976年斯托克波特都市自治市议会选举
zh.s: 斯托克波特议会选举于1976年5月6日（星期四）举行，议会三分之一席位进行改选，胜选者任期四年，到1980年届满。保守党继续掌控议会。

en.s: The 1976 City of Lincoln Council election took place on 6 May 1976. This was on the same day as other local elections. The entire council was up for election and the Democratic Labour Party retained control of the council.

zh.s: 1976年林肯市议会选举于5月6日举行，与其他地方选举同日进行。议会全部席位都进行改选，民主工党继续掌控议会。

en.s: The 1976 Braintree District Council election took place on 6 May 1976 to elect members of Braintree District Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 1976年布伦特里区议会选举于5月6日举行，选出英格兰布伦特里区议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。

en.s: The 1976 Corby District Council election took place on 6 May 1976 to elect members of Corby District Council in Northamptonshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections. It was the first election be held under new ward boundaries. The Conservative Party gained overall control of the council from the Labour Party, for the first and only time in its history.

zh.s: 1976年科比区议会选举于5月6日举行，选出英格兰北安普敦郡科比区议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。这是按新选区边界举行的首次选举。保守党从工党手中夺得议会控制权；这是科比历史上唯一一次由保守党掌控议会。

en.s: The 1976 Horsham District Council election took place on 6 May 1976 to elect members of Horsham District Council in England. It was held on the same day as other local elections. The Conservatives won a majority of 9 on the council, gaining from Independent. In a number of seats, candidates who stood as an Independent in 1973, when these seats were last contested, stood again as a Conservative Party candidate.

zh.s: 1976年霍舍姆区议会选举于5月6日举行，选出英格兰霍舍姆区议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。保守党在议会赢得9席多数，取代无党籍议员掌控议会。在一些选区，曾于1973年上次选举中以无党籍身份参选的候选人，这次改以保守党候选人身份再次参选。

en.s: The 1976 Bracknell District Council election took place on 6 May 1976, to elect all 31 members in 16 wards for Bracknell District Council in England. The election was held on the same day as other local elections as part of the 1976 United Kingdom local elections. The Conservative Party ousted the one-term Labour Party council, winning all but 4 of the seats, with Labour group leader Bill Lindop losing his seat of Wildridings.

zh.s: 1976年布拉克内尔区议会选举于5月6日举行，选出英格兰布拉克内尔区议会全部31名议员，分属16个选区。选举与1976年英国地方选举中的其他投票同日举行。保守党击败只执政一届的工党议会，赢得除4席以外的所有席位；工党党团领袖比尔·林多普也失去了他在威尔德林斯选区的席位。

en.s: Elections to Chichester District Council in West Sussex, United Kingdom were held on 6 May 1976. The whole council was up for election and resulted in a Conservative majority.

zh.s: 英国西萨塞克斯郡奇切斯特区议会选举于1976年5月6日举行。议会全部席位都进行改选，选后保守党取得多数。

en.s: The 1976 Basildon District Council election took place on 6 May 1976 to elect members of Basildon District Council in Essex, England. This was on the same day as other local elections. The Labour Party lost overall control of the council, which fell under no overall control.

zh.s: 1976年巴西尔登区议会选举于5月6日举行，选出英格兰埃塞克斯郡巴西尔登区议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。工党失去议会多数，议会转为没有任何政党占据多数。

en.s: The 1976 Cambridge City Council election took place on 6 May 1976 to elect members of Cambridge City Council in Cambridge, Cambridgeshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England. The whole council was up for election on new ward boundaries, with fourteen 3-seat wards being contested at this election. Labour lost control of the council to the Conservatives.

zh.s: 1976年剑桥市议会选举于5月6日举行，选出英格兰剑桥郡剑桥市议会议员，与英格兰各地其他地方选举同日进行。议会全部席位按新的选区边界改选，共有14个三席选区参加选举。工党失去议会控制权，由保守党接替。

en.s: The 1976 West Norfolk District Council election took place on 6 May 1976 to elect members of West Norfolk District Council in Norfolk, England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 1976年西诺福克区议会选举于5月6日举行，选出英格兰诺福克郡西诺福克区议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。

en.s: The 1976 Welwyn Hatfield District Council election took place on 6 May 1976 to elect members of Welwyn Hatfield District Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. All seats were up for election. In a reversal of the initial election the Conservatives managed to secure a majority of the total votes over their main rivals the Labour Party, gaining enough seats to take control of the council, albeit by only two seats.

zh.t: 1976年韦林哈特菲尔德区议会选举
zh.s: 1976年韦林哈特菲尔德区议会选举于5月6日举行，选出英格兰韦林哈特菲尔德区议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。所有席位都进行改选。与最初选举结果相反，保守党最终以总得票领先主要对手工党，并赢得足够席位掌控议会，但只多出2席。

en.s: Elections to the Adur District Council were held on 6 May 1976, with the entire council up for election. The two councillors in Marine elected as Residents were defending their seats as Independents. Overall turnout was recorded at 51.8%. The election resulted in the council remaining under no overall control.

zh.s: 阿杜尔区议会选举于1976年5月6日举行，议会全部席位都进行改选。海洋选区两名以居民党身份当选的议员这次以无党籍身份竞选连任。整体投票率为51.8%。选后议会仍没有任何政党占据多数。

en.s: The 1976 Wirral Metropolitan Borough Council election took place on 6 May 1976 to elect Wirral Metropolitan Borough Council members in England. This election was held on the same day as other local elections.

zh.t: 1976年威勒尔都市自治市议会选举
zh.s: 1976年威勒尔都市自治市议会选举于5月6日举行，选出英格兰威勒尔都市自治市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日举行。

en.s: The 1976 Stevenage Borough Council election took place on 6 May 1976. This was on the same day as other local elections. The entire council was up for election and the Labour Party retained control of the council.

zh.t: 1976年史蒂文尼奇自治市议会选举
zh.s: 1976年史蒂文尼奇自治市议会选举于5月6日举行，与其他地方选举同日进行。议会全部席位都进行改选，工党继续掌控议会。

en.s: The 1976 Harlow District Council election took place on 6 May 1976 to elect members of Harlow District Council in Essex, England. This was on the same day as other local elections. The Labour Party retained control of the council.

zh.s: 1976年哈洛区议会选举于5月6日举行，选出英格兰埃塞克斯郡哈洛区议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。工党继续掌控议会。

en.s: Elections to Barnsley Metropolitan Borough Council were held on 6 May 1976, with one third of council up for election. The election resulted in Labour retaining control of the council.

zh.t: 1976年巴恩斯利都市自治市议会选举
zh.s: 巴恩斯利都市自治市议会选举于1976年5月6日举行，议会三分之一席位进行改选。工党继续掌控议会。

en.s: The 1976 North Norfolk District Council election took place on 6 May 1976 to elect members of North Norfolk District Council in Norfolk, England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 1976年北诺福克区议会选举于5月6日举行，选出英格兰诺福克郡北诺福克区议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。

en.s: The 1976 South Norfolk District Council election took place on 6 May 1976 to elect members of South Norfolk District Council in Norfolk, England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 1976年南诺福克区议会选举于5月6日举行，选出英格兰诺福克郡南诺福克区议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。

en.s: The 1976 Bath City Council election was held on Thursday 6 May 1976 to elect councillors to Bath City Council in England. It took place on the same day as other district council elections in the United Kingdom. The entire council was up for election. Following boundary changes the number of wards was increased by one, and the number of seats increased from 45 to 48.

zh.s: 巴斯市议会选举于1976年5月6日（星期四）举行，选出英格兰巴斯市议会议员，与英国其他区议会选举同日进行。议会全部席位都进行改选。选区边界调整后，选区数量增加1个，议席数从45席增至48席。

en.s: The 1976 Fenland District Council election took place on 6 May 1976 to elect members of Fenland District Council in the Isle of Ely, Cambridgeshire, England. This was on the same day as the other local elections. The Conservative Party achieved a majority on the council.

zh.s: 1976年芬兰区议会选举于5月6日举行，选出英格兰剑桥郡伊利岛芬兰区议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。保守党在议会取得多数。

en.s: Elections for all 40 seats on Penwith District Council were held on 6 May 1976, the same day as other local elections in the United Kingdom. The composition of the council remained largely unchanged: independent candidates won 38 seats, an increase of one, and Labour and the Liberal Party each won one seat unopposed in St Ives.

zh.s: 彭威斯区议会全部40席于1976年5月6日举行选举，与英国其他地方选举同日进行。议会组成大致没有变化：无党籍候选人赢得38席，比上次增加1席；工党和自由党则各有1名候选人在圣艾夫斯选区未经竞争当选。

en.s: The 1976 Plymouth City Council election took place on 6 May 1976 to elect members of Plymouth City Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. Voting took place across 22 wards, each electing 3 Councillors. The Conservative Party retained control of the Council after winning a majority of seats.

zh.s: 1976年普利茅斯市议会选举于5月6日举行，选出英格兰普利茅斯市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。全市22个选区各选出3名议员。保守党赢得多数席位，继续掌控议会。

en.s: Elections to Erewash Borough Council were held on 6 May 1976 as part of nationwide local elections. The election saw the Conservative Party gain control of the Council for the first time.

zh.t: 1976年埃雷沃什自治市议会选举
zh.s: 埃雷沃什自治市议会选举于1976年5月6日举行，是全国地方选举的一部分。保守党首次赢得该议会的控制权。

en.s: The 1976 Sunderland Metropolitan Borough Council election was held on 6 May 1976. A third of the seats on the Council were up for election, with each of the 26 council wards returning one councillor by first-past-the-post. The election was held on the same day as other local elections.

zh.t: 1976年桑德兰都市自治市议会选举
zh.s: 桑德兰都市自治市议会选举于1976年5月6日举行。议会三分之一席位进行改选，26个议会选区各按“先到先得”制选出1名议员。选举与其他地方选举同日举行。

en.s: The 1976 Derby Borough Council election took place on 6 May 1976 to elect members of Derby Borough Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. Voting took place across 18 wards, each electing 3 Councillors. The Conservative Party gained control of the council from the Labour Party.

zh.s: 1976年德比自治市议会选举于5月6日举行，选出英格兰德比自治市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。全市18个选区各选出3名议员。保守党从工党手中赢得议会控制权。

en.s: The 1976 Rochford District Council election took place on 6 May 1976 to elect members of Rochford District Council in Essex, England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 1976年罗奇福德区议会选举于5月6日举行，选出英格兰埃塞克斯郡罗奇福德区议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。

en.s: The 1976 Chelmsford Borough Council election took place on 6 May 1976 to elect members of Chelmsford Borough Council in Essex, England. This was on the same day as other local elections. The council was contested under new ward boundaries, but the number of seats remained the same.

zh.t: 1976年切姆斯福德自治市议会选举
zh.s: 1976年切姆斯福德自治市议会选举于5月6日举行，选出英格兰埃塞克斯郡切姆斯福德自治市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。选举按新的选区边界举行，但议席总数没有变化。

en.s: The 1976 Friuli earthquake, also known in Italy as Terremoto del Friuli (Friulian earthquake) and Orcolat ("big, bad ogre"), occurred on 6 May 1976, at 21:00:13 (20:00:13 UTC) with a moment magnitude of 6.5 and a maximum EMS intensity of X (very destructive). The shock occurred in the Friuli region in northeast Italy near the town of Gemona del Friuli. 990 people were killed, up to about 3,000 were injured, and more than 157,000 were left homeless.

zh.s: 1976年弗留利地震于1976年5月6日21时00分13秒发生（协调世界时20时00分13秒），震级为矩震级6.5级，最高烈度达到欧洲宏观地震烈度表X级（极具破坏性）。这次地震发生在意大利东北部弗留利地区，靠近杰莫纳德尔弗留利镇。地震造成990人死亡，约有多达3,000人受伤，超过157,000人无家可归。该地震在意大利也称Terremoto del Friuli（弗留利地震），在弗留利语中称Orcolat（意为“巨大的恶鬼”）。

en.s: The 1976 North Hertfordshire District Council election was held on 6 May 1976, at the same time as other local elections across England and Wales. All 48 seats on North Hertfordshire District Council were up for election. The election saw the Conservatives take a majority of the seats on the council, which had previously been under no overall control, being led by a Conservative minority administration.

zh.t: 1976年北赫特福德郡区议会选举
zh.s: 北赫特福德郡区议会选举于1976年5月6日举行，与英格兰和威尔士其他地方选举同日进行。北赫特福德郡区议会全部48席都进行改选。此前议会没有任何政党占据多数，由保守党少数派政府执政；这次保守党赢得多数席位。

en.s: Elections to Liverpool City Council were held on 6 May 1976. One third of the council was up for election and John Hamilton of the Labour Party became Council Leader albeit with no overall control of the council.

zh.s: 利物浦市议会选举于1976年5月6日举行，议会三分之一席位参加改选。工党人约翰·汉密尔顿成为议会领袖，但没有任何政党取得多数。

en.s: The 1976 Ipswich Borough Council election was the second election to the Ipswich Borough Council which had been established by the Local Government Act 1972 in England and Wales. It took place as part of the 1976 United Kingdom local elections. There were 14 wards returning between 2 and 5 councillors each. The Conservative Party gained control of the Council.

zh.t: 1976年伊普斯维奇自治市议会选举
zh.s: 1976年伊普斯维奇自治市议会选举是依据《1972年地方政府法》设立的新伊普斯维奇自治市议会举行的第二次选举，也是1976年英国地方选举的一部分。14个选区各选出2至5名议员。保守党赢得议会控制权。

en.s: Elections to Alnwick District Council were held on 6 of May 1976 alongside other local elections for Non-metropolitan district councils across England. Unlike the election of 1973, which was mainly fought between Independent politicians with a few wards being contested by Labour candidates, there were a few wards contested by Conservative and Liberal candidates this time around.

zh.s: 阿尼克区议会选举于1976年5月6日举行，与英格兰各地其他非都市区议会选举同日进行。与1973年主要由无党籍政治人物竞争、少数选区有工党候选人参选的选举不同，这次有一些选区也出现了保守党和自由党候选人。

en.s: The Flagstaff Hill incident was an international incident between the Republic of Ireland and the United Kingdom. It took place on the night of 5/6 May 1976 near Cornamucklagh, a townland just inside the Cooley Peninsula in the north of County Louth in the Republic of Ireland, when the Irish Army and Garda Síochána arrested eight British Special Air Service soldiers who had illegally crossed the Irish border.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 旗杆山事件是爱尔兰共和国和英国之间的一场国际事件。1976年5月5日至6日夜间，爱尔兰军队和爱尔兰警察在爱尔兰共和国劳斯郡北部库利半岛内的科纳穆克拉格镇地带，逮捕了8名非法越境的英国特种空勤团士兵。

en.s: The 1978 FA Cup final was an association football match between Arsenal and Ipswich Town on 6 May 1978 at the old Wembley Stadium, London. It was the final match of the 1977–78 FA Cup, the 97th season of the world's oldest football knockout competition, the FA Cup. Four-time winners Arsenal were appearing in their ninth final, whereas Ipswich Town were making their debut at Wembley and in their first FA Cup final.

zh.s: 1978年英格兰足总杯决赛于1978年5月6日在伦敦旧温布利球场举行，由阿森纳对阵伊普斯维奇镇。这是1977至1978赛季足总杯的决赛，也是这项世界上历史最悠久的足球淘汰赛的第97个赛季。曾四次夺冠的阿森纳第九次打入决赛；伊普斯维奇镇则首次在温布利球场亮相，也是首次进入足总杯决赛。

en.s: The 1978 Scottish Cup Final was played on 6 May 1978 at Hampden Park in Glasgow and was the final of the 93rd Scottish Cup. Aberdeen and Rangers contested the match, Rangers won the match 2–1 with a flying header from Alex MacDonald and a second from Derek Johnstone in the second half.

zh.s: 1978年苏格兰杯决赛于1978年5月6日在格拉斯哥汉普顿公园球场举行，是第93届苏格兰杯的决赛。阿伯丁对阵流浪者，流浪者以2比1获胜。亚历克斯·麦克唐纳以一记凌空头球破门，德里克·约翰斯通则在下半场攻入第二球。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Austria on 6 May 1979. The result was a victory for the Social Democratic Party, which won 95 of the 183 seats. Voter turnout was 92.2%.

zh.s: 奥地利于1979年5月6日举行议会选举。社会民主党获胜，在183个席位中赢得95席。投票率为92.2%。

en.s: The 1979 WFA Cup Final was the ninth final of the FA Women's Cup, England's primary cup competition for women's football teams. It was the ninth final to be held under the direct control of Women's Football Association (WFA). Southampton and Lowestoft contested the match at Jubilee Park, the home of Waterlooville F.C. on 6 May 1979. The match ended 1–0 in favour of Southampton.

zh.s: 1979年英格兰足总女子杯决赛是第9届决赛，也是英格兰女子足球队伍的主要杯赛决赛；这是女子足球协会直接管理下举行的第9届决赛。南安普敦队和洛斯托夫特队于1979年5月6日在水洛维尔足球俱乐部主场朱比利公园球场交锋，南安普敦以1比0获胜。

en.s: Elections to Liverpool City Council were held on 6 May 1980. Following boundary changes, the entire council was up for election (3 Councillors for each ward). The candidates with the highest number of votes in each ward were elected until 1984, the candidates with the second highest number of votes were elected until 1983 and the candidates with the third highest number of votes were elected until 1982.

zh.s: 利物浦市议会选举于1980年5月6日举行。由于选区边界调整，议会全部席位都进行改选，每个选区选出3名议员。各选区得票最高的候选人任期至1984年，得票第二的候选人任期至1983年，得票第三的候选人任期至1982年。

en.s: Regional elections were held in Scotland on Thursday 6 May 1982, as part of the wider 1982 United Kingdom local elections. Whilst the 1982 elections saw the Conservatives hold up relatively well in England, the Tories did comparatively poorly in Scotland, where their already disadvantageous position worsened. The Conservatives did particularly poorly in Strathclyde, where the Conservative group leader lost his seat. Despite this poor performance, the Conservatives were actually seen as doing somewhat well in the overall Scottish context; the Conservative vote had, prior to the election, been languishing around 18% in Scotland.

zh.s: 苏格兰地区选举于1982年5月6日星期四举行，是1982年英国地方选举的一部分。保守党在英格兰的表现尚可，但在苏格兰表现较差，原本就不利的处境进一步恶化。保守党在斯特拉斯克莱德表现尤其糟糕，党团领袖失去席位。尽管表现不佳，从苏格兰整体情况看，保守党仍被认为成绩尚可；选前该党在苏格兰的得票率一直徘徊在18%左右。

en.s: The 1982 Camden Council election took place on 6 May 1982 to elect members of Camden London Borough Council in London, England. The whole council was up for election. The election, like the election across the country, was marked by the emergence of the SDP–Liberal Alliance. However, despite winning 25% of the vote across Camden, no Alliance councillors were elected. Few seats changed hands overall, with the Conservatives gaining two seats from Labour in Bloomsbury in the south and losing one seat to Labour in West Hampstead and one in Highgate.

zh.s: 1982年卡姆登议会选举于5月6日举行，选出英格兰伦敦卡姆登伦敦自治市议会成员，全体议席都要改选。与全国其他地区一样，此次选举中社会民主党—自由党联盟开始崭露头角。该联盟在卡姆登赢得25%的选票，却没有议员当选。整体上只有少数席位易手：保守党在南部布卢姆斯伯里从工党手中赢得两席，之后又在西汉普斯特德和海格特各失去一席给工党。

en.s: The 1982 Welwyn Hatfield District Council election took place on 6 May 1982 to elect members of Welwyn Hatfield District Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. A third of the council's seats were up for election. The newly formed SDP–Liberal Alliance saw a huge improvement in their share of their vote compared to their predecessor, scoring over 20% of the vote; the highest percentage for a third party since the forming of the Welwyn Hatfield's council.

zh.t: 1982年韦林哈特菲尔德区议会选举
zh.s: 1982年韦林哈特菲尔德区议会选举于5月6日举行，选出英格兰韦林哈特菲尔德区议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。议会三分之一席位进行改选。新成立的社会民主党—自由党联盟得票率比其前身大幅上升，得票超过20%；这是韦林哈特菲尔德议会成立以来第三党取得的最高得票率。

en.s: The 1982 Thurrock Borough Council election took place on 6 May 1982 to elect members of Thurrock Borough Council in Essex, England. This was on the same day as other local elections in England. Labour regained control of the council from No overall control.

zh.s: 1982年瑟罗克自治市议会选举于5月6日举行，选出英格兰埃塞克斯郡瑟罗克自治市议会议员，与英格兰其他地方选举同日进行。工党从原本没有任何政党占据多数的状态中重新取得议会控制权。

en.s: The 1982 Stevenage Borough Council election took place on 6 May 1982. This was on the same day as other local elections. One third of the council was up for election and the Labour Party retained control of the council, which it had held continuously since its creation in 1973.

zh.t: 1982年史蒂文尼奇自治市议会选举
zh.s: 1982年史蒂文尼奇自治市议会选举于5月6日举行，与其他地方选举同日进行。议会三分之一席位进行改选。工党继续掌控议会；自该自治市于1973年设立以来，议会一直由工党控制。

en.s: Elections to the Adur District Council were held on 6 May 1982, with one third of the council up for election. There was additional vacancies in the Mash Barn and Peverel wards, but no elections for the single-member ward St Marys and Residents stronghold, Marine, which went uncontested. In the intervening years, the newly formed Alliance had gained three seats at the expense of the Conservatives.

zh.s: 阿杜尔区议会选举于1982年5月6日举行，议会三分之一席位进行改选。马什巴恩和佩弗雷尔选区另有空缺需要补选；圣玛丽单席选区和居民党票仓海洋选区没有举行选举，因为候选人未经竞争当选。在此期间，新成立的联盟党从保守党手中赢得3席。

en.s: The 1982 Epping Forest District Council election took place on 6 May 1982 to elect members of Epping Forest District Council in Essex, England. 19 members of Epping Forest District Council in Essex were elected. The council remained under Conservative majority control.

zh.s: 1982年埃平森林区议会选举于5月6日举行，选出英格兰埃塞克斯郡埃平森林区议会议员。埃塞克斯郡埃平森林区议会有19名议员当选，保守党继续以多数席位掌控议会。

en.s: The 1982 Southend-on-Sea Borough Council election took place on 6 May 1982 to elect members of Southend-on-Sea Borough Council in Essex, England. This was on the same day as other local elections.
