zh.s: 1982年滨海绍森德自治市议会选举于5月6日举行，选出英格兰埃塞克斯郡滨海绍森德自治市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。

en.s: The 1982 Rochford District Council election took place on 6 May 1982 to elect members of Rochford District Council in Essex, England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 1982年罗奇福德区议会选举于5月6日举行，选出英格兰埃塞克斯郡罗奇福德区议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。

en.s: The third election to Fife Regional Council was held on 6 May 1982 as part of the wider 1982 Scottish regional elections. The election saw Labour maintaining their control of the region's 46-seat council.

zh.s: 法夫大区议会第三次选举于1982年5月6日举行，是1982年苏格兰大区选举的一部分。工党继续掌控该区46席的议会。

en.s: The third election to the Western Isles Islands Council was held on 6 May 1982 as part of the wider 1982 Scottish regional elections. All candidates stood as Independents. Of the councils 30 councillors, 19 were elected unopposed. Five incumbent councillors were defeated in the election, including Education Committee Chair Kathleen Macaskill.

zh.s: 西部群岛议会第三次选举于1982年5月6日举行，是1982年苏格兰大区选举的一部分。所有候选人均以无党籍身份参选。议会30名议员中有19人未经竞争当选。5名现任议员在选举中落败，其中包括教育委员会主席凯瑟琳·麦克阿斯基尔。

en.s: The 1982 York City Council election took place on 6 May 1982 to elect members of York City Council in North Yorkshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 1982年约克市议会选举于5月6日举行，选出英格兰北约克郡约克市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。

en.s: The 1982 Wirral Metropolitan Borough Council election took place on 6 May 1982 to elect members of Wirral Metropolitan Borough Council in England. This election was held on the same day as other local elections. The second third of the council was up for election to new boundaries.

zh.t: 1982年威勒尔都市自治市议会选举
zh.s: 1982年威勒尔都市自治市议会选举于5月6日举行，选出英格兰威勒尔都市自治市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。议会三分之二的席位按新的选区边界进行改选。

en.s: Local government elections took place in London, and some other parts of the United Kingdom on Thursday 6 May 1982. Ward changes took place in Enfield which increased the total number of councillors by 6 from 1,908 to 1,914. All London borough council seats were up for election. Both major parties lost votes to the SDP-Liberal Alliance, but whilst the Conservatives gained 20 council seats, Labour lost 101.

zh.s: 伦敦及英国部分其他地区的地方政府选举于1982年5月6日（星期四）举行。恩菲尔德的选区调整使议员总数增加6人，从1,908人增至1,914人。伦敦所有自治市议会席位都进行改选。两大政党都失去部分选票，转投社会民主党—自由党联盟；保守党增加20个议会席位，工党则失去101席。

en.s: The 1982 Bath City Council election was held on Thursday 6 May 1982 to elect councillors to Bath City Council in England. It took place on the same day as other district council elections in the United Kingdom. One third of seats were up for election. Two seats were contested in Lambridge due to an extra vacancy occurring.

zh.s: 巴斯市议会选举于1982年5月6日（星期四）举行，选出英格兰巴斯市议会议员，与英国其他区议会选举同日进行。议会三分之一席位进行改选。兰布里奇选区因新增一个空缺，本次有两个席位参加选举。

en.s: The 1982 Basildon District Council election took place on 6 May 1982 to elect members of Basildon District Council in Essex, England. This was on the same day as other local elections. One third of the council was up for election; the seats of the candidates who finished second in each ward in the all-out election of 1979.

zh.s: 1982年巴西尔登区议会选举于5月6日举行，选出英格兰埃塞克斯郡巴西尔登区议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。议会三分之一席位进行改选，参选席位由1979年全体改选中各选区得票第二的候选人所占席位构成。

en.s: The 1982 Derby City Council election took place on 6 May 1982 to elect members of Derby City Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. 15 of the council's 44 seats were up for election. The Labour Party retained control of the council.

zh.s: 1982年德比市议会选举于5月6日举行，选出英格兰德比市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。议会44席中有15席参加改选，工党继续掌控议会。

en.s: The 1982 Cambridge City Council election took place on 6 May 1982 to elect members of Cambridge City Council in Cambridge, Cambridgeshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England.

zh.s: 1982年剑桥市议会选举于5月6日举行，选出英格兰剑桥郡剑桥市议会议员，与英格兰各地其他地方选举同日进行。

en.s: The 1982 Chester City Council election took place on 6 May 1982 to elect members of Chester City Council in Cheshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 1982年切斯特市议会选举于5月6日举行，选出英格兰柴郡切斯特市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。

en.s: The 1982 Harlow District Council election took place on 6 May 1982 to elect members of Harlow District Council in Essex, England. This was on the same day as other local elections. The Labour Party retained control of the council.

zh.s: 1982年哈洛区议会选举于5月6日举行，选出英格兰埃塞克斯郡哈洛区议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。工党继续掌控议会。

en.s: Elections to Barnsley Metropolitan Borough Council were held on 6 May 1982, with one third of the council up for election with an additional vacancy in Royston. Prior to the election, Labour had gained a seat from Residents in a Dodsworth by-election, with another Residents councillor in Wombwell North defecting to the Labour grouping, offsetting a by-election loss in Penistone East to the recently formed SDP-Liberal Alliance.

zh.t: 1982年巴恩斯利都市自治市议会选举
zh.s: 巴恩斯利都市自治市议会选举于1982年5月6日举行，议会三分之一席位参加改选，罗伊斯顿选区另有一个空缺。在选举前，工党通过多兹沃思选区补选从居民党手中赢得1席；沃姆韦尔北选区另有一名居民党议员转投工党党团。这抵消了工党在彭尼斯顿东选区补选中输给新成立的社会民主党—自由党联盟的席位。

en.s: An election to the Highland Regional Council was held on 6 May 1982 as part of the wider 1982 Scottish regional elections. The election saw Independents win control of 42 of the council's 52 seats.

zh.s: 高地大区议会选举于1982年5月6日举行，是1982年苏格兰大区选举的一部分。无党籍议员赢得议会52席中的42席，继续掌控议会。

en.t: 1982 Tower Hamlets London Borough Council election
en.s: Elections to Tower Hamlets London Borough Council were held on Thursday 6 May 1982. The whole council was up for election. Turnout was 30.6%.

zh.t: 1982年塔村伦敦自治市议会选举
zh.s: 塔村伦敦自治市议会选举于1982年5月6日（星期四）举行，议会全部席位都进行改选。投票率为30.6%。

en.s: The 1982 election to the Grampian Regional Council took place on 6 May 1982, as part of the wider 1982 Scottish regional elections. The election saw the Conservatives maintaining their dominance of the 54 seat Council, albeit with a reduced presence.

zh.s: 格兰扁大区议会选举于1982年5月6日举行，是1982年苏格兰大区选举的一部分。保守党继续主导该区54席的议会，但席位有所减少。

en.s: The 1982 City of Lincoln Council election took place on 6 May 1982. This was on the same day as other local elections. One third of the council was up for election: the seats of the second-highest polling candidates at the all out election of 1979. The Labour Party gained control of the council from the Conservative Party.

zh.s: 1982年林肯市议会选举于5月6日举行，与其他地方选举同日进行。议会三分之一席位进行改选，参选席位由1979年全体改选中各选区得票第二的候选人所占席位构成。工党从保守党手中赢得议会控制权。

en.t: 1982 Dumfries and Galloway Regional Council election
en.s: The third Dumfries and Galloway Regional Council election was held on 6 May 1982. This was the first time the Liberals and the SDP contested the regional election in Dumfries and Galloway. The Conservatives remained behind to the independents, even though they lost one of their seats. Labour managed to increase their seats while their vote share declined.

zh.t: 1982年邓弗里斯-加洛韦大区议会选举
zh.s: 邓弗里斯-加洛韦大区议会第三次选举于1982年5月6日举行。这是自由党和社会民主党首次参加该区大区议会选举。保守党失去1席，但仍排在无党籍议员之后。工党席位增加，尽管其得票率下降。

en.s: The third election to Central Regional Council was held on 6 May 1982 as part of the wider 1982 Scottish regional elections.

zh.s: 中央大区议会第三次选举于1982年5月6日举行，是1982年苏格兰大区选举的一部分。

en.s: The 1982 North Hertfordshire District Council election was held on 6 May 1982, at the same time as other local elections across England and Scotland. There were 16 out of 50 seats on North Hertfordshire District Council up for election, being the usual third of the council. Only one seat changed party, being a Conservative win from Labour in Letchworth South East ward.

zh.t: 1982年北赫特福德郡区议会选举
zh.s: 北赫特福德郡区议会选举于1982年5月6日举行，与英格兰和苏格兰其他地方选举同日进行。北赫特福德郡区议会50席中有16席参加改选，即通常改选的三分之一席位。只有1个席位发生政党轮替：保守党在莱奇沃思东南选区从工党手中赢得席位。

en.s: Elections to Strathclyde Regional Council were held on Thursday 6 May 1982, on the same day as the eight other Scottish regional elections. This was the third election to the regional council following the local government reforms in the 1970s. The election was the first to use the 103 electoral divisions created by the Initial Reviews of Electoral Arrangements in 1978.

zh.t: 1982年斯特拉斯克莱德大区议会选举
zh.s: 斯特拉斯克莱德大区议会选举于1982年5月6日（星期四）举行，与苏格兰其他8个大区选举同日进行。这是1970年代地方政府改革后该大区议会举行的第三次选举，也是首次按1978年选区安排初步审查所设立的103个选区进行选举。

en.s: Elections to Liverpool City Council were held on 6 May 1982. One third of the council was up for election.

zh.s: 利物浦市议会选举于1982年5月6日举行，议会三分之一席位参加改选。

en.s: Local elections were held in the United Kingdom in 1982. The elections coincided with rising popularity of the Conservative government and Prime Minister Margaret Thatcher, which was mostly attributed to the Falklands War. The projected share of the vote was Conservatives 40%, Labour 29%, Liberal-SDP Alliance 27%. Elections were held in several English boroughs, including all those in London.

zh.s: 1982年，英国举行地方选举。保守党政府和首相玛格丽特·撒切尔的支持率有所上升，这主要被归因于福克兰群岛战争。预计得票率为：保守党40%、工党29%、自由党—社会民主党联盟27%。英格兰多个自治市举行了选举，其中包括伦敦所有自治市。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: Elections to Southwark Council were held in May 1982. The whole council was up for election. Turnout was 30.5%.

zh.t: 1982年萨瑟克伦敦自治市议会选举
zh.s: 萨瑟克议会选举于1982年5月举行，议会全部席位都进行改选。投票率为30.5%。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 1982 Ipswich Borough Council election was the second election to the Ipswich Borough Council under the system of electing by thirds, whereby a third of the councillors were to stand for election, each time. These new arrangements had been determined by the Local Government Boundary Commission as laid out in their Report 280. It took place as part of the 1982 United Kingdom local elections.

zh.t: 1982年伊普斯维奇自治市议会选举
zh.s: 1982年伊普斯维奇自治市议会选举是该议会按三分之一席位轮流改选制度举行的第二次选举，即每次改选三分之一议员。新的选举安排由地方政府边界委员会根据第280号报告制定。选举是1982年英国地方选举的一部分。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: Island council elections were held in the Netherlands Antilles on 29 April (ABC islands) and 6 May 1983 (SSS islands) to elect the members of the island councils of its six island territories. The election was won by the People's Electoral Movement (13 seats) in Aruba, the Bonaire Democratic Party (5 seats) in Bonaire, the New Antilles Movement (8 seats) in Curaçao, the Windward Islands People's Movement (4 seats) in Saba, the Democratic Party Statia (3 seats) in Sint Eustatius, and the Democratic Party (5 seats) in Sint Maarten.

zh.t: 1983年荷属安的列斯群岛岛屿议会选举
zh.s: 荷属安的列斯群岛岛屿议会选举分两天举行：ABC群岛于4月29日投票，SSS群岛于1983年5月6日投票，选出六个岛屿领地的议会议员。选举中，人民选举运动在阿鲁巴赢得13席，博内尔民主党在博内尔赢得5席，新安的列斯运动在库拉索赢得8席，向风群岛人民运动在萨巴赢得4席，民主党在圣尤斯特歇斯赢得3席，民主党在圣马丁赢得5席。

en.s: The Republic of Panama held a general election on 6 May 1984, electing both a new President of the Republic and a new Legislative Assembly.

zh.s: 巴拿马共和国于1984年5月6日举行大选，选出新总统和新一届立法议会。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 1984 WFA Cup Final was the 14th final of the WFA Cup, England's primary cup competition for women's football teams. The showpiece event was played under the auspices of the Women's Football Association (WFA). Howbury Grange and Doncaster Belles contested the match at Sincil Bank, the home stadium of Lincoln City on 6 May 1984. Howbury Grange won 4–2.

zh.s: 1984年英格兰足总女子杯决赛是第14届决赛，也是英格兰女子足球队伍的主要杯赛决赛，由女子足球协会主办。豪伯里格兰奇队和唐卡斯特贝尔斯队于1984年5月6日在林肯城主场辛西尔银行球场交锋，豪伯里格兰奇以4比2获胜。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in El Salvador on 25 March 1984, with a second round on 6 May. A new president was elected, together with a vice president, for a five-year term. The result was a victory for José Napoleón Duarte of the Christian Democratic Party. The elections were held under military rule amidst high levels of repression and violence, and candidates to the left of Duarte's brand of Christian Democrats were excluded from participating.
en.n: This entry records the second round, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.t: 1984年萨尔瓦多总统选举第二轮
zh.s: 萨尔瓦多总统选举于1984年3月25日举行首轮投票，第二轮于5月6日举行。选民选出新总统和副总统，任期五年。基督教民主党候选人何塞·拿破仑·杜阿尔特获胜。选举在军政府统治期间举行，当时镇压和暴力事件频发，政治立场比杜阿尔特所属基督教民主党更偏左的候选人被排除在选举之外。
zh.n: 本条记录的是源信息框标注的第二轮投票日期。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 1987 South African general election was held on 6 May 1987. The State of Emergency existing in South Africa at that time cast a cloud over the elections. It was once again won by the National Party (NP) under the leadership of P. W. Botha, although for the first time it faced serious opposition from the right of the South African political spectrum. The right-wing opposition came in the form of the Conservative Party (CP), which opposed even the limited powersharing with Indian and Coloured South Africans that had been implemented by the NP as part of a package of constitutional reforms in 1984.

zh.s: 1987年南非大选于5月6日举行。当时南非正处于紧急状态，给选举蒙上阴影。博塔领导的国民党（NP）再次胜选，但首次遭到来自政治右翼的有力挑战。右翼反对派是保守党（CP），该党甚至反对国民党在1984年宪法改革方案中实施的、与印度裔和有色人种南非人有限度分享权力的安排。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 1987 Black Dragon fire, also known as the 1987 Daxing'anling wildfire (Chinese: 大兴安岭特大森林火灾), was the deadliest forest fire in the People's Republic of China. The fire broke out in Daxing'anling Prefecture, Heilongjiang, on May 6, 1987. It also spread into the Soviet Union. The burning lasted almost a month, when it was finally stopped on June 2, 1987.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1987年黑龙火灾也称1987年大兴安岭森林大火，是中华人民共和国伤亡最惨重的森林火灾。火灾于1987年5月6日在黑龙江省大兴安岭地区爆发，还蔓延至苏联。大火持续近一个月，最终于1987年6月2日扑灭。
zh.n: 本条记录的是源信息框标注的事件开始日期。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: Widerøe Flight 710, also known as the Torghatten Accident (Norwegian: Torghatten-ulykken), was a controlled flight into terrain into the mountain of Torghatten in Brønnøy Municipality, Norway. The Widerøe-operated de Havilland Canada Dash 7 crashed on 6 May 1988 at 20:29:30 during approach to Brønnøysund Airport. All thirty-six people on board LN-WFN were killed; the crash remains the deadliest accident involving the Dash 7 and the deadliest in Northern Norway.

zh.t: 维德罗航空710号班机空难
zh.s: 维德罗航空710号班机空难也称托尔加滕事故（挪威语：Torghatten-ulykken），是一宗飞行可控但撞向地形的事故。1988年5月6日20时29分30秒，维德罗航空一架德哈维兰加拿大Dash 7客机在飞往布伦讷于机场、进场降落时，撞上挪威布伦讷于市政区内的托尔加滕山。机上36人全部遇难。这是Dash 7机型伤亡最惨重的事故，也是挪威北部最严重的空难。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current lead via MediaWiki API

en.s: Operation Conservation was a British Army attempt to ambush a large Provisional Irish Republican Army (IRA) unit along the Dorsey Enclosure, between Cullyhanna and Silverbridge, in south County Armagh. The action took place on 6 May 1990. The operation was uncovered and thwarted by the IRA South Armagh Brigade.

zh.s: 「保护行动」是英国陆军的一次行动，计划在南阿马郡库利汉纳和西尔弗布里奇之间的多尔西围场伏击一支爱尔兰共和军临时派别的大部队。行动于1990年5月6日进行，被爱尔兰共和军南阿马旅发现并挫败。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.t: 1992 Argyll and Bute District Council election
en.s: Elections to Argyll and Bute Council were held in May 1992, the same day as the other Scottish local government elections. The election was the last for the Argyll and Bute District Council, as the council would be replaced with the Argyll and Bute unitary authority for the 1995 election.

zh.t: 1992年阿盖尔-比特郡区议会选举
zh.s: 阿盖尔-比特议会选举于1992年5月举行，与苏格兰其他地方政府选举同日进行。这是阿盖尔-比特郡区议会举行的最后一次选举；1995年选举时，该议会将由阿盖尔-比特单一层级政府取代。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 1992 European Cup Winners' Cup Final was a football match contested between Monaco of France and Werder Bremen of Germany (who qualified for the tournament through the West German berth). It was the final match of the 1991–92 European Cup Winners' Cup and the 32nd European Cup Winners' Cup final. The final was held at Estádio da Luz in Lisbon.

zh.s: 1992年欧洲优胜者杯决赛由法国摩纳哥队对阵德国云达不来梅队，决出1991至1992赛季欧洲优胜者杯冠军。这是该赛事第32届决赛。云达不来梅通过西德名额获得参赛资格。决赛在里斯本光明球场举行。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 1993 Avon County Council election took place on 6 May 1993 to elect members of Avon County Council in England. This was on the same day as other nationwide local elections. The Liberal Democrats made a number of gains, mainly at the expense of the Conservatives. Labour remained the largest group on the council, but were 6 seats short of gaining a majority. This was the last election for Avon County, which was abolished in 1996 and replaced with four new unitary authorities: Bath and North East Somerset, Bristol, North Somerset and South Gloucestershire.

zh.s: 1993年埃文郡议会选举于5月6日举行，选出英格兰埃文郡议会成员，与全国其他地方选举同日进行。自由民主党获得若干席位，主要是从保守党手中赢得。工党仍是议会最大党，但距离多数席位还差6席。这是埃文郡的最后一次选举；该郡于1996年撤销，并由巴斯和东北萨默塞特、布里斯托尔、北萨默塞特及南格洛斯特郡四个单一层级地方政府取代。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The Newbury by-election, in West Berkshire, England, was held on 6 May 1993 after Conservative Member of Parliament (MP) Judith Chaplin died, after only being elected the previous year. It was won by David Rendel of the Liberal Democrats with an impressive swing of 28.4%, and well over twice as many votes as the Conservative candidate. However, as with other by-elections, turnout was lower than at the general election at 71.3%. The by-election in Newbury was the first by-election of the 1992–1997 parliament, and the first in a string of by-election losses for the Conservative Party who were in their fourth consecutive term of office.

zh.s: 英格兰西伯克郡纽伯里选区于1993年5月6日举行补选，原因是保守党议员Judith Chaplin去世；她在前一年才当选。自由民主党候选人David Rendel以28.4个百分点的摇摆幅度胜选，得票数超过保守党候选人的两倍。但与其他补选一样，投票率低于大选，为71.3%。这是1992—1997年议会任期内的首次补选，也是保守党接连在补选中失利的开端；该党当时已连续执政四届。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: Elections to Wiltshire County Council were held on 6 May 1993. The whole council was up for election and the result was no overall control, with the Liberal Democrats as the largest party. This resulted in a no-party-control shared administration for the first year of the Council, with the three main party groups being briefed on a coequal basis. Following a by-election gain by the Liberal Democrats from the Conservatives, giving the Liberal Democrats exactly half the seats on the Council, a Liberal Democrat administration was formed, but with a convention that committee chairpersons would not use their casting vote to force through policies.

zh.s: 威尔特郡郡议会选举于1993年5月6日举行，全体议席都要改选。选举后议会无人占多数，自由民主党是最大党。第一年由各党共同参与、不设党派控制的联合行政班子执政。自由民主党随后在补选中从保守党手中赢得一席，达到议会席位总数的一半，于是组建自由民主党政府；但各委员会主席约定不使用决定票强行通过政策。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 1993 Nottinghamshire County Council election was held on Thursday, 6 May 1993. The whole council of eighty-eight members was up for election and the result was that the Labour Party retained control of the Council, increasing its number of councillors to fifty-eight. The Conservatives suffered a net loss of ten seats and won twenty-four councillors. The Liberal Democrats won six seats.

zh.s: 诺丁汉郡郡议会选举于1993年5月6日星期四举行，全体88席都要改选。工党继续控制议会，席位增加至58席。保守党净失去10席，赢得24席；自由民主党赢得6席。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 1993 Lincolnshire County Council election was held on Thursday, 6 May 1993. The whole council of 76 members was up for election and the election resulted in no party winning an overall majority of seats on the council. The Conservative Party lost control of the council for the first time since 1973, winning 31 seats.

zh.s: 1993年林肯郡议会选举于5月6日（星期四）举行，议会全部76个席位都进行改选。选举后没有政党获得议会多数席位。保守党自1973年以来首次失去对议会的控制，赢得31席。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: Local elections to Northumberland County Council, a county council in the north east of England, were held on 6 May 1993, resulting in a council with Labour members forming a majority.

zh.s: 英格兰东北部诺森伯兰郡议会地方选举于1993年5月6日举行，结果是工党议员组成多数派。

en.s: Elections to Hertfordshire County Council were held on 6 May 1993, at the same time as other elections to county councils across England and Wales. All 77 seats on the county council were up for election. The Conservatives lost control of the council to no overall control, with Labour forming the largest political group. Prior to the election the Conservative group leader, Iris Tarry, was leader of the council, having held that position since 1989.

zh.s: 赫特福德郡议会选举于1993年5月6日举行，与英格兰和威尔士其他郡议会选举同日进行。议会全部77席都进行改选。保守党失去多数，议会转为没有任何政党占据多数，工党成为议会中最大的政治团体。选举前，保守党党团领袖艾丽丝·塔里担任议会领袖，她自1989年以来一直担任这一职务。

en.s: Elections to Cornwall County Council were held on 6 May 1993, as part of the wider 1993 local elections. The Liberal Democrats gained control of the council, which had previously been under no overall control.

zh.s: 康沃尔郡议会选举于1993年5月6日举行，是1993年地方选举的一部分。自由民主党赢得议会控制权，此前议会没有任何政党占据多数。

en.s: Elections to Cumbria County Council were held on 6 May 1993. This was on the same day as other UK county council elections. The whole council of 83 members was up for election and the council remained under no overall control.

zh.s: 坎布里亚郡议会选举于1993年5月6日举行，与英国其他郡议会选举同日进行。议会全部83个席位都进行改选，选后仍没有任何政党占据多数。

en.s: The 1993 United Kingdom local elections were held on Thursday 6 May 1993 in England and Wales, and Wednesday 19 May 1993 in Northern Ireland. The results showed a decline for the governing Conservative Party, who were still reeling from the fallout of Black Wednesday; with the third-placed party, the Liberal Democrats, gaining most seats.

zh.s: 1993年英国地方选举于5月6日（星期四）在英格兰和威尔士举行，北爱尔兰则于5月19日（星期三）投票。执政的保守党表现下滑，当时该党仍受到“黑色星期三”事件的影响；排名第三的自由民主党赢得了最多席位。

en.s: The 1993 Essex County Council election took place on 6 May 1993 to elect members of Essex County Council in Essex, England. It was held on the same day as other local elections. 98 councillors were elected from various electoral divisions, which returned either one or two county councillors each by first-past-the-post voting for a four-year term of office.

zh.s: 1993年埃塞克斯郡议会选举于5月6日举行，选出英格兰埃塞克斯郡议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。各选区按“先到先得”制选出1名或2名郡议员，任期四年，共有98名议员当选。

en.s: Local elections in Wales were held on 6 May 1993 to elect members to the eight county councils. They were held alongside other local elections in the United Kingdom. The previous elections to the second-level districts of the counties were held in 1991, while the previous election to the counties were held in 1989.

zh.s: 威尔士地方选举于1993年5月6日举行，选出8个郡议会的议员，与英国其他地方选举同日进行。上一次郡内第二级行政区选举在1991年举行，郡议会选举则于1989年举行。

en.s: The 1993 Dorset County Council election was held on 6 May 1993, on the same day as other county council elections. A legal challenge to the result was lodged for the Lytchett division of North Dorset. Conservative candidate Commander Harry Selby-Bennett won 1,315 votes while Liberal Democrat candidate, Peter Gainsford had 1,314 votes. The result was void by the High Court.

zh.s: 多塞特郡议会选举于1993年5月6日举行，与其他郡议会选举同日进行。北多塞特郡利切特选区的选举结果受到法律挑战。保守党候选人、海军司令哈里·塞尔比-贝内特获得1,315票，自由民主党候选人彼得·盖恩斯福德获得1,314票。高等法院后来宣布选举结果无效。

en.s: The 1993 Berkshire County Council election was held on 6 May 1993, at the same time as other local elections across England and Wales. All of Berkshire County Council's 76 seats were up for election. Prior to the election, the county council had been under no overall control, with a coalition of Labour, the Liberal Democrats and independents running the authority.

zh.s: 1993年伯克郡郡议会选举于5月6日举行，与英格兰和威尔士其他地方选举同日进行。伯克郡郡议会全部76席都进行改选。选举前，议会没有任何政党占据多数，由工党、自由民主党和无党籍议员组成的联盟执政。

en.s: The 1993 Suffolk County Council election was held on 6 May 1993 to elect members of Suffolk County Council in Suffolk, England. It was held on the same day as other local elections. 80 councillors were elected from various electoral divisions, which returned one county councillor each by first-past-the-post voting for a four-year term of office.

zh.s: 1993年萨福克郡议会选举于5月6日举行，选出英格兰萨福克郡议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。各选区按“先到先得”制选出1名郡议员，任期四年，共有80名议员当选。

en.s: The Channel Tunnel (French: Tunnel sous la Manche), sometimes referred to as the Chunnel, is a 50.46-kilometre (31.35-mile) railway tunnel beneath the English Channel which connects Folkestone in the United Kingdom with Coquelles in northern France. Opened in 1994, it remains the only fixed link between Great Britain and the European mainland.

zh.s: 英吉利海峡隧道（法语：Tunnel sous la Manche），有时也称“海峡隧道”，是一条长50.46公里（31.35英里）的铁路隧道，穿过英吉利海峡，连接英国福克斯通和法国北部的科凯勒。隧道于1994年开通，至今仍是连接大不列颠岛与欧洲大陆的唯一固定通道。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; Chinese Events calendar and English linked-topic occurrence evidence

en.s: The 1995 Dallas mayoral election took place on May 6, 1995, to elect the mayor of Dallas, Texas. The race was officially nonpartisan. Ron Kirk won the election, taking a majority in the initial round of voting, thereby negating the need for a runoff to be held.

zh.s: 1995年达拉斯市长选举于1995年5月6日举行。选举正式上为无党派选举。朗·柯克在首轮投票中取得多数票并赢得选举，因此不需要举行第二轮投票。

en.s: K-1 Grand Prix '96 was a kickboxing event promoted by the K-1 organization. It was the fourth K-1 World Grand Prix final involving eight of the world's best heavyweight fighters (+95 kg/209 lbs), with all bouts fought under K-1 Rules. The eight finalists had all almost qualified via elimination fights at the K-1 Grand Prix '96 Opening Battle event. The only absentee was Stan Longinidis who was unable to participate in the tournament due to injury - he was replaced by reservist Duane Van Der Merwe. As well as tournament bouts there were also two 'Super Fights' fought under K-1 Rules.

zh.s: K-1世界大奖赛96是由K-1组织主办的一场踢拳赛事。这是第四届K-1世界大奖赛决赛，共有八名世界顶尖重量级选手（95公斤以上／209磅以上）参赛，所有比赛均按K-1规则进行。八名决赛选手几乎都通过K-1世界大奖赛96开幕战的淘汰赛获得资格。唯一缺席的是Stan Longinidis，他因伤无法参赛，由候补选手Duane Van Der Merwe替补。除锦标赛比赛外，赛事还安排了两场按K-1规则进行的「超级战」。

en.s: The 1998 UEFA Cup final was a football match played at Parc des Princes in Paris, France on 6 May 1998 as the conclusion to the 1997–98 UEFA Cup. It was the first time that the UEFA Cup final was played as a single leg at a neutral venue. The match was played between two Italian teams – Lazio and Internazionale, commonly known as Inter.

zh.s: 1998年欧洲联盟杯决赛于1998年5月6日在法国巴黎王子公园球场举行，为1997至1998赛季欧洲联盟杯的收官战。这是欧洲联盟杯决赛首次在中立场地以单场决胜的方式举行。对阵双方都是意大利球队：拉齐奥和国际米兰（通常简称“国米”）。

en.s: The 1998 Cupa României final was the 60th final of Romania's most prestigious cup competition. The final was played at the Stadionul Naţional in Bucharest on 6 May 1998 and was contested between Divizia A sides Rapid București and Universitatea Craiova. The cup was won by Rapid.

zh.s: 1998年罗马尼亚杯决赛是罗马尼亚最高级别杯赛的第60届决赛，于1998年5月6日在布加勒斯特国家体育场举行。参赛双方是甲级联赛球队布加勒斯特快速队和克拉约瓦大学队，最终快速队夺冠。

en.s: The Eritrean–Ethiopian War, also known as the Badme War, was a major armed conflict between Ethiopia and Eritrea that took place from May 6, 1998 to June 18, 2000. After Eritrea gained independence from Ethiopia in 1993, relations were initially friendly. However, disagreements about where the newly created international border should be caused relations to deteriorate significantly, eventually leading to full-scale war.

zh.t: 厄立特里亚—埃塞俄比亚战争
zh.s: 厄立特里亚—埃塞俄比亚战争又称巴德梅战争，是埃塞俄比亚与厄立特里亚之间的一场大规模武装冲突，始于1998年5月6日，至2000年6月18日结束。厄立特里亚于1993年脱离埃塞俄比亚独立后，两国关系起初友好，但双方在新设国际边界的位置上存在分歧，关系显著恶化，最终演变为全面战争。

en.s: The first National Assembly for Wales elections were held on 6 May 1999. The overall turnout of voters was 46.3%. Although Welsh Labour were the biggest party, they did not gain enough seats to form a majority government and instead entered into coalition with the Liberal Democrats. The election was marked by the historically high level of support for Plaid Cymru, who won their highest share of the vote in any Wales-wide election and, as of 2011, their highest number of seats in an Assembly election to date.

zh.s: 首届威尔士国民议会选举于1999年5月6日举行，整体投票率为46.3%。威尔士工党是最大党，但席位不足以单独组建多数政府，之后与自由民主党联合执政。威尔士党获得了历史上较高的支持率，在全威尔士范围的选举中得票率创下新高；截至2011年，该党在议会选举中的席位数也创下新高。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: Elections to Sheffield City Council were held on 6 May 1999. One third of the council was up for election. Previous to this election, there had been a by-election in Park, resulting in a Liberal Democrat gain from Labour, effectively cancelling out the concurrent defection of sitting Stocksbridge councillor Alan Pears from the Lib Dems to Labour. The election seen the Liberal Democrats gain control of the council - the first time since its formation not to be controlled by Labour. The results themselves were more favourable to Labour than recent elections. However, they suffered double-digit losses with the Liberal Democrats sustaining their recent election surges.

zh.s: 谢菲尔德市议会选举于1999年5月6日举行，议会通常应改选的三分之一席位在此次选举中改选。此前，帕克选区补选由自由民主党从工党手中赢得一席，基本抵消了斯托克斯布里奇选区现任议员Alan Pears从自由民主党转投工党的影响。自由民主党此次赢得议会控制权，这是该议会成立以来首次不由工党控制。工党的结果比近期选举有所好转，但仍遭遇两位数的席位损失；自由民主党则延续了近期的选举上升势头。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 1999 elections to Argyll and Bute Council were held on the 6 May 1999 and were the second for the unitary authority, which was created under the Local Government etc (Scotland) Act 1994 and replaced the previous two-tier system of local government under Strathclyde Regional Council and Dumbarton and Argyll & Bute District Councils. It was held on the same day as the first Scottish Parliament election and resulted in no change to the administration of the council - independent control.

zh.s: 阿盖尔和比特议会选举于1999年5月6日举行，是该单一层级议会成立后的第二次选举。该议会根据《1994年苏格兰地方政府等法案》设立，取代了斯特拉斯克莱德地区议会以及邓巴顿区和阿盖尔-比特区议会组成的两级地方政府体系。选举与首届苏格兰议会选举同日举行，议会仍由独立议员控制，执政安排没有变化。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 1999 Bristol City Council election took place on 6 May 1999, on the same day as other local elections. All seats were up for election due to boundary changes, with each ward electing 2 councillors. The total number of seats on the council increased by 2 due to the creation of a new ward: Clifton East. Despite losing seats to both the Liberal Democrats and the Conservatives, the Labour Party maintained control of the council with a slim overall majority.

zh.s: 布里斯托尔市议会选举于1999年5月6日举行，与其他地方选举同日进行。由于选区边界调整，全体席位都要改选，每个选区选出两名议员。新增克利夫顿东选区后，议会席位增加两席。工党虽然失去若干席位给自由民主党和保守党，仍以微弱多数继续控制议会。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: Elections to Manchester Council were held on Thursday, 6 May 1999. One third of the council was up for election, as well as a vacancy in Chorlton, with each successful candidate to serve a four-year term of office, expiring in 2003. The two Independent Labour candidates stood as "Peace 2000 England's Republic", a slight alteration on the previous year's "Labour Peace 2000". Overall turnout was up marginally from the previous year at 21.9%. The Labour Party retained overall control of the Council.

zh.s: 曼彻斯特市议会选举于1999年5月6日星期四举行。议会通常应改选的三分之一席位及乔尔顿选区的一个空缺席位同时改选，当选者任期四年，至2003年届满。两名独立工党候选人以「和平2000英格兰共和国」名义参选，名称只是略微改动了上一年的「工党和平2000」。整体投票率为21.9%，略高于上一年。工党继续控制议会。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The first election to the devolved Scottish Parliament, to fill 129 seats, took place on 6 May 1999. Following the election, the Labour Party and the Liberal Democrats formed the Scottish Executive, with Labour Member of the Scottish Parliament (MSP) Donald Dewar becoming First Minister. The Scottish Parliament was created after a referendum on devolution took place on 11 September 1997 in which 74.3% of those who voted approved the idea. The Scotland Act (1998) was then passed by the UK Parliament which established the devolved Scottish Parliament and Scottish Executive.

zh.s: 首届权力下放后的苏格兰议会选举于1999年5月6日举行，共选出129名议员。选举后，工党和自由民主党组建苏格兰行政院，工党议员Donald Dewar出任首席部长。1997年9月11日举行的权力下放公投中，74.3%的投票者支持设立议会。随后英国议会通过《1998年苏格兰法》，设立权力下放后的苏格兰议会和苏格兰行政院。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: Local elections took place in much of the United Kingdom on 6 May 1999. All Scottish and Welsh unitary authorities had all their seats elected. In England a third of the seats on each of the Metropolitan Boroughs were elected along with elections in many of the unitary authorities and district councils. There were no local elections in Northern Ireland. The elections saw Labour, now in their second year of government, suffer a setback as the opposition Conservatives gained ground.

zh.s: 英国大部分地区于1999年5月6日举行地方选举。苏格兰和威尔士的所有单一层级地方政府全体改选；英格兰各大都会自治市议会改选三分之一席位，许多单一层级地方政府和区议会也举行选举。北爱尔兰没有地方选举。工党当时执政第二年，在选举中遭遇挫折，反对党保守党有所进展。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: Elections to City of Lincoln Council in Lincolnshire, England, were held on 6 May 1999. The whole council was up for election with boundary changes since the last election in 1998. The Labour party stayed in overall control of the Council.

zh.s: 林肯郡英格兰地区的林肯市议会选举于1999年5月6日举行。由于自1998年上次选举以来选区边界有所调整，议会全部席位都进行改选。工党继续掌控议会。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: On 6 May 1999, an election was held to choose council members for the Trafford Council in Greater Manchester, England. One-third of the council members were up for election, with each successful candidate to serve a four-year term of office, expiring in 2003. The Labour Party held overall control of the council.

zh.t: 1999年特拉福德都市自治市议会选举
zh.s: 1999年5月6日，英格兰大曼彻斯特地区举行选举，选出特拉福德议会议员。议会三分之一席位进行改选，胜选者任期四年，到2003年届满。工党继续掌控议会。

en.s: The 1999 Aberdeen City Council election took place on 6 May 1999 to elect members of Aberdeen City Council. The results saw Labour retain its control of the council, albeit with a reduced majority.

zh.s: 1999年阿伯丁市议会选举于5月6日举行，选出阿伯丁市议会议员。选举结果显示，工党以多数席位减少的代价保住了议会控制权。

en.s: Elections to the Highland Council were held on 6 May 1999; the same day as elections to the Scottish Parliament and to the 31 other councils in Scotland. 80 councillors were elected from 80 wards using the plurality system (a.k.a. 'First Past the Post'). Independent councillors retained their status as the majority group, with councillors also being elected representing the Labour Party, Liberal Democrats, and Scottish National Party.

zh.s: 高地议会选举于1999年5月6日举行，与苏格兰议会选举及苏格兰另外31个地方议会的选举同日进行。选举采用相对多数制（也称“先到先得制”），从80个选区选出80名议员。无党籍议员继续构成多数派，工党、自由民主党和苏格兰民族党也有候选人当选。

en.s: The 1999 Colchester Borough Council election took place on 6 May 1999 to elect members of Colchester Borough Council in Essex, England. One third of the council was up for election and the council stayed under no overall control.

zh.s: 1999年科尔切斯特自治市议会选举于5月6日举行，选出英格兰埃塞克斯郡科尔切斯特自治市议会议员。议会三分之一席位进行改选，选后议会仍没有任何政党占据多数。

en.s: Elections to Stevenage Council were held on 6 May 1999. The whole council was up for election with boundary changes since the last election in 1998. The Labour party stayed in overall control of the council.

zh.s: 史蒂文尼奇议会选举于1999年5月6日举行。由于自1998年上次选举以来选区边界有所调整，议会全部席位都进行改选。工党继续掌控议会。

en.s: 1999 Elections to Fife Council were held on 6 May 1999, the same day as the other Scottish local government elections and the Scottish Parliament election. The election were the first after the third boundary review which resulted in 78 individual councillors being elected.

zh.s: 法夫议会选举于1999年5月6日举行，与苏格兰其他地方议会选举及苏格兰议会选举同日进行。这是第三次选区边界审查后的首次选举，共选出78名议员。

en.s: The 1999 Barnsley Metropolitan Borough Council election took place on 6 May 1999 to elect members of Barnsley Metropolitan Borough Council in South Yorkshire, England. One third of the council was up for election and the Labour party stayed in overall control of the council.

zh.t: 1999年巴恩斯利都市自治市议会选举
zh.s: 1999年巴恩斯利都市自治市议会选举于5月6日举行，选出英格兰南约克郡巴恩斯利都市自治市议会议员。议会三分之一席位进行改选，工党继续掌控议会。

en.s: Elections to Rochford Council were held on 6 May 1999. One third of the council was up for election and the council stayed under no overall control.

zh.s: 罗奇福德议会选举于1999年5月6日举行。议会三分之一席位进行改选，选后仍没有任何政党占据多数。

en.s: Elections to City of York Council were held on 6 May 1999. All 53 council seats in the city were up for election and the Labour party kept overall control of the council.

zh.s: 约克市议会选举于1999年5月6日举行，市内全部53个议席都进行改选。工党保住了议会控制权。

en.s: The 1999 Basildon District Council election took place on 6 May 1999 to elect members of Basildon District Council in Essex, England. One third of the council was up for election and the Labour party stayed in overall control of the council.

zh.s: 1999年巴西尔登区议会选举于5月6日举行，选出英格兰埃塞克斯郡巴西尔登区议会议员。议会三分之一席位进行改选，工党继续掌控议会。

en.s: Elections to the City of Edinburgh Council were held on 6 May 1999, the same day as the other Scottish local government elections and the Scottish Parliament general election. Turnout was 61%, an increase of 16.5% on the 1995 turnout.

zh.s: 爱丁堡市议会选举于1999年5月6日举行，与苏格兰其他地方议会选举及苏格兰议会大选同日进行。投票率为61%，比1995年上升16.5个百分点。

en.s: The Scottish local elections, 1999 were held on 6 May 1999, the same day as First Scottish Parliament elections. It was the second election for all 32 Scottish councils and the first after a major review into all wards.

zh.s: 1999年苏格兰地方选举于5月6日举行，与苏格兰议会首次选举同日进行。这是苏格兰32个地方议会的第二次选举，也是全面检视各区后举行的首次选举。

en.s: The 1999 Harlow District Council election took place on 6 May 1999 to elect members of Harlow District Council in Essex, England. One third of the council was up for election and the Labour party stayed in overall control of the council.

zh.s: 1999年哈洛区议会选举于5月6日举行，选出哈洛区议会议员。议会三分之一席位进行改选，工党继续掌控议会。

en.s: Elections for Ipswich Borough Council were held on 6 May 1999. One third of the council was up for election and the Labour party kept overall control of the council. This was the first time that the Liberal-Democrats won a seat in the St Margarets ward. Inga Lockington gained one of the ward's 3 seats from the Conservatives. She has held it ever since.

zh.t: 1999年伊普斯维奇自治市议会选举
zh.s: 伊普斯维奇自治市议会选举于1999年5月6日举行。议会三分之一席位进行改选，工党保住了议会控制权。这是自由民主党首次在圣玛格丽特选区赢得席位：英加·洛克廷顿从保守党手中赢得该选区3席中的1席，此后一直保有这一席位。

en.s: The 1999 Gravesham Borough Council election took place on 6 May 1999 to elect members of Gravesham Borough Council in Kent, England. The whole council was up for election and the Labour party stayed in overall control of the council.

zh.t: 1999年格雷夫舍姆自治市议会选举
zh.s: 1999年格雷夫舍姆自治市议会选举于5月6日举行，选出英格兰肯特郡格雷夫舍姆自治市议会议员。议会全部席位都进行改选，工党继续掌控议会。

en.s: The 1999 Fenland District Council election took place on 6 May 1999 to elect members of Fenland District Council in Cambridgeshire, England. The whole council was up for election and the Conservative party gained overall control of the council from no overall control.

zh.s: 1999年芬兰区议会选举于5月6日举行，选出英格兰剑桥郡芬兰区议会议员。议会全部席位都进行改选，保守党从原本没有任何政党占据多数的状态中取得多数并控制议会。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: Elections to Epping Forest Council were held on 6 May 1999. One third of the council was up for election and the council stayed under no overall control. Overall turnout was 29%.

zh.s: 埃平森林议会选举于1999年5月6日举行。议会三分之一席位进行改选，选后仍没有任何政党占据多数。整体投票率为29%。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.t: Tonbridge and Malling Borough Council election, 1999
en.s: Elections to Tonbridge and Malling Borough Council were held on 6 May 1999. The whole borough council (55 members) were up for election. Parish council elections were held on the same day.

zh.t: 1999年汤布里奇和莫林区自治市议会选举
zh.s: 汤布里奇和莫林区自治市议会选举于1999年5月6日举行，自治市议会全部55个席位都进行改选。当天也举行了堂区议会选举。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: Elections to Tendring District Council in Essex, England took place on 6 May 1999. This was on the same day as other local elections across the United Kingdom. Although the Labour Party remained the largest party on the council, it lost overall control while the Conservatives made major gains.

zh.s: 英格兰埃塞克斯郡滕德林区议会选举于1999年5月6日举行，与英国其他地方选举同日进行。工党仍是议会中最大的政党，但失去议会多数；保守党则大幅增加席位。

en.s: An election to Comhairle nan Eilean Siar was held on 6 May 1999 as part of the wider 1999 Scottish local elections. The council, formerly known as Western Isles Council, had been renamed in 1997 in Gaelic as Comhairle nan Eilean Siar. Council ward boundaries had also been changed since the previous election, and the total number of wards was increased from 30 to 31.

zh.s: 西部群岛议会选举于1999年5月6日举行，是1999年苏格兰地方选举的一部分。该议会原名西部群岛议会，1997年改用盖尔语名称Comhairle nan Eilean Siar。自上次选举以来，议会选区边界也经过调整，选区总数从30个增至31个。

en.s: The 1999 Chelmsford Borough Council election took place on 6 May 1999 to elect members of Chelmsford Borough Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.t: 1999年切姆斯福德自治市议会选举
zh.s: 1999年切姆斯福德自治市议会选举于5月6日举行，选出英格兰切姆斯福德自治市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。

en.s: The 1999 Reading Borough Council election was held on 6 May 1999, at the same time as other local elections across Britain. Sixteen of the 45 seats on Reading Borough Council were up for election, being the usual third of the council (15 seats) plus a by-election in Abbey ward, where Labour's Jane Griffiths had resigned her seat on the council.

zh.s: 1999年雷丁自治市议会选举于5月6日举行，与英国各地其他地方选举同日进行。雷丁自治市议会45席中有16席参加改选，其中15席是通常改选的三分之一席位，另有1席是在阿比选区举行的补选。此前，工党议员简·格里菲思已辞去该席位。

en.s: Elections for the Scottish Borders Council took place on Thursday 6 May 1999, alongside the wider Scottish local elections. No party held a majority, with the largest grouping - local Independents - winning 14 of the council's 34 seats.

zh.s: 苏格兰边区议会选举于1999年5月6日（星期四）举行，与苏格兰其他地方选举同日进行。没有政党获得多数席位，最大的团体是地方无党籍议员，共赢得议会34席中的14席。

en.s: Local elections in Wales were held on 6 May 1999 to elect members to the twenty-two local authorities. They were held alongside other local elections in the United Kingdom. The previous elections were held in 1995. The inaugural election to the National Assembly for Wales took place on the same day as well.

zh.s: 威尔士地方选举于1999年5月6日举行，选出22个地方政府的议员，与英国其他地方选举同日进行。上一次选举于1995年举行。威尔士议会首次选举也在同一天举行。

en.s: The 1999 Cardiff Council election was the second election to the post-1996 Cardiff Council following the re-organization of local government in Wales. It was held on Thursday 6 May 1999. It was preceded by the 1995 election and followed by the 2004 elections. On the same day the first elections to the Welsh Assembly were held as well as elections to the other 21 local authorities in Wales.

zh.s: 1999年韦灵伯勒自治市议会选举于5月6日举行，选出英国北安普敦郡韦灵伯勒自治市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。选举结果与全国投票倾向相反：韦灵伯勒是1999年选举中唯一一个由工党夺得控制权的议会。

This was on the same day as other local elections. This was the first election to be held under new ward boundaries. The Conservative Party regained overall control of the council from the Labour Party, which it had lost at the previous election in 1995.

zh.t: 1999年东北安普敦郡区议会选举

en.s: The 1999 West Dorset District Council election was held on Thursday 6 May 1999 to elect councillors to West Dorset District Council in England. It took place on the same day as other district council elections in the United Kingdom. The entire council was up for election. The 1999 election saw the Conservatives become the largest party on the council but fall short of a majority.

zh.s: 西多塞特区议会选举于1999年5月6日（星期四）举行，选出英格兰西多塞特区议会议员，与英国其他区议会选举同日进行。议会全部席位都进行改选。保守党成为议会中最大的政党，但未能取得多数。

en.s: Elections to West Lothian Council were held on 6 May 1999, on the same day as the other Scottish local government elections. This was the second election to the unitary council following the implementation of the Local Government etc. (Scotland) Act 1994. The election used the 32 wards created by the Third Statutory Reviews of Electoral Arrangements in 1998. Each ward elected one councillor using first-past-the-post voting.

zh.s: 西洛锡安议会选举于1999年5月6日举行，与苏格兰其他地方政府选举同日进行。这是根据《1994年苏格兰地方政府等法案》设立单一层级议会后举行的第二次选举。选举采用1998年第三次法定选区安排审查设立的32个选区，各选区按“先到先得”制选出1名议员。

en.s: On 6 May 1999, an election was held to elect councillors to the North Warwickshire Borough Council in the English Midlands. It took place on the same day as other local elections in the UK. It resulted in the Labour Party keeping control of the council. All 34 seats were up for election in all wards. The Liberal Democrats also gained two seats in this election with an independent politician keeping their seat.

zh.t: 1999年北沃里克郡自治市议会选举

en.s: Elections to East Ayrshire Council were held on 6 May 1999, alongside elections to the Scottish Parliament. This was the second election following the local government reforms in 1994 and the first following the Third Statutory Reviews of Electoral Arrangements which resulted in two additional seats from the previous election. Despite losing five seats, Labour maintained a majority on the council winning 17 of the 32 seats.

zh.s: 东艾尔郡议会选举于1999年5月6日举行，与苏格兰议会选举同日进行。这是1994年地方政府改革后举行的第二次选举，也是1998年第三次法定选区安排审查后举行的首次选举，选区数比上次增加2个。工党失去5席，但仍以32席中的17席保持议会多数。

en.s: Elections to Daventry District Council were held on 6 May 1999. The whole council was up for election with boundary changes since the last election in 1998 increasing the number of seats by 3. The Conservative party gained overall control of the council from no overall control.

en.s: The 1999 West Dunbartonshire Council election was held on the 6 May 1999 and were the second to the unitary authority, which was created, along with 28 other local authorities, under the Local Government etc (Scotland) Act 1994.

en.s: Elections to Mid Bedfordshire District Council were held on 6 May 1999. All 53 seats were up for election. The Conservative Party gained overall control of the council, increasing their number of seats from 22 to 34, whilst the Labour Party declined from having 20 seats in 1995 to 7.

en.s: Elections to Inverclyde Council were held on 6 May 1999, the same day as other Scottish Local Government elections and the first Scottish Parliament Election.

en.s: The 1999 Dundee City Council election took place on 6 May 1999 to elect members of City of Dundee Council, as part of the Scottish local elections of that year.

en.s: Elections to Falkirk Council took place on 6 May 1999, alongside elections to the councils of Scotland's various other 31 unitary authorities. There were 32 wards - 4 less than in 1995.

This was the second election following the local government reforms in 1994 and the first following the Third Statutory Reviews of Electoral Arrangements which resulted in six fewer seats from the previous election.

zh.s: 南拉纳克郡议会选举于1999年5月6日举行，与苏格兰议会选举同时举行。这是1994年地方政府改革后举行的第二次选举，也是1998年第三次法定选区安排审查后举行的首次选举，议席因此比上次减少6席。

en.s: The Scottish Parliament (Scottish Gaelic: Pàrlamaid na h-Alba [ˈpʰaːrˠl̪ˠəmɪtʲ nə ˈhal̪ˠapə]; Scots: Scots Pairlament) is the devolved, unicameral legislature of Scotland. It is located in the Holyrood area of Edinburgh, and is frequently referred to by the metonym Holyrood. It is a democratically elected body and its role is to scrutinise the Scottish Government and legislate on devolved matters that are not reserved to the Parliament of the United Kingdom.
en.n: The first elections to the devolved Scottish Parliament and Welsh Assembly are held.

zh.s: 苏格兰议会（苏格兰盖尔语：Pàrlamaid na h-Alba；苏格兰语：Scots Pairlament）是苏格兰的自治立法机构，实行一院制。议会位于爱丁堡的荷里路德地区，常以“荷里路德”代称。议会由民主选举产生，负责监督苏格兰政府，并就不属于英国议会保留权限的事项立法。
zh.n: 苏格兰自治议会和威尔士议会举行首次选举。

en.s: The 2000 Insurrextion was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by the American promotion World Wrestling Federation (WWF, now WWE) and broadcast exclusively in the United Kingdom. It was the inaugural Insurrextion and took place on May 6, 2000, at the Earls Court Exhibition Centre in London, England.

zh.s: 2000年Insurrextion是世界摔角联合会（WWF，现为WWE）制作的一场职业摔角按次付费赛事，仅在英国播出。这是首届Insurrextion赛事，于2000年5月6日在英格兰伦敦伯爵宫展览中心举行。

en.s: The 2000 DFB-Pokal final decided the winner of the 1999–2000 DFB-Pokal, the 57th season of Germany's premier knockout football cup competition. It was played on 6 May 2000 at the Olympiastadion in Berlin. Bayern Munich won the match 3–0 against Werder Bremen to claim their 10th cup title.

zh.s: 2000年德国杯决赛决出了1999至2000赛季德国杯冠军，这是德国顶级足球淘汰赛的第57个赛季。决赛于2000年5月6日在柏林奥林匹克体育场举行。拜仁慕尼黑以3比0击败云达不来梅，赢得队史第10座德国杯冠军。

en.t: 2002 Football League Third Division play-off final
en.s: The 2002 Football League Third Division play-off final was an association football match played on 6 May 2002 at the Millennium Stadium, Cardiff, between Cheltenham Town and Rushden & Diamonds. The match determined the fourth and final team to gain promotion from the Football League Third Division, English football's fourth tier, to the Second Division.

zh.t: 2002年英格兰足球联赛丙级联赛升级附加赛决赛
zh.s: 2002年英格兰足球联赛丙级联赛升级附加赛决赛于2002年5月6日在威尔士加的夫千禧球场举行，由切尔滕纳姆镇对阵拉什登与戴蒙德。这场比赛决出最后一支从英格兰足球第四级别丙级联赛升入乙级联赛的球队。

en.s: The 2002 FA Women's Cup Final was the 32nd final of the FA Women's Cup, England's primary cup competition for women's football teams. The final event was played between Doncaster Belles and Fulham on 6 May 2002 at Selhurst Park in London. Doncaster Belles entered a record 13th final having won the trophy on six previous occasions. Fulham made its second final appearance, after losing the 2001 final.

zh.s: 2002年英格兰足总女子杯决赛是第32届赛事，也是英格兰女子足球队伍的主要杯赛决赛。唐卡斯特贝尔斯队于2002年5月6日在伦敦塞尔赫斯特公园球场对阵富勒姆队。唐卡斯特贝尔斯第13次打入决赛，创下纪录，此前曾6次夺冠。富勒姆第二次进入决赛，此前在2001年决赛中失利。

en.s: Pim Fortuyn, a Dutch politician, was assassinated by Volkert van der Graaf in Hilversum, North Holland on 6 May 2002, nine days before the general election of 2002, in which he was leading the Pim Fortuyn List (LPF). On a few occasions, Fortuyn had expressed his fear of being murdered: after being pied at the official release of his book De puinhopen van acht jaar Paars, as well as, most notably, on the talk show Jensen!

zh.s: 荷兰政治人物皮姆·福图恩于2002年5月6日在北荷兰省希尔弗瑟姆遭沃尔克特·范德赫拉夫暗杀，距离2002年大选还有9天。当时福图恩正领导皮姆·福图恩名单党。福图恩曾多次表示担心自己遭人谋杀：一次是在他的新书《紫色八年留下的烂摊子》正式发布时被人扔奶油蛋糕之后，另一次则是在脱口秀节目《延森！》上。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current lead via MediaWiki API

en.s: The 2003 Lincoln, Nebraska mayoral election took place on May 6, 2003, following a primary election on April 8, 2003. Incumbent Mayor Don Wesely, who was first elected in 1999, announced on January 17, 2003, that he would not seek re-election. Though the race was officially nonpartisan, following Wesely's departure, Democrats consolidated around City Councilwoman Coleen Seng, who announced that she would run to succeed Wesely.

zh.t: 2003年内布拉斯加州林肯市长选举
zh.s: 2003年内布拉斯加州林肯市长选举于2003年5月6日举行，此前初选于同年4月8日举行。1999年首次当选的现任市长唐·韦斯利于2003年1月17日宣布不竞选连任。虽然这场选举正式上为无党派选举，但韦斯利退出后，民主党人转而支持市议员科琳·森，她宣布竞选接替韦斯利。

en.t: The final episode of the television sitcom Friends is aired
en.s: "The Last One" is the series finale of the American sitcom Friends. Originally shown in its entirety, the episode's two parts were classified as the seventeenth and eighteenth episodes of the tenth season, and the 235th and the 236th episodes overall. It was written by series creators David Crane and Marta Kauffman and directed by executive producer Kevin S. Bright.

zh.t: 情景喜剧《老友记》播出最后一集
zh.s: 《最后一集》是美国情景喜剧《老友记》的大结局。该集最初分为两部分播出，分别列为第十季第17集和第18集，也是全剧第235集和第236集。剧集由创作者大卫·克兰和玛塔·考夫曼编剧，执行制片人凯文·S·布莱特执导。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; dated Events calendar entry and linked subject introduction

en.s: The 2006 Singaporean parliamentary general election was held on 6 May 2006. 1.22 million out of the 2.16 million eligible Singaporeans voted for members of parliament and elected their next government. The People's Action Party (PAP), in its first election under Lee Hsien Loong, won 66.6% of the overall votes and gained 82 out of 84 seats. The PAP held the office of Prime Minister for a twelfth consecutive term. The general election was held under the first-past-the-post system. The parliament was dissolved by President S R Nathan on 20 April, three weeks before the election.

zh.s: 新加坡国会大选于2006年5月6日举行。216万名符合资格的选民中有122万人投票，选出国会议员和新一届政府。这是人民行动党（PAP）在李显龙领导下首次参加大选，该党赢得66.6%的总票数和84席中的82席，连续第12届执政，李显龙继续担任总理。此次大选采用简单多数制。总统塞拉潘·纳丹于4月20日解散国会，距投票日三周。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: Periodic elections for the Tasmanian Legislative Council were held on 6 May 2006. The two seats up for election were Rowallan, held by independent MLC Greg Hall, and Wellington, held by Labor MLC Doug Parkinson. Rowallan was last contested in 2001, while Wellington was last contested in 2000.

zh.t: 2006年塔斯马尼亚立法委员会定期选举
zh.s: 塔斯马尼亚立法委员会定期选举于2006年5月6日举行。参加改选的两个席位是罗瓦兰选区和惠灵顿选区；前者由无党籍立法委员会成员格雷格·霍尔担任，后者由工党成员道格·帕金森担任。罗瓦兰上一次选举于2001年举行，惠灵顿则于2000年举行。

en.s: The 2007 French presidential election, the ninth of the Fifth French Republic was held to elect the successor to Jacques Chirac as president of France for a five-year term. The winner, decided on 5 and 6 May 2007, was Nicolas Sarkozy. The first round of voting took place on Saturday, 21 April 2007 (French territories in the Americas and the Eastern Pacific) and Sunday, 22 April 2007 (French territories in the Western Pacific, Indian Ocean, and Metropolitan France). As no candidate obtained a majority (50 percent plus one), a second round between the two leading candidates, Nicolas Sarkozy and Ségolène Royal, took place on Saturday, 5 May and Sunday, 6 May 2007.

zh.s: 2007年法国总统选举是法兰西第五共和国第九次总统选举，旨在选出雅克·希拉克的继任者，任期五年。最终胜出的是尼古拉·萨科齐，结果于2007年5月5日和6日确定。首轮投票于4月21日星期六在美洲和东太平洋地区的法国领土举行，4月22日星期日在西太平洋、印度洋和法国本土举行。由于无人取得过半数（50%加一票），排名前两位的萨科齐和塞戈莱娜·罗亚尔于5月5日星期六和6日星期日参加第二轮投票。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: A regional election was held in Madeira on 6 May 2007, to determine the composition of the Legislative Assembly of the Autonomous Region of Madeira. The election was a snap election, as it was original schedule to only happen in October 2008. The election was called after the President of the Regional Government, Alberto João Jardim, resigned after his government clashed with the Socialist Prime Minister José Sócrates due to the new regional finance law approved by the Sócrates government.

zh.s: 马德拉于2007年5月6日举行大区选举，决定马德拉自治区立法议会的组成。这是一次提前选举，原定于2008年10月举行。大区政府主席阿尔贝托·若昂·雅尔丁因与社会主义总理若泽·苏格拉底就新地区财政法发生冲突而辞职，随后启动了这次选举。

en.s: Periodic elections for the Tasmanian Legislative Council were held on 6 May 2007. The three seats up for election were Montgomery, held by independent MLC Sue Smith; Nelson, held by independent MLC Jim Wilkinson; and Pembroke, held by Labor MLC Allison Ritchie. Montgomery was last contested in 2002, while Nelson and Pembroke were last contested in 2001.

zh.t: 2007年塔斯马尼亚立法委员会定期选举
zh.s: 塔斯马尼亚立法委员会定期选举于2007年5月6日举行。参加改选的3个席位是蒙哥马利、纳尔逊和彭布罗克选区，分别由无党籍立法委员会成员苏·史密斯、吉姆·威尔金森和工党成员艾莉森·里奇担任。蒙哥马利上一次选举于2002年举行，纳尔逊和彭布罗克则于2001年举行。

en.s: The 2007 KNVB Cup final was a football match between AZ and Ajax on 6 May 2007 at De Kuip, Rotterdam. It was the final match of the 2006–07 KNVB Cup competition. Ajax beat AZ on penalties after the match finished 1–1 after extra time. It was Ajax' 17th KNVB Cup title.

zh.s: 2007年荷兰杯决赛于2007年5月6日在鹿特丹德奎普球场举行，由阿尔克马尔对阵阿贾克斯，是2006至2007赛季荷兰杯的决赛。双方在加时赛后战成1比1，阿贾克斯通过点球大战获胜，赢得队史第17座荷兰杯冠军。

en.s: The 2008 Indiana Republican presidential primary took place on May 6, 2008. 27 delegates to the 2008 Republican National Convention were selected in the election. In addition, 27 other delegates were selected during the state convention from June 9 to June 10, 2008. John McCain was the winner of the election and of all of Indiana's delegates.

zh.t: 2008年印第安纳州共和党总统初选
zh.s: 2008年印第安纳州共和党总统初选于2008年5月6日举行。选举选出27名代表，参加2008年共和党全国代表大会。另外27名代表于2008年6月9日至10日举行的州代表大会上选出。约翰·麦凯恩赢得初选，并获得印第安纳州全部代表席位。

en.s: The 2008 Indiana Democratic presidential primary took place on May 6, 2008. It was an open primary with 72 delegates at stake. The winner in each of Indiana's nine congressional districts was awarded all of that district's delegates, totaling 47. Another 25 delegates were awarded to the statewide winner, Hillary Clinton. The 72 delegates represented Indiana at the Democratic National Convention in Denver, Colorado.

zh.t: 2008年印第安纳州民主党总统初选
zh.s: 2008年印第安纳州民主党总统初选于2008年5月6日举行。这是一场开放式初选，共有72名代表席位待分配。印第安纳州9个国会选区各自的胜者获得该选区全部代表席位，共47席；全州胜者希拉里·克林顿另外获得25席。这72名代表代表印第安纳州出席在科罗拉多州丹佛市举行的民主党全国代表大会。

en.s: The 2008 Oregon Republican presidential primary was a mail only primary in the U.S. state of Oregon. Ballots were mailed to registered Republican voters between May 2 and May 6, 2008. To be counted, all ballots must have been received by county elections offices by 8:00 p.m. PDT on May 20, 2008. It was a closed primary; in order to vote in Republican races, residents must have registered as Republicans on or before April 29, 2008.

zh.t: 2008年俄勒冈州共和党总统初选
zh.s: 2008年俄勒冈州共和党总统初选采用邮寄投票。选票于2008年5月2日至6日寄给登记为共和党选民的人士。要计入选举结果，选票必须在2008年5月20日太平洋夏令时间晚8时前送达各县选举办公室。这是一场封闭式初选；居民必须在2008年4月29日或之前登记为共和党人，才能参加共和党选举。

en.s: The 2008 North Carolina Republican presidential primary took place on May 6, 2008 as part of the 2008 Republican Party presidential primaries. Moderate U.S. Senator and former presidential candidate John McCain would take the state after winning 74.01% of votes in the state and 51 delegates.

zh.t: 2008年北卡罗来纳州共和党总统初选
zh.s: 2008年北卡罗来纳州共和党总统初选于2008年5月6日举行，是2008年共和党总统初选的一部分。温和派联邦参议员、前总统候选人约翰·麦凯恩赢得该州74.01%的选票，并获得51名代表，因此赢得该州初选。

en.s: The 2008 North Carolina Democratic presidential primary took place on May 6, 2008, one of the last primary elections in the long race for nomination between Barack Obama and Hillary Clinton. Obama won the primary. North Carolina sent 134 delegates to the 2008 Democratic National Convention. 115 delegates were tied to the results of the primary, with the remainder being unelected superdelegates not pledged to any candidate.

zh.t: 2008年北卡罗来纳州民主党总统初选
zh.s: 2008年北卡罗来纳州民主党总统初选于5月6日举行，是巴拉克·奥巴马与希拉里·克林顿这场漫长提名竞争中的倒数几场初选之一。奥巴马赢得初选。北卡罗来纳州派出134名代表参加2008年民主党全国代表大会，其中115名代表席位按初选结果分配，其余为未经选举产生、未承诺支持任何候选人的超级代表。

en.s: An indirect presidential election was held in South Africa on 6 May 2009 following the general election on 22 April 2009. Jacob Zuma of the ruling African National Congress won the election with 277 votes (13 more than the number of seats held by the ANC), while Mvume Dandala of the Congress of the People got 47 votes. The 67 members of the official opposition Democratic Alliance abstained from voting.

zh.s: 南非于2009年5月6日举行间接总统选举，此前全国大选已于4月22日举行。执政的非洲人国民大会候选人雅各布·祖马以277票胜出，比该党在议会中的席位数多13票；人民大会候选人姆武梅·丹达拉获得47票。官方反对党民主联盟的67名议员弃权。

en.s: The 2009 Albanian Cup final was the 57th final of the Albanian Cup. The final was played at Niko Dovana Stadium in Durrës on 6 May 2009. The match was contested by Tirana, who beat Elbasani in their semi-final, and Flamurtari who beat Shkumbini. After Rezart Dabulla opened the scoring with a header after 42 minutes, Devis Mema equalised in the 65th minute before Hair Zeqiri scored the winner in the 92nd minute to give Flamurtari their third Albanian Cup success.

zh.s: 2009年阿尔巴尼亚杯决赛是该赛事第57届决赛，于2009年5月6日在都拉斯的尼科·多瓦纳体育场举行。半决赛中，地拉那队击败埃尔巴桑队，弗拉穆尔塔里队击败什昆比尼队，双方晋级决赛。第42分钟，雷扎尔特·达布拉头球破门；第65分钟，德维斯·梅马扳平比分；第92分钟，海尔·泽基里打入制胜球，帮助弗拉穆尔塔里第三次夺冠。

en.s: The 2010 Calderdale Metropolitan Borough Council election took place on 6 May 2010 to elect members of Calderdale Metropolitan Borough Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections and a general election. One councillor was elected in each ward for a four-year term so the councillors elected in 2010 last stood for election in 2006. Each ward is represented by three councillors, the election of which is staggered, so only one third of the councillors was elected in this election.

zh.t: 2010年卡尔德代尔都会自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2010年卡尔德代尔都会自治市议会选举于5月6日举行，选出英格兰卡尔德代尔都会自治市议会成员，与其他地方选举和英国大选同日进行。每个选区选出一名议员，任期四年，因此2010年当选的议员上次于2006年参选。每个选区由三名议员代表，分批改选，因此本次只改选三分之一席位。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The Leeds City Council election took place on 6 May 2010, the same day as the General Election, to elect members of City of Leeds Metropolitan Borough Council in West Yorkshire, England. Since the last election, there had been a number of by-elections with the Conservatives gaining a Temple Newsam seat from Labour, and after a brief stint sat as an Independent, Kabeer Hussain's return to the Liberal Democrats was cut short by his sudden death, with Labour gaining his vacated Hyde Park & Woodhouse seat in the ensuing by-election.

zh.s: 利兹市议会选举于2010年5月6日举行，与英国大选同日进行，选出英格兰西约克郡利兹都会自治市议会成员。上次选举以来，保守党在坦普尔纽瑟姆选区举行的补选中从工党手中赢得一席。议员Kabeer Hussain曾短暂回归自由民主党，之后突然去世；随后工党在海德公园和伍德豪斯选区的补选中赢得了他留下的席位。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 2010 United Kingdom local elections were held on Thursday 6 May 2010, when the 2010 general election also took place. Direct elections were held to all 32 London boroughs, all 36 metropolitan boroughs, 76 second-tier district authorities, 20 unitary authorities and various Mayoral posts, all in England. For those authorities elected "all out" these were the first elections since 2006. The elections that were due to be held in Exeter and Norwich were cancelled due to structural changes. The results provided some comfort to the Labour Party, losing the general election on the same day, as it was the first time Conservative councillor numbers declined since 1996.

zh.s: 2010年英国地方选举于5月6日星期四举行，与英国大选同日进行。英格兰的32个伦敦自治市、36个大都会自治市、76个第二层级区级地方政府、20个单一层级地方政府及多个市长职位举行直选。实行全体改选的地方政府自2006年以来首次举行选举。由于地方政府结构调整，埃克塞特和诺里奇原定的选举取消。尽管工党在同日举行的大选中失利，地方选举结果仍给该党一些安慰：保守党议员人数自1996年以来首次减少。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: Elections to Manchester City Council were held on 6 May 2010, on the same day as the 2010 UK General Election. One-third of the council was up for election, with each successful candidate to serve a four-year term of office, expiring in 2014. Since the election there had been a further defection from the Liberal Democrats to Labour. Labour held overall control of the council, on a high turnout - owing to the general election on the same day - of 50.9%.

zh.s: 曼彻斯特市议会选举于2010年5月6日举行，与英国大选同日进行。议会通常应改选的三分之一席位在此次选举中改选，当选者任期四年，至2014年届满。选举后又有一名自由民主党议员转投工党。工党继续控制议会；由于与大选同日举行，投票率较高，达到50.9%。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The United Kingdom general election of 2010 was held on Thursday, 6 May 2010, with 45,597,461 registered voters entitled to vote to elect members to the House of Commons. The election took place in 650 constituencies across the United Kingdom under the first-past-the-post system. None of the parties achieved the 326 seats needed for an overall majority. The Conservative Party, led by David Cameron, won the largest number of votes and seats but still fell 20 seats short. This resulted in a hung parliament where no party was able to command a majority in the House of Commons.

zh.s: 英国大选于2010年5月6日星期四举行，共有45,597,461名登记选民具备投票资格，选出下议院议员。选举在英国650个选区举行，采用简单多数制。没有政党赢得组阁所需的326席。大卫·卡梅伦领导的保守党得票和席位最多，但仍差20席才达到多数，最终出现没有任何政党在下议院占多数的悬峙议会。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: Elections to Reading Borough Council took place on 6 May 2010 under the backdrop of the 2010 General Election, with 15 council seats up for election. The Labour Party continued to lose seats, losing Katesgrove ward to the Liberal Democrats and Park ward to the Green Party. The Conservatives held all their seats apart from Minster ward which was a surprise gain by Labour. The election resulted in Reading Borough Council being left in no overall control. Shortly after the election the Conservatives and Liberal Democrats announced they would form a coalition to govern locally, ending over two decades of Labour control.

zh.s: 雷丁自治市议会选举于2010年5月6日举行，与英国大选同期进行，共有15席改选。工党继续失去席位：凯茨格罗夫选区的一席由自由民主党赢得，帕克选区的一席由绿党赢得。保守党保住所有待改选席位，只有明斯特选区被工党意外夺得。选举后雷丁自治市议会无人占多数。选举后不久，保守党和自由民主党宣布组建地方联合政府，结束了工党二十多年的执政。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: Sheffield City Council elections took place on Thursday 6 May 2010. There were 28 seats up for election in 2010, one of the three councillors from each ward. Since the previous election, Liberal Democrat councillor Frank Taylor had defected to an Independent leaving the Liberal Democrats with 44 councillors. Turnout was up dramatically with it being held alongside the general election, to 62.6%. The higher turnout helped mainly Labour against their electoral rivals, who managed to return the council to no overall control with three gains. This was bolstered by the newly elected Liberal Democrat in Walkley defecting to Labour immediately after being elected.

zh.s: 谢菲尔德市议会选举于2010年5月6日星期四举行，共有28席改选，即每个选区的三名议员中改选一人。上次选举以来，自由民主党议员Frank Taylor转为独立议员，使该党议员减至44人。由于与英国大选同日举行，投票率大幅升至62.6%。较高的投票率主要帮助工党，令其在增加三席后使议会恢复为无人占多数。自由民主党在沃克利选区新当选的议员随即转投工党。

en.t: Barking and Dagenham London Borough Council election, 2010
en.s: The 2010 Barking and Dagenham Council election took place on 6 May 2010 to elect members of Barking and Dagenham London Borough Council in London, England. The whole council was up for election and the Labour Party retained control of the council winning all of the seats. The British National Party lost all the seats they had gained in 2006. The Conservatives lost their only remaining seat and the Liberal Democrats failed to regain any seats they had lost four years ago The 2010 General Election was held on the same day, which increased turnout.

zh.t: 2010年巴金和达格纳姆伦敦自治市议会选举

zh.s: 伦敦克罗伊登议会选举于2010年5月6日举行，与英国大选及其他地方选举同日进行。伦敦自治市议会每四年全面改选一次；部分地方议会则在四年中有三年每年改选一名议员。

en.s: Elections for Ealing Council in London were held on 6 May 2010. The 2010 United Kingdom General Election and other local elections took place on the same day. In London council elections the entire council is elected every four years, as opposed to some local elections where one councillor is elected every year in three of the four years.

zh.t: 2010年伊灵伦敦自治市议会选举
zh.s: 伦敦伊灵议会选举于2010年5月6日举行，与英国大选及其他地方选举同日进行。伦敦自治市议会每四年全面改选一次；部分地方议会则在四年中有三年每年改选一名议员。

en.s: The 2010 Southend-on-Sea Borough Council election took place on 6 May 2010 to elect members of Southend-on-Sea Borough Council in Essex, England. One third of the council was up for election.

zh.t: 2010年滨海绍森德自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2010年滨海绍森德自治市议会选举于5月6日举行，选出英格兰埃塞克斯郡滨海绍森德自治市议会议员。议会三分之一席位进行改选。

en.t: 2010 United Kingdom general election in Northern Ireland
en.s: On 6 May 2010, the 2010 United Kingdom general election was held in Northern Ireland, to elect all 650 members of the House of Commons, including the 18 Northern Ireland seats. 1,169,184 people were eligible to vote, up 29,191 from the 2005 general election. 57.99% of eligible voters turned out (when including spoiled and excluded ballots), down 5.5 percentage points from the last general election.

zh.t: 2010年英国大选北爱尔兰选区结果
zh.s: 2010年英国大选于5月6日在北爱尔兰举行，改选下议院全部650名议员，其中包括北爱尔兰的18席。共有1,169,184人具备投票资格，比2005年大选增加29,191人。投票率为57.99%（包括废票和无效选票），比上届大选下降5.5个百分点。

en.s: Elections to Cambridge City Council were held on 6 May 2010 as part of the wider local elections across England.

zh.s: 剑桥市议会选举于2010年5月6日举行，是英格兰各地地方选举的一部分。

en.t: 2010 United Kingdom general election in Wales
en.s: On Thursday 6 May 2010, the 2010 United Kingdom general election was held in Wales, to elect all 650 members of the House of Commons, with 40 constituencies being in Wales. The Labour Party remained the party with the most seats in Wales, however it suffered a net loss of 4 seats and its share of the vote dropped by 6.5%.

zh.t: 2010年英国大选威尔士选区结果
zh.s: 2010年英国大选于5月6日（星期四）在威尔士举行，选出下议院全部650名议员，其中40个选区位于威尔士。工党仍是威尔士席位最多的政党，但净失去4席，得票率下降6.5%。

en.s: Local government elections took place in London, and some other parts of the United Kingdom on Thursday 6 May 2010. Polling stations were open between 7am and 10pm. Despite losing 6 Parliamentary seats in London in the General Election conducted on the same day, London Labour's share of the vote, council seats and control of Councils rose substantially. 10 councils swung to Labour control, and the party gained 190 council seats.

zh.s: 伦敦及英国部分其他地区的地方政府选举于2010年5月6日（星期四）举行，投票站开放时间为早上7时至晚上10时。尽管工党在同日举行的大选中失去伦敦的6个议席，但该党在伦敦的得票率上升，赢得更多市议会席位，掌控的议会也有所增加。10个议会转由工党掌控，工党共增加190席。

en.s: The 2010 Newcastle City Council election took place on 6 May 2010 to elect one third of the members of Newcastle City Council in England. The elections took place on the same day as other council elections in England and Wales and the general election. Following the last set of local elections held in 2008, two members of the Liberal Democrats resigned and sat as independents.

zh.s: 2010年纽卡斯尔市议会选举于5月6日举行，改选英格兰纽卡斯尔市议会三分之一的议员，与英格兰和威尔士其他议会选举及英国大选同日进行。此前一次地方选举于2008年举行；此后有两名自由民主党议员辞职，并以无党籍身份留在议会。

en.s: The May 6, 2010, flash crash, also known as the crash of 2:45 or simply the flash crash, was a United States trillion-dollar flash crash (a type of stock market crash) which started at 2:32 p.m. EDT and lasted for approximately 36 minutes. A variety of explanations have been forwarded for the crash, including errors in automatic trading systems and deliberate market manipulation.

zh.s: 2010年5月6日的闪电崩盘也称“2时45分崩盘”，是一场发生在美国、造成数万亿美元市值蒸发的股市闪崩。崩盘于美国东部夏令时间下午2时32分开始，持续约36分钟。人们提出了多种解释，包括自动交易系统出错和蓄意操纵市场。

en.s: Elections for the London Borough of Merton were held on 6 May 2010. This was on the same day as other local elections in England and a national general election. Following the elections, a Labour minority administration was formed with the support of the three Merton Park Ward Residents Association councillors, this replaced the previous Conservative administration.

zh.t: 2010年默顿伦敦自治市议会选举
zh.s: 伦敦默顿自治市议会选举于2010年5月6日举行，与英格兰其他地方选举及英国大选同日进行。选举后，工党在默顿公园选区居民协会3名议员的支持下组建少数派政府，取代此前的保守党政府。

en.s: Elections for Bromley Council were held on 6 May 2010. The 2010 General Election and other local elections took place on the same day. In London council elections the entire council is elected every four years, whereas in some local elections one councillor is elected every year for two or three of the four years.

zh.t: 2010年布罗姆利伦敦自治市议会选举
zh.s: 伦敦布罗姆利议会选举于2010年5月6日举行，与英国大选及其他地方选举同日进行。伦敦各议会每四年全面改选一次；部分地方议会则在四年中有两年或三年每年改选一名议员。

en.s: Elections for Southwark Council were held on 6 May 2010. The 2010 General Election and other local elections took place on the same day. In London council elections the entire council is elected every four years, opposed to some local elections where one councillor is elected every year for three of the four years. Southwark has 21 wards, each electing 3 councillors giving a total number of seats as 63.

zh.t: 2010年萨瑟克伦敦自治市议会选举
zh.s: 伦敦萨瑟克议会选举于2010年5月6日举行，与英国大选及其他地方选举同日进行。伦敦各议会每四年全面改选一次；部分地方议会则在四年中有三年每年改选一名议员。萨瑟克有21个选区，各选出3名议员，议席总数为63席。

en.t: 2010 Waltham Forest London Borough Council election
en.s: The 2010 Council elections for London Borough of Waltham Forest were held on 6 May 2010. The 2010 General Election and other local elections also took place on the same day. In London council elections, the entire council is elected every four years, opposed to some local elections where one councillor is elected every year for three of the four years.

zh.t: 2010年沃尔瑟姆森林伦敦自治市议会选举
zh.s: 沃尔瑟姆森林伦敦自治市议会选举于2010年5月6日举行，与英国大选及其他地方选举同日进行。伦敦各自治市议会每四年全面改选一次；部分地方议会则在四年中有三年每年改选一名议员。

en.t: 2010 Kensington and Chelsea London Borough Council election
en.s: Elections for the Royal Borough of Kensington and Chelsea were held on 6 May 2010. The 2010 General Election and other local elections took place on the same day. In London borough council elections the entire council is elected every four years, unlike some other English councils, where a third of the councillors are elected for a four-year term in three successive years, with no elections in the fourth.

zh.t: 2010年肯辛顿-切尔西皇家自治市议会选举
zh.s: 肯辛顿-切尔西皇家自治市议会选举于2010年5月6日举行，与英国大选及其他地方选举同日进行。伦敦自治市议会每四年全面改选一次；部分英格兰地方议会则分三年、每年改选三分之一议员，第四年不举行选举。

en.s: Elections to Hyndburn Borough Council were held on 6 May 2010. One third of the council was up for election. Since there was also the General Election being held on the same day, overall voter turnout was much higher than usual, for such local elections.

zh.s: 欣德本自治市议会选举于2010年5月6日举行，议会三分之一席位参加改选。由于当天还举行英国大选，整体投票率远高于这类地方选举的通常水平。

en.s: Elections for the City of Westminster London borough were held on 6 May 2010. The 2010 general election and other local elections took place on the same day. In London council elections the entire council is elected every four years, as opposed to the local elections ‘by thirds’ in some areas of England, in which a third of the councillors are elected every year for three years and then no election is held in the fourth year.

zh.s: 威斯敏斯特伦敦自治市议会选举于2010年5月6日举行，与英国大选及其他地方选举同日进行。伦敦议会每四年全面改选一次；英格兰一些地方议会则实行“三分之一改选”制度，连续三年每年改选三分之一议员，第四年不举行选举。

en.s: Elections for London Borough of Hackney Council were held on Thursday 6 May 2010. The whole council was up for election. Hackney is divided into 19 wards, each electing 3 councillors, so a total of 57 seats were up for election.

zh.t: 2010年哈克尼伦敦自治市议会选举
zh.s: 哈克尼伦敦自治市议会选举于2010年5月6日（星期四）举行，议会全部席位都进行改选。哈克尼分为19个选区，每区选出3名议员，共改选57席。

en.s: The 2010 North Hertfordshire Council election was held on 6 May 2010, at the same time as other local elections across England and the general election. Of the 49 seats on North Hertfordshire District Council, 19 were up for election, being the usual third of seats plus a by-election in Royston Palace ward.

zh.t: 2010年北赫特福德郡区议会选举
zh.s: 北赫特福德郡区议会选举于2010年5月6日举行，与英格兰其他地方选举及英国大选同日进行。北赫特福德郡区议会49席中有19席参加改选，包括通常改选的三分之一席位，以及罗伊斯顿宫选区的1席补选。

en.s: Elections to Liverpool City Council were held on 6 May 2010. One third of the council was up for election. (30 seats) As Liverpool Council is elected in thirds, councillors elected in the 2006 elections defend their seats this year, and the vote share changes are compared on that basis.

zh.s: 利物浦市议会选举于2010年5月6日举行，议会三分之一席位参加改选，共30席。由于利物浦议会按三分之一席位轮流改选，本次由2006年当选的议员守席，得票率变化也以此为比较基准。

en.s: Elections to Lambeth London Borough Council were held on 6 May 2010. All 63 seats were up for election. Turnout was 58%. The Labour Party retained control of the council, increasing its majority. The elections took place on the same day as other local elections and the United Kingdom general election.

zh.t: 2010年兰贝斯伦敦自治市议会选举
zh.s: 兰贝斯伦敦自治市议会选举于2010年5月6日举行，议会全部63席都进行改选。投票率为58%。工党继续掌控议会，并扩大多数。选举与英国大选及其他地方选举同日进行。

en.t: 2010 Tower Hamlets London Borough Council election
en.s: Elections to Tower Hamlets London Borough Council took place on 6 May 2010, the same day as the 2010 United Kingdom general election. There were 17 wards electing 3 councillors each.

zh.t: 2010年塔村伦敦自治市议会选举
zh.s: 塔村伦敦自治市议会选举于2010年5月6日举行，与英国大选同日进行。该自治市有17个选区，每个选区选出3名议员。

en.s: Elections for Harrow London Borough Council were held on 6 May 2010. The 2010 General Election and other local elections took place on the same day. In London council elections the entire council is elected every four years, whereas in some local elections one councillor per ward is elected every year in three out of the four years.

zh.t: 2010年哈罗伦敦自治市议会选举
zh.s: 哈罗伦敦自治市议会选举于2010年5月6日举行，与英国大选及其他地方选举同日进行。伦敦各自治市议会每四年全面改选一次；部分地方议会则每年改选四年中三年的议席。

en.s: On 5 May 2010, Somali pirates hijacked MV Moscow University, a Liberian-flagged Russian tanker, in the Gulf of Aden. Her crew was freed by the Russian Navy destroyer Marshal Shaposhnikov the following day.

zh.t: 莫斯科大学号油轮劫持事件
zh.s: 2010年5月5日，索马里海盗在亚丁湾劫持了悬挂利比里亚旗的俄罗斯油轮“莫斯科大学”号。次日，俄罗斯海军驱逐舰“沙波什尼科夫元帅”号救出了船员。

en.s: The 2011 Southampton Council election took place on 6 May 2011 to elect members of Southampton Unitary Council in Hampshire, England. One third of the council (16 seats) was up for election. Labour won a majority of the seats being contested and the Conservatives stayed in overall control of the council. Southampton Council is elected in thirds, which means the vote share change is compared to the corresponding Southampton Council election, 2007.

zh.s: 2011年南安普敦议会选举于5月6日举行，选出英格兰汉普郡南安普敦单一层级议会议员。议会三分之一席位（16席）进行改选。工党赢得本次改选席位中的多数，但保守党仍掌控议会。南安普敦议会按三分之一席位轮流改选，因此本次投票得票率变化是与2007年同类选举比较。

en.s: Tachi Palace Fights 9 was a mixed martial arts event held by Tachi Palace Fights (TPF) on Friday, May 6 at the Tachi Palace Hotel and Casino in Lemoore, California.

loc: 德国石勒苏益格-荷尔斯泰因州

en.s: A state election occurred in Schleswig-Holstein on 6 May 2012. All 69 seats in the Landtag of Schleswig-Holstein were contested in this election. Exit polling results predicted a close race, with 30.6% for the CDU, 8.3% for the FDP, 29.9% for the SPD, 14% for the Greens, 8% for the Pirates, and 4.5% for the minority Danish SSW. The Left Party failed to achieve enough votes to pass the minimum threshold for representation. After the elections, SPD held coalition talks with the Greens and SSW, which have 35 seats altogether. The proposed coalition is dubbed as the Danish traffic light or Namibia coalition due to the participation of SSW.

zh.t: 2012年石勒苏益格-荷尔斯泰因州选举
zh.s: 石勒苏益格-荷尔斯泰因州于2012年5月6日举行州选举，州议会全部69席都要改选。出口民调预测竞争激烈：基民盟得票率30.6%，自民党8.3%，社民党29.9%，绿党14%，海盗党8%，丹麦少数族裔党派南石勒苏益格选民协会（SSW）4.5%。左翼党未能达到进入议会的最低门槛。选举后，社民党与绿党及SSW举行组阁谈判，三党合计拥有35席。拟议中的联合政府因SSW参与，被称为「丹麦交通灯」或「纳米比亚联盟」。

en.s: The presidential election took place on 6 May 2012 in Serbia, on the same date as the parliamentary election. The election was called following President Boris Tadić's early resignation in order to coincide with the parliamentary and local elections to be held on the same date. The Speaker of the Parliament, Slavica Đukić Dejanović, took over as the Acting President. As no candidate won a majority, a runoff was on 20 May, with incumbent Tadić facing Tomislav Nikolić of the Serbian Progressive Party. According to preliminary results published by CeSID, Ipsos and RIK, Tomislav Nikolić has beaten his opponent Boris Tadić and is the new President of Serbia.

zh.s: 2012年5月6日，塞尔维亚举行总统选举，与议会选举在同一天进行。总统鲍里斯·塔迪奇提前辞职，以便总统选举与议会和地方选举同日举行，因此提前举行了此次选举。议会议长斯拉维察·久基奇·德亚诺维奇接任代理总统。没有候选人获得过半数选票，因此5月20日举行第二轮投票，由现任总统塔迪奇对阵塞尔维亚进步党候选人托米斯拉夫·尼科利奇。根据CeSID、Ipsos和RIK公布的初步结果，尼科利奇击败塔迪奇，当选塞尔维亚总统。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Greece on Sunday, 6 May 2012 to elect all 300 members to the Hellenic Parliament. It was scheduled to be held in late 2013, four years after the previous election; however, an early election was stipulated in the coalition agreement of November 2011 which formed the Papademos Cabinet.

zh.s: 希腊于2012年5月6日（星期日）举行议会选举，改选希腊议会全部300名议员。原定选举在2013年举行，即上次选举四年后，但2011年11月组建帕帕季莫斯内阁的联合政府协议规定提前举行选举。

en.s: The 2012 Ukrainian Cup final was a football match that was played at the Olimpiysky NSC, Kyiv, on 6 May 2012. The match was the 21st Ukrainian Cup Final and was contested by Metalurh Donetsk and Shakhtar Donetsk. This was the first time since 2007 that the Cup final had returned to Kyiv. Since Shakhtar had qualified for the 2012–13 UEFA Champions League, Metalurh would qualify for the 2012–13 UEFA Europa League.

zh.s: 2012年乌克兰杯决赛于2012年5月6日在基辅奥林匹克国家体育场举行，是第21届乌克兰杯决赛。顿涅茨克冶金队对阵顿涅茨克矿工队。这是自2007年以来决赛首次重返基辅。由于矿工队已获得2012至2013赛季欧洲冠军联赛资格，冶金队将取得2012至2013赛季欧洲联赛的参赛资格。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in France on 22 April 2012 (or 21 April in some overseas departments and territories), with a second round run-off held on 6 May (or 5 May for those same territories) to elect the President of France (who is also ex officio one of the two joint heads of state of Andorra, a sovereign state).
en.n: This entry records the second round, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 法国总统选举首轮投票于2012年4月22日举行（部分海外省和领地为4月21日），第二轮于5月6日举行（这些海外地区为5月5日），以选出法国总统。法国总统当然也是主权国家安道尔两位共同元首之一。
zh.n: 本条记录的是源信息框标注的第二轮投票日期。

en.s: Periodic elections for the Tasmanian Legislative Council were held on 6 May 2013. The three seats up for election were Montgomery, Nelson and Pembroke.

zh.t: 2013年塔斯马尼亚立法委员会定期选举
zh.s: 塔斯马尼亚立法委员会定期选举于2013年5月6日举行。参加改选的3个席位属于蒙哥马利、纳尔逊和彭布罗克选区。

en.t: Three women, kidnapped and missing for more than a decade, are found alive in Cleveland, Ohio, in the United States
en.s: Between 2002 and 2004, Ariel Castro abducted Michelle Knight, Amanda Berry, and Gina DeJesus from the roads of Cleveland, Ohio, United States, and later held them captive in his home at 2207 Seymour Avenue in the city's Tremont neighborhood. All three young women were imprisoned at Castro's home until 2013, when Berry successfully escaped with her six-year-old daughter, to whom she had given birth while captive.

zh.t: 三名被绑架、失踪十余年的女性在美国俄亥俄州克利夫兰被发现仍然生还
zh.s: 2002 至 2004 年间，阿里尔·卡斯特罗在美国俄亥俄州克利夫兰的道路上绑架了米歇尔·奈特、阿曼达·贝里和吉娜·德杰苏斯，之后将她们囚禁在特里蒙特社区西摩大道 2207 号的住所。三名年轻女性都被囚禁在那里，直到 2013 年贝里带着她在囚禁期间生下的六岁女儿成功逃出。

en.s: A knife attack at Guangzhou Railway Station in China left passengers injured. Police intervened and subdued the attacker at the station.
