en.t: 2016 Liberal National Party of Queensland leadership spill
en.s: The 2016 Liberal National Party of Queensland leadership spill was held on 6 May 2016 to elect a new leader of the Liberal National Party of Queensland (LNP) and, ex officio, Leader of the Opposition. Tim Nicholls was elected as the new leader, defeating sitting leader Lawrence Springborg in the second round of voting. Deb Frecklington was elected unopposed as deputy leader after John-Paul Langbroek did not recontest the position.

zh.t: 2016年昆士兰自由国家党领导层改选
zh.s: 昆士兰自由国家党于2016年5月6日举行领导层改选，选出新党魁及当然担任的反对党领袖。蒂姆·尼科尔斯在第二轮投票中击败现任党魁劳伦斯·斯普林博格，当选新党魁。约翰-保罗·朗布鲁克没有竞选连任副党魁，黛布·弗雷克林顿因此在没有对手的情况下当选副党魁。

en.s: The 2017 Plano municipal election was an election to the Plano City Council in the city of Plano, Texas on May 6, 2017. Along with the mayoral election (Place 6), seats were contested for Places 2, 4, and 8. Since no candidate received more than 50% of the vote in Places 2 and 8, a runoff was held on June 10, 2017 for these races.

zh.s: 2017年普莱诺市政选举于2017年5月6日举行，选出美国得克萨斯州普莱诺市议会议员。除市长席位（第6席位）外，第2、第4和第8席位也进行选举。由于第2和第8席位的初选中没有候选人得票超过50%，这两个席位于2017年6月10日举行了第二轮选举。

en.s: General elections were held in Niue on 6 May 2017.

zh.s: 纽埃于2017年5月6日举行大选。

en.s: The 2017 Fort Worth mayoral election took place on May 6, 2017, to elect the mayor of Fort Worth, Texas. The election was officially non-partisan. Betsy Price, who was serving her third term, ran for reelection. She handily won reelection with over 70% of the vote.

zh.s: 2017年沃思堡市长选举于2017年5月6日举行，选出得克萨斯州沃思堡市长。选举正式上为无党派选举。时任市长贝齐·普莱斯当时正在第三个任期内，竞选连任并以超过70%的得票率轻松胜出。

en.s: Periodic elections for the Tasmanian Legislative Council were held on 6 May 2017. The three seats up for elections were Launceston, Murchison and Rumney. They were previously contested in 2011.

zh.t: 2017年塔斯马尼亚立法委员会定期选举
zh.s: 塔斯马尼亚立法委员会定期选举于2017年5月6日举行。参加改选的3个席位属于朗塞斯顿、默奇森和拉姆尼选区。这些席位上一次于2011年参加选举。

en.s: On May 6, 2017, the city of San Antonio, Texas held an election to choose the next mayor of San Antonio. The election was officially nonpartisan, with candidates' party affiliations not appearing on the ballot. As no candidate secured a majority of the vote (50% of all votes cast +1), a runoff was held on June 10, 2017, with Councilman Ron Nirenberg defeating incumbent mayor Ivy Taylor.

zh.s: 得克萨斯州圣安东尼奥市于2017年5月6日举行选举，选出新一任市长。选举正式上为无党派选举，选票上不会列出候选人的党派。由于没有候选人取得过半选票（全部有效票的50%加1票），6月10日举行第二轮选举，市议员罗恩·尼伦伯格击败现任市长艾薇·泰勒。

en.s: The 2017 Greek Cup final was the 73rd final of the Greek Cup. It took place on 6 May 2017 at Panthessaliko Stadium. The contesting teams were PAOK and AEK Athens. It was PAOK's eighteenth Greek Cup final in their 91 years of existence and AEK Athens' twenty second Greek Cup final and second consecutive, of their 93-year history.

zh.s: 2017年希腊杯决赛是第73届希腊杯决赛，于2017年5月6日在潘塞萨利科体育场举行。参赛双方是塞萨洛尼基PAOK队和雅典AEK队。这是PAOK成立91年来第18次打入希腊杯决赛，也是AEK成立93年来第22次闯入决赛，并且连续第二年进入决赛。

en.s: El Paso, Texas, held a first round of general elections on May 6, 2017, to elect the mayor and city council. The runoff election took place on June 10, 2017. Incumbent mayor Oscar Leeser was eligible for another term, but announced in July 2016 that he would not seek another term. Leeser had a cancer-related surgery in 2016, but stated that his decision was not because of his health.

zh.s: 得克萨斯州埃尔帕索市于2017年5月6日举行首轮市政选举，选出市长和市议会议员。第二轮选举于2017年6月10日举行。现任市长奥斯卡·利瑟当时符合连任资格，但早在2016年7月就宣布不再竞选。利瑟于2016年接受过癌症相关手术，但表示不竞选连任并非出于健康原因。

en.s: The 2017 Sultan of Selangor Cup was played on 6 May 2017, at Singapore National Stadium in Kallang, Singapore.

zh.s: 2017年雪兰莪苏丹杯于2017年5月6日在新加坡加冷的新加坡国家体育场举行。

en.t: 2018 Lebanese general election in South III
en.s: Voting to elect eleven members of the Lebanese parliament took place in the South III district (one of three electoral districts in South Lebanon) on 6 May 2018, part of the general election of that year. The constituency had 460,565 voters, out of whom 228,563 voted. The district elects 8 Shiite parliamentarians, 1 Druze, 1 Greek Orthodox and 1 Sunni.

zh.t: 2018年黎巴嫩大选南部第三区选区结果
zh.s: 2018年黎巴嫩大选的一部分投票于5月6日在南部第三区举行，选出11名黎巴嫩议会议员。该选区是黎巴嫩南部三个选区之一，共有460,565名选民，其中228,563人投票。该区选出8名什叶派、1名德鲁兹派、1名希腊正教会和1名逊尼派议员。

en.t: 2018 Lebanese general election in Beirut I
en.s: Voting to elect eight members of the Lebanese parliament took place in the Beirut I district (one of two electoral districts in the city) on 6 May 2018, part of the general election of that year. The constituency had 134,355 (2018) registered voters, out of whom 43,353 voted.

zh.t: 2018年黎巴嫩大选贝鲁特第一区选区结果
zh.s: 2018年黎巴嫩大选的一部分投票于5月6日在贝鲁特第一区举行，选出8名黎巴嫩议会议员。该区是贝鲁特市两个选区之一，共有134,355名登记选民（2018年数据），其中43,353人投票。

en.s: Local elections were held in Tunisia on 6 May 2018 under the supervision of the Independent High Authority for Elections. These were Tunisia's first free and democratic local elections following the Tunisian Revolution and saw unaffiliated independent lists win the most votes but on a very low turnout especially in terms of youth turnout which was down sharply.

zh.s: 突尼斯地方选举于2018年5月6日举行，由独立选举高级委员会监督。这是突尼斯革命后首次举行自由、民主的地方选举。无党籍独立候选人名单获得最多选票，但投票率很低，年轻选民的投票率尤其大幅下降。

en.t: 2018 Lebanese general election in Mount Lebanon I
en.s: Voting to elect eight members of the Lebanese parliament took place in the Mount Lebanon I district (one of four electoral districts in the Mount Lebanon region) on 6 May 2018, part of the general election of that year. The constituency had 176,818 registered voters, out of whom 115,619 voted.

zh.t: 2018年黎巴嫩大选黎巴嫩山第一区选区结果
zh.s: 2018年黎巴嫩大选的一部分投票于5月6日在黎巴嫩山第一区举行，选出8名黎巴嫩议会议员。该区是黎巴嫩山地区四个选区之一，共有176,818名登记选民，其中115,619人投票。

en.s: The year 2018 was the fourth year in the history of the Rizin Fighting Federation, a mixed martial arts promotion based in Japan. The year began with Rizin 10 in Fukuoka on May 6, 2018. Rizin events are broadcast through a television agreement with Fuji Television. In North America and Europe, Rizin events are available via PPV on FITE TV.

zh.s: 2018年是Rizin格斗联盟发展史上的第四年。该联盟是一家总部位于日本的综合格斗赛事推广机构。2018年的赛事于5月6日在福冈举行的Rizin 10拉开帷幕。Rizin赛事通过与富士电视台的协议播出；在北美和欧洲，观众可通过FITE TV按次付费观看。

en.s: General elections were held in Lebanon on 6 May 2018. Although originally scheduled for 2013, the election was postponed three times in 2013, 2014 and 2017 for various reasons, including the security situation, the failure of the Parliament to elect a new President, and the technical requirements of holding an election. A new electoral law adopted in 2017 provides a proportional representation system for the first time.

zh.s: 黎巴嫩于2018年5月6日举行大选。选举原定于2013年举行，但因安全局势、议会未能选出新总统，以及举行选举所需的技术条件等原因，先后于2013年、2014年和2017年三度延期。2017年通过的新选举法首次规定采用比例代表制。

en.t: 2018 Lebanese general election in North II
en.s: Voting to elect eleven members of the Lebanese parliament took place in the North II district on 6 May 2018, part of the general election of that year. The constituency had 350,147 registered to vote, out of whom 146,419 voted. Residents elect 8 Sunni, 1 Alawite, 1 Greek Orthodox and 1 Maronite seat. The constituency contains three 'minor districts', Tripoli (corresponding to Tripoli District), Miniyeh and Danniyeh (the latter two corresponding to the Miniyeh-Danniyeh District).

zh.t: 2018年黎巴嫩大选北部第二区选区结果
zh.s: 2018年黎巴嫩大选的一部分投票于5月6日在北部第二区举行，选出11名黎巴嫩议会议员。该选区共有350,147名登记选民，其中146,419人投票。选民选出8名逊尼派、1名阿拉维派、1名希腊正教会和1名马龙派议员。该选区包括三个“次级选区”：的黎波里（对应的黎波里区）、米尼耶和丹尼耶（后两者对应米尼耶-丹尼耶区）。

en.t: 2018 Lebanese general election in North I
en.s: Voting to elect six members of the Lebanese parliament took place in the North I district (one of three electoral districts in the north Lebanon region) on 6 May 2018, part of the general election of that year. The constituency had 137,550 who voted. The district elects 3 Sunni, 2 Greek Orthodox, 1 Maronite, 1 Alawite. It covers the Akkar district.

zh.s: 2018年5月6日，黎巴嫩北部地区三个选区之一的北一区举行投票，选出6名议会议员，这是当年大选的一部分。该选区有137,550名选民投票，可选出3名逊尼派、2名希腊正教会、1名马龙派和1名阿拉维派议员，范围包括阿卡尔区。

en.s: The 2018 Backlash was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) and livestreaming event produced by WWE, held for wrestlers from the promotion's main roster brands, Raw and SmackDown. It was the 14th Backlash and took place on May 6, 2018, at the Prudential Center in Newark, New Jersey. Nine matches were contested at the event, including one on the Kickoff pre-show.

zh.s: 2018年Backlash是一场由WWE主办的职业摔角按次付费及流媒体赛事，参赛者来自该推广品牌Raw和SmackDown的主力阵容。这是第14届Backlash，于2018年5月6日在新泽西州纽瓦克的保德信中心举行。赛事共进行了9场比赛，其中1场安排在赛前节目中。

en.s: The 2019 Indian general election were held in Rajasthan in two phases- 29 April and 6 May 2019 to constitute the 17th Lok Sabha.

zh.t: 2019年印度大选拉贾斯坦邦选区
zh.s: 2019年印度大选在拉贾斯坦邦分两阶段举行，投票日分别为4月29日和5月6日，以选出第17届人民院议员。

en.t: 2019 Indian general election in Jammu and Kashmir
en.s: The 2019 Indian general election in Jammu and Kashmir was held for 6 seats in the state. The voting process was held in five phases on 11, 18, 23, 29 April and 6 May 2019.The Bharatiya Janata Party and the Jammu and Kashmir National Conference won 3 seats each with the BJP getting an impressive 46.4% votes hare. JKNC's vote share was 7.9%.

zh.t: 2019年印度大选查谟和克什米尔邦选区
zh.s: 2019年印度大选在查谟和克什米尔邦改选6个席位，投票分五个阶段举行，日期为4月11日、18日、23日、29日和5月6日。印度人民党和查谟和克什米尔全国会议各赢得3席。印度人民党得票率为46.4%，查谟和克什米尔全国会议得票率为7.9%。

en.s: A by-election was held in the federal riding of Nanaimo—Ladysmith on May 6, 2019, following the resignation of incumbent New Democratic MP Sheila Malcolmson. Green candidate Paul Manly won the by-election, becoming the second Green Party member to be elected to the House of Commons.

zh.t: 2019年纳奈莫—莱迪史密斯联邦补选
zh.s: 纳奈莫—莱迪史密斯联邦选区于2019年5月6日举行补选，此前现任新民主党议员希拉·马尔科姆森辞职。绿党候选人保罗·曼利赢得补选，成为第二位当选加拿大众议院议员的绿党成员。

en.s: A Gaza–Israel conflict escalation began on 3 May 2019 after two Israeli soldiers were injured by sniper fire from the Gaza Strip during the weekly protests at the Gaza–Israel border. In response, the Israeli Air Force carried out an airstrike, killing two Palestinians. Following this, hundreds of rockets were launched from Gaza at Israel, while the Israeli Air Force struck numerous targets within the Gaza Strip.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.t: 2019 年 5 月加沙—以色列冲突升级
zh.s: 加沙—以色列冲突于 2019 年 5 月 3 日升级，起因是每周举行的加沙—以色列边境抗议活动中，两名以色列士兵遭到来自加沙地带的狙击火力攻击并受伤。作为回应，以色列空军发动空袭，造成两名巴勒斯坦人死亡。随后，加沙方向向以色列发射了数百枚火箭弹，以色列空军则袭击了加沙地带的多个目标。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.t: 2021 Basingstoke and Deane Borough Council election
en.s: Elections to Basingstoke and Deane Borough Council took place on 6 May 2021 as part of the 2021 United Kingdom local elections. They took place at the same time as the elections for Hampshire County Council and the Hampshire Police and Crime Commissioner.

zh.t: 2021年贝辛斯托克和迪恩自治市议会选举
zh.s: 贝辛斯托克和迪恩自治市议会选举于2021年5月6日举行，是2021年英国地方选举的一部分。选举与汉普郡郡议会及汉普郡警察与犯罪专员选举同时举行。

en.s: The 2021 Epping Forest District Council election took place on 6 May 2021 to elect members of Epping Forest District Council in England on the same day as other local elections. This election marked the first time in over 22 years that the Labour Party have stood in every ward. The For Britain Movement stood in 3 out of 4 of the Waltham Abbey seats.

zh.s: 2021年埃平森林区议会选举于5月6日举行，选出英格兰埃平森林区议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。这是22年多来工党首次在所有选区都派出候选人。英国运动在沃尔瑟姆修道院4个席位中的3个选区派出候选人。

en.s: The 2021 Redditch Borough Council elections took place on 6 May 2021 to elect members of Redditch Borough Council, a district-level local authority in Worcestershire, England.

zh.s: 雷迪奇自治市议会选举于2021年5月6日举行，选出英格兰伍斯特郡雷迪奇自治市议会议员。

en.s: Elections to Southend-on-Sea Borough Council took place on 6 May 2021. This was on the same day as other local elections across the United Kingdom. The results saw the Conservatives and Labour pick up seats at the expense of the local Independents. The council is elected by thirds, so a single member was elected from all 17 wards to a term of four years.

zh.t: 2021年滨海绍森德自治市议会选举
zh.s: 滨海绍森德自治市议会选举于2021年5月6日举行，与英国各地其他地方选举同日进行。保守党和工党从地方无党籍议员手中赢得席位。该议会按三分之一席位轮流改选，因此本次17个选区各选出1名议员，任期四年。

en.s: The 2021 Barnsley Metropolitan Borough Council election took place on 6 May 2021 to elect members of Barnsley Metropolitan Borough Council in England. It took place on the same day as other local elections. The election was originally due to take place in May 2020, but was postponed due to the COVID-19 pandemic.

zh.t: 2021年巴恩斯利都市自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2021年巴恩斯利都市自治市议会选举于5月6日举行，选出英格兰巴恩斯利都市自治市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。选举原定于2020年5月举行，后因新冠疫情推迟。

en.s: The 2021 Hartlepool Borough Council election took place on 6 May 2021 as part of the 2021 local elections in the United Kingdom. A by-election for the Hartlepool constituency, which has identical boundaries to the council, was held on the same day.

zh.t: 2021年哈特尔浦自治市议会选举
zh.s: 哈特尔浦自治市议会选举于2021年5月6日举行，是2021年英国地方选举的一部分。边界与议会辖区相同的哈特尔浦选区也在当天举行补选。

en.s: The 2021 Brentwood Borough Council election took place on 6 May 2021 to elect members of Brentwood Borough Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.t: 2021年布伦特伍德自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2021年布伦特伍德自治市议会选举于5月6日举行，选出英格兰布伦特伍德自治市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。

en.s: The 2021 Exeter City Council election took place on 6 May 2021 to elect the members of Exeter City Council in Devon, England. This was on the same day as other local elections. Two candidates were elected to the Mincinglake and Whipton ward due to a by-election taking place the same day following the death of a Councillor some months earlier.

zh.s: 2021年埃克塞特市议会选举于5月6日举行，选出英格兰德文郡埃克塞特市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。由于几个月前一名议员去世，明辛莱克和惠普顿选区当天也举行补选，共有两名候选人当选。

en.s: The 2021 Cornwall Council election took place on 6 May 2021 as part of the 2021 United Kingdom local elections. It was contested under new division boundaries as the number of seats on the council falls from 123 to 87. The election was won by the Conservative Party, who took an overall majority of seats.

zh.s: 康沃尔议会选举于2021年5月6日举行，是2021年英国地方选举的一部分。本次选举按新的选区边界举行，议席从123席减至87席。保守党赢得选举，并取得议会多数。

en.s: Elections to Worcestershire County Council took place on 6 May 2021 as part of the 2021 United Kingdom local elections.

zh.s: 伍斯特郡议会选举于2021年5月6日举行，是2021年英国地方选举的一部分。

en.s: Elections to Hampshire County Council took place on 6 May 2021 as part of the 2021 United Kingdom local elections. All 78 seats were up for election, with each ward returning either one or two councillors by first-past-the-post voting for a four-year term of office. This took place at the same time as the elections for the Hampshire Police and Crime Commissioner and district councils.

zh.s: 汉普郡郡议会选举于2021年5月6日举行。议会全部78席都进行改选，各选区按“先到先得”制选出1名或2名议员，任期四年。选举与汉普郡警察与犯罪专员及各区议会选举同时举行。

en.s: The 2021 North Hertfordshire District Council election took place on 6 May 2021 to elect 17 of the 49 members of North Hertfordshire District Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections around the country. This election had originally been due to take place in May 2020, but was postponed due to the COVID-19 pandemic.

zh.t: 2021年北赫特福德郡区议会选举
zh.s: 2021年北赫特福德郡区议会选举于5月6日举行，选出英格兰北赫特福德郡区议会49名议员中的17人，与全国其他地方选举同日进行。该选举原定于2020年5月举行，后因新冠疫情推迟。

en.s: The 2021 Norwich City Council election took place on 6 May 2021 to elect members of Norwich City Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. 13 of 39 seats (one-third) were up for election.

zh.s: 2021年诺里奇市议会选举于5月6日举行，选出英格兰诺里奇市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。议会39席中有13席（三分之一）参加改选。

en.s: The 2021 Runnymede Borough Council election was held on 6 May 2021 to elect members of Runnymede Borough Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections, and was the second election on new electoral boundaries, following the 2019 Runnymede Borough Council election. The elections were postponed from May 2020 due to the COVID-19 pandemic Englefield Green East was not contested.

zh.t: 2021年朗尼米德自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2021年朗尼米德自治市议会选举于5月6日举行，选出英格兰朗尼米德自治市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。这是2019年朗尼米德自治市议会选举后，按新选区边界举行的第二次选举。选举原定于2020年5月举行，后因新冠疫情推迟。恩格尔菲尔德格林东选区没有进行选举。

en.s: The 2021 Stockport Metropolitan Borough Council election was held on 6 May 2021, to elect members of Stockport Metropolitan Borough Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. Stockport Council is elected in thirds, which means that in each three member local ward, one councillor is elected every year, except every four years which is classed as a fallow year.

zh.t: 2021年斯托克波特都市自治市议会选举
zh.s: 斯托克波特都市自治市议会选举于2021年5月6日举行，选出英格兰斯托克波特都市自治市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。斯托克波特议会按三分之一席位轮流改选：在每个有3名议员的地方选区中，每年选出1名议员；每四年会有一年不举行选举。

en.t: 2021 St Albans City and District Council election
en.s: The 2021 St Albans City and District Council election took place on 6 May 2021, delayed by one year due to the COVID-19 pandemic, to elect members of St Albans City and District Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. At the elections, the Liberal Democrats achieved a majority for the first time since 2011 and took the council back from no overall control.

zh.t: 2021年圣奥尔本斯市及区议会选举
zh.s: 圣奥尔本斯市及区议会选举于2021年5月6日举行，因新冠疫情推迟了一年，选出英格兰圣奥尔本斯市及区议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。自由民主党在选举中取得多数，这是该党自2011年以来首次做到，并从原本没有任何政党占据多数的状态中重新掌控议会。

en.s: The 2021 Broxbourne Borough Council election took place on 6 May 2021 to elect members of the Broxbourne Borough Council in Hertfordshire, England. One-third of the council was up for election, and the Conservatives maintained overall control of the council. These seats were due to be contested in 2020 but were delayed by one year due to the COVID-19 pandemic.

zh.t: 2021年布罗克斯本自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2021年布罗克斯本自治市议会选举于5月6日举行，选出英格兰赫特福德郡布罗克斯本自治市议会议员。议会三分之一席位参加改选，保守党继续掌控议会。这些席位原定于2020年改选，后因新冠疫情推迟一年。

en.s: The 2021 Worthing Borough Council election took place on 6 May 2021 to elect members of Worthing Borough Council, on the same day as other UK local elections. This election was originally scheduled to take place on 7 May 2020, but was delayed a year due to the COVID-19 pandemic; 2021 was originally scheduled to be an off-year for Worthing Borough Council elections.

zh.s: 2021年沃辛自治市议会选举于5月6日举行，选出沃辛自治市议会议员，与英国其他地方选举同日进行。选举原定于2020年5月7日举行，后因新冠疫情推迟一年；沃辛自治市议会原本计划2021年不举行选举。

en.s: The 2021 Wiltshire Council election took place on 6 May 2021 as part of the 2021 local elections in the United Kingdom. All 98 councillors were elected from electoral divisions which returned one councillor each by first-past-the-post voting for a four-year term of office.

zh.s: 威尔特郡议会选举于2021年5月6日举行，是2021年英国地方选举的一部分。议会全部98名议员按“先到先得”制选出，各选区选出1名议员，任期四年。

en.s: The 2021 Cambridge City Council election took place on 6 May 2021 to elect members of Cambridge City Council in England. This was on the same day as other nationwide local elections.

zh.s: 2021年剑桥市议会选举于5月6日举行，选出英格兰剑桥市议会议员，与全国其他地方选举同日进行。

en.s: The 2021 Rochdale Metropolitan Borough Council election took place on 6 May 2021 to elect members of Rochdale Borough Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. One-third of the seats were up for election.

zh.t: 2021年罗奇代尔都市自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2021年罗奇代尔都市自治市议会选举于5月6日举行，选出英格兰罗奇代尔自治市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。议会三分之一席位参加改选。

en.s: The 2021 Gloucester City Council election took place on 6 May 2021 to elect members of Gloucester City Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. There were held elections for all 39 of the City Council’s seats, Quedgeley Town Council and for the Police and Crime Commissioner for Gloucestershire, all of which were postponed from May 2020 due to the COVID-19 pandemic.

zh.s: 2021年格洛斯特市议会选举于5月6日举行，选出英格兰格洛斯特市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。市议会全部39席都举行了选举，昆奇利镇议会和格洛斯特郡警察与犯罪专员也举行了选举；这几场选举原定于2020年5月举行，后因新冠疫情推迟。

en.s: The 2021 Doncaster Metropolitan Borough Council election took place on 6 May 2021 as part of the 2021 local elections in the United Kingdom. All 55 councillors were elected from 21 wards which return either two or three councillors each by first-past-the-post voting for a four-year term of office. The election of the Mayor of Doncaster also took place on the same day.

zh.t: 2021年唐卡斯特都市自治市议会选举
zh.s: 唐卡斯特都市自治市议会选举于2021年5月6日举行，是2021年英国地方选举的一部分。议会全部55名议员从21个选区选出，各区采用“先到先得”制选出2名或3名议员，任期四年。唐卡斯特市长选举也在同一天举行。

en.s: The 2021 Gloucestershire County Council election took place on 6 May 2021 alongside other local elections. All 53 seats to Gloucestershire County Council were up for election. The Conservatives retained their majority, albeit a smaller one than in 2017.

zh.s: 格洛斯特郡议会选举于2021年5月6日与其他地方选举同时举行。议会全部53席都进行改选。保守党保住多数，但多数席位比2017年减少。

en.s: The 2021 Trafford Metropolitan Borough Council election to elect members of Trafford Metropolitan Borough Council in England took place on 6 May 2021. As with many other local elections in England, it was postponed from May 2020, due to the COVID-19 pandemic. One third of council seats were contested in the election, with each successful candidate serving a two-year term of office rather than the normal four due to a boundary review to be implemented in 2023.

zh.t: 2021年特拉福德都市自治市议会选举
zh.s: 特拉福德都市自治市议会选举于2021年5月6日举行，选出英格兰特拉福德都市自治市议会议员。与英格兰许多其他地方选举一样，本次选举原定于2020年5月举行，后因新冠疫情推迟。议会三分之一席位参加改选；由于2023年将实施选区边界审查，胜选者任期为两年，而非通常的四年。

en.t: 2021 England and Wales police and crime commissioner elections
en.s: Elections of police and crime commissioners in England and Wales were held on 6 May 2021, on the same day as the Senedd election in Wales and the local elections in England. This was the third time police and crime commissioner elections have been held (the two previous occasions were in 2012 and 2016).

zh.t: 2021年英格兰和威尔士警察与犯罪专员选举
zh.s: 英格兰和威尔士警察与犯罪专员选举于2021年5月6日举行，与威尔士议会选举及英格兰地方选举同日进行。这是警察与犯罪专员选举第三次举行；前两次分别在2012年和2016年。

en.t: 2021 Nuneaton and Bedworth Borough Council election
en.s: The 2021 Nuneaton and Bedworth Borough Council election was held on 6 May 2021 as part of the 2021 United Kingdom local elections and alongside elections for Warwickshire County Council and Warwickshire Police and Crime Commissioner. Half of the borough council seats were up for election and the results provided the Conservative Party with a majority on the council, with the party winning all but two seats up for election.

zh.t: 2021年纳尼顿和贝德沃思自治市议会选举
zh.s: 纳尼顿和贝德沃思自治市议会选举于2021年5月6日举行，是2021年英国地方选举的一部分，并与沃里克郡议会及沃里克郡警察与犯罪专员选举同时举行。自治市议会一半席位参加改选。保守党赢得多数席位，在本次改选席位中只输掉两席。

en.s: The 2021 Liverpool City Council election took place on 6 May 2021 to elect members of Liverpool City Council, alongside other elections across the United Kingdom. One third of the council were up for election, as well as the Mayor of Liverpool, the Metro Mayor of Liverpool City Region and Police and Crime Commissioner Merseyside Police, all covering Liverpool.

zh.s: 利物浦市议会选举于2021年5月6日举行，选出利物浦市议会议员，与英国其他地方选举同日进行。议会三分之一席位参加改选，利物浦市长、利物浦城市区域市长以及默西塞德警察与犯罪专员也在同日举行选举，选举范围均包括利物浦。

en.s: The 2021 Newcastle City Council election took place on 6 May 2021 to elect members of Newcastle City Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections across the United Kingdom. Twenty-eight seats were contested: the 26 seats forming the ordinary election, plus casual vacancies in Byker and Chapel.

zh.s: 2021年纽卡斯尔市议会选举于5月6日举行，选出英格兰纽卡斯尔市议会议员，与英国各地其他地方选举同日进行。共有28席参加选举：通常改选的26席，以及拜克和教堂区的两个临时空缺席位。

en.s: The 2021 Peterborough City Council election took place on 6 May 2021 to elect members to Peterborough City Council in Cambridgeshire, England. 23 of the 60 seats were contested. The election was held alongside the 2021 Cambridgeshire Police and Crime Commissioner election and the 2021 Cambridgeshire and Peterborough mayoral election.

zh.s: 2021年彼得伯勒市议会选举于5月6日举行，选出英格兰剑桥郡彼得伯勒市议会议员。议会60席中有23席参加选举。选举与2021年剑桥郡警察与犯罪专员选举及剑桥郡和彼得伯勒市长选举同时举行。

en.s: The 2021 Leeds City Council election took place on Thursday 6 May 2021 to elect members of Leeds City Council in England. It was held on the same day as other local elections across England and the rest of the UK, including the inaugural West Yorkshire mayoral election.

zh.s: 利兹市议会选举于2021年5月6日（星期四）举行，选出英格兰利兹市议会议员，与英格兰及英国其他地区的地方选举同日进行，其中包括首次举行的西约克郡市长选举。

en.s: Elections to Swindon Borough Council took place on 6 May 2021 as part of the 2021 local elections in the United Kingdom. The Conservatives made 6 gains and secured a majority of 15, their best performance since the 2011 elections.

zh.s: 斯温顿自治市议会选举于2021年5月6日举行，是2021年英国地方选举的一部分。保守党增加6席，取得15席多数，这是该党自2011年选举以来的最佳成绩。

en.s: The 2021 Knowsley Metropolitan Borough Council election took place on 6 May 2021 to elect members of Knowsley Metropolitan Borough Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. One-third of the seats were up for election.

zh.t: 2021年诺斯利都市自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2021年诺斯利都市自治市议会选举于5月6日举行，选出英格兰诺斯利都市自治市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。议会三分之一席位参加改选。

en.s: The 2021 Colchester Borough Council election was held on 6 May 2021 to elect members of Colchester Borough Council in Essex, England. The election had originally been scheduled for 7 May 2020, but were postponed for a year due to the COVID-19 pandemic. 17 members of the council (one-third of the whole) were up for election, one from each of the 17 wards.

zh.t: 2021年科尔切斯特自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2021年科尔切斯特自治市议会选举于5月6日举行，选出英格兰埃塞克斯郡科尔切斯特自治市议会议员。选举原定于2020年5月7日举行，后因新冠疫情推迟一年。议会17个选区各改选1席，合计改选议会三分之一的17名议员。

en.s: The 2021 Solihull Metropolitan Borough Council election took place on 6 May 2021 to elect members of Solihull Metropolitan Borough Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. One-third of the seats were up for election.

zh.t: 2021年索利赫尔都市自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2021年索利赫尔都市自治市议会选举于5月6日举行，选出英格兰索利赫尔都市自治市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。议会三分之一席位参加改选。

en.s: Elections to Isle of Wight Council took place on 6 May 2021 as part of the 2021 United Kingdom local elections. These were held at the same time as the elections for the Hampshire Police and Crime Commissioner. The elections saw the Conservatives lose control of the council, losing seats against the national trend for the party.

zh.s: 怀特岛议会选举于2021年5月6日举行，是2021年英国地方选举的一部分。选举与汉普郡警察与犯罪专员选举同时举行。保守党失去议会控制权，席位也有所减少，与该党在全国的总体趋势相反。

en.s: Elections to Three Rivers District Council took place on 6 May 2021 alongside other local elections in the United Kingdom. 13 of the 39 seats were elected: the seats elected were last contested in the 2016 election. The election was originally scheduled to take place on 7 May 2020, however elections were delayed nationwide by one year due to the COVID-19 pandemic.

zh.s: 三河区议会选举于2021年5月6日举行，与英国其他地方选举同日进行。议会39席中有13席进行改选，这些席位上一次于2016年改选。选举原定于2020年5月7日举行，但因新冠疫情而在全国范围内推迟一年。

en.s: The 2021 Cheltenham Borough Council elections took place on 6 May 2021 to elect members of Cheltenham Borough Council in Gloucestershire, England. Half of the council was up for election, and the Liberal Democrats remained in overall control of the council. These seats were due to be contested in 2020, but were delayed by one year due to the COVID-19 pandemic.

zh.t: 2021年切尔滕纳姆自治市议会选举
zh.s: 切尔滕纳姆自治市议会选举于2021年5月6日举行，选出英格兰格洛斯特郡切尔滕纳姆自治市议会议员。议会一半席位参加改选，自由民主党继续掌控议会。这些席位原定于2020年改选，后因新冠疫情推迟一年。

en.s: Elections to Winchester City Council took place on 6 May 2021 as part of the 2021 United Kingdom local elections. This took place at the same time as the elections for Hampshire County Council and the Hampshire Police and Crime Commissioner.

zh.s: 温彻斯特市议会选举于2021年5月6日举行，是2021年英国地方选举的一部分。选举与汉普郡郡议会及汉普郡警察与犯罪专员选举同时举行。

en.s: The 2021 Walsall Metropolitan Borough Council election took place on 6 May 2021 to elect members of Walsall Council in England. This was on the same day as the 2021 elections for the West Midlands Police and Crime Commissioner, and the 2021 West Midlands mayoral election. These elections had been delayed from May 2020 due to the COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom.

zh.t: 2021年沃尔索尔都市自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2021年沃尔索尔都市自治市议会选举于5月6日举行，选出英格兰沃尔索尔议会议员。选举与2021年西米德兰兹警察与犯罪专员及西米德兰兹市长选举同日进行。这些选举原定于2020年5月举行，后因英国新冠疫情推迟。

en.s: The 2021 Cambridgeshire County Council election took place on 6 May 2021 as part of the 2021 local elections in the United Kingdom. All 61 councillors were elected from 59 electoral divisions, which returned either one or two county councillors each by first-past-the-post voting for a four-year term of office. The election was held alongside a full election for Cambridge City Council, the Cambridgeshire Police and Crime Commissioner, Mayor of Cambridgeshire and Peterborough and one-third of Peterborough City Council.

zh.s: 剑桥郡议会选举于2021年5月6日举行，是2021年英国地方选举的一部分。议会全部61名议员从59个选区选出，各选区按“先到先得”制选出1名或2名议员，任期四年。选举与剑桥市议会全面改选、剑桥郡警察与犯罪专员选举、剑桥郡和彼得伯勒市长选举以及彼得伯勒市议会三分之一席位改选同时举行。

en.s: An election for the Northumberland County Council took place on 6 May 2021 as part of the 2021 local elections in the United Kingdom. All 67 councillors were elected from 66 electoral divisions which returned either one or two county councillors each by first-past-the-post voting for a four-year term of office. The results saw the Conservative Party win 34 seats, a bare majority.

zh.s: 诺森伯兰郡议会选举于2021年5月6日举行，是2021年英国地方选举的一部分。全部67名议员从66个选区选出，各选区按“先到先得”制选出1名或2名议员，任期四年。保守党赢得34席，刚好过半。

en.s: A by-election for the United Kingdom parliamentary constituency of Hartlepool was held on 6 May 2021, triggered by the resignation of incumbent Labour Party Member of Parliament (MP) Mike Hill, who stood down over allegations of sexual harassment. It was won by Jill Mortimer of the Conservative Party with 51.9% of the vote and a swing of 16%—the largest ever swing towards an incumbent governing party in recorded UK by-electoral history.

zh.s: 英国国会哈特尔浦选区于2021年5月6日举行补选，起因是现任工党议员迈克·希尔因受到性骚扰指控而辞职。保守党候选人吉尔·莫蒂默以51.9%的得票率胜出，领先幅度为16个百分点，这是英国有记录以来执政党现任议员在补选中面对的最大得票率变化。

en.s: The 2021 Southampton City Council election took place on 6 May 2021, on the same day as other local elections, to elect members of Southampton City Council. The election was originally due to take place in May 2020, to elect the seats of councillors last elected in 2016, but was postponed due to the COVID-19 pandemic.

zh.s: 南安普敦市议会选举于2021年5月6日举行，选出南安普敦市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。原定于2020年5月进行的选举，原本是改选2016年当选议员所占席位，后因新冠疫情推迟。

en.s: The 2021 Slough Borough Council election took place on 6 May 2021 to elect members of Slough Borough Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 2021年斯劳自治市议会选举于5月6日举行，选出英格兰斯劳自治市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。

en.s: The 2021 Crawley Borough Council election took place on 6 May 2021 to elect members of Crawley Borough Council in West Sussex, England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 2021年克劳利自治市议会选举于5月6日举行，选出英格兰西萨塞克斯郡克劳利自治市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。

en.s: Elections to Welwyn Hatfield Borough Council took place on 6 May 2021. This was on the same day as other local elections across the United Kingdom. At the previous election the Liberal Democrats managed to gain enough of the popular vote to end the Conservatives majority of the council for the first time since 2002.

zh.t: 2021年韦林哈特菲尔德自治市议会选举
zh.s: 韦林哈特菲尔德自治市议会选举于2021年5月6日举行，与英国各地其他地方选举同日进行。上次选举中，自由民主党得票足以让保守党失去自2002年以来首次拥有的议会多数。

en.s: Elections to Havant Borough Council took place on 6 May 2021 as part of the 2021 United Kingdom local elections. They took place at the same time as the elections for Hampshire County Council and the Hampshire Police and Crime Commissioner.

zh.s: 哈文特自治市议会选举于2021年5月6日举行，是2021年英国地方选举的一部分。选举与汉普郡郡议会及汉普郡警察与犯罪专员选举同时举行。

en.s: The 2021 Nottinghamshire County Council election took place on 6 May 2021 as part of the 2021 local elections in the United Kingdom. All 66 councillors were elected from 56 electoral divisions, which returned either one or two county councillors each by first-past-the-post voting for a four-year term of office. The Conservative Party won 37 of 66 seats, winning an overall majority for the first time since 2009.

zh.s: 诺丁汉郡议会选举于2021年5月6日举行，是2021年英国地方选举的一部分。全部66名议员从56个选区选出，各选区按“先到先得”制选出1名或2名议员，任期四年。保守党赢得66席中的37席，首次自2009年以来取得议会多数。

en.s: The 2021 Durham County Council election was held on 6 May 2021 as part of the 2021 local elections in the United Kingdom. All 126 councillors were to be elected. The county is divided into 63 electoral divisions (called "wards") with each electing between 1 and 3 councillors by the first-past-the-post voting method for a fixed four-year term.

zh.s: 达勒姆郡议会选举于2021年5月6日举行，是2021年英国地方选举的一部分。议会全部126名议员参加选举。全郡分为63个选区（称为“选区”），每区按“先到先得”制选出1至3名议员，任期固定为四年。

en.s: Elections to Staffordshire County Council took place on 6 May 2021 on the same day as district council elections in Cannock Chase and Tamworth and other local elections in England. All of the council's divisions were up for election, meaning a total of 62 councillors were elected. The result was a second consecutive landslide victory for the Conservative Party which increased its majority on the council from 51 seats in 2017 up to 57 seats, out of a possible 62.

zh.s: 斯塔福德郡议会选举于2021年5月6日举行，与英格兰坎诺克蔡斯和塔姆沃思的区议会选举及其他地方选举同日进行。议会所有选区都进行改选，共选出62名议员。保守党连续第二次大胜，将议会多数席位从2017年的51席扩大至62席中的57席。

en.s: The 2021 United Kingdom local elections were held on Thursday 6 May 2021. More than 145 English local councils, around 5,000 councillor seats (including by-elections), thirteen directly elected mayors in England, and 39 police and crime commissioners in England and Wales were contested. On the same day, the 2021 Hartlepool by-election took place, and there were also elections to the Scottish Parliament (129 seats), Senedd (Welsh Parliament) (60 seats) and London Assembly (25 seats), the last in conjunction with the London mayoral election.

zh.s: 2021年英国地方选举于2021年5月6日（星期四）举行。英格兰145个以上的地方议会、约5,000个议会席位（包括补选席位）、13名直选市长，以及英格兰和威尔士的39名警察与犯罪专员都参加选举。同日还举行了2021年哈特尔浦补选，以及苏格兰议会（129席）、威尔士议会（60席）和伦敦议会（25席）选举；伦敦议会选举与伦敦市长选举同时举行。

en.s: The 2021 Tees Valley mayoral election was held on 6 May 2021 to elect the Tees Valley Mayor on the same day as other local elections across the country. The mayor was elected by the supplementary vote. The election was originally due to take place in May 2020, but was postponed due to the COVID-19 pandemic. Conservative incumbent mayor Ben Houchen was seeking re-election, with Labour candidate Jessie Joe Jacobs challenging him.

zh.s: 蒂斯河谷市长选举于2021年5月6日举行，与英国各地其他地方选举同日进行。市长采用补充投票制选出。选举原定于2020年5月举行，后因新冠疫情推迟。保守党现任市长本·霍臣竞选连任，工党候选人杰西·乔·雅各布斯向他发起挑战。

en.s: The 2021 Wigan Metropolitan Borough Council election took place on 6 May 2021 to elect members of Wigan Metropolitan Borough Council in England. This election was held on the same day as other local elections. The election was originally due to take place on 7 May 2020, but was postponed due to the COVID-19 pandemic.

zh.t: 2021年威根都市自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2021年威根都市自治市议会选举于5月6日举行，选出英格兰威根都市自治市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。选举原定于2020年5月7日举行，后因新冠疫情推迟。

en.s: The 2021 Sheffield City Council election took place on 6 May 2021 to elect members of Sheffield City Council in England, as part of the nationwide local elections. The election was originally due to take place on 7 May 2020, but was postponed due to the COVID-19 pandemic. One seat from each ward was up for election.

zh.s: 2021年谢菲尔德市议会选举于5月6日举行，选出英格兰谢菲尔德市议会议员，是全国地方选举的一部分。选举原定于2020年5月7日举行，后因新冠疫情推迟。每个选区各改选1席。

en.s: The 2021 Essex County Council election took place on 6 May 2021 as part of the 2021 United Kingdom local elections. All 75 councillors were elected from 70 electoral divisions, with each returning either one or two councillors by first-past-the-post voting for a four-year term of office. The electoral divisions were the same as those used at the previous elections in 2005, 2009, 2013 and 2017.

zh.s: 埃塞克斯郡议会选举于2021年5月6日举行，是2021年英国地方选举的一部分。全部75名议员从70个选区选出，各区按“先到先得”制选出1名或2名议员，任期四年。这些选区边界与2005、2009、2013和2017年上次选举时相同。

en.s: The 2021 Kirklees Metropolitan Borough Council election took place on 6 May 2021 to elect members of Kirklees Metropolitan Borough Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections across the United Kingdom.. One-third of the seats were up for election, with two wards Almondbury (Birstall & Birkenshaw and Golcar) electing two councillors.

zh.t: 2021年柯克利斯都市自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2021年柯克利斯都市自治市议会选举于5月6日举行，选出英格兰柯克利斯都市自治市议会议员，与英国其他地方选举同日进行。议会三分之一席位参加改选，其中阿尔蒙德伯里和戈尔卡尔两个选区各选出两名议员。

en.s: Elections to Manchester City Council were held on 6 May 2021, as part of the 2021 United Kingdom local elections. They were originally scheduled for 2020 but were suspended for a year, due to the COVID-19 pandemic. In 2019 Labour had retained its majority on the council, with 93 seats, with the Liberal Democrats led by former MP John Leech increasing the number of opposition councillors to three, but this had fallen back to two in March 2021 when Councillor Greg Stanton defected to the Labour Party.

zh.s: 曼彻斯特市议会选举于2021年5月6日举行，是2021年英国地方选举的一部分。选举原定于2020年举行，后因新冠疫情暂停一年。工党在2019年保住议会多数，拥有93席；由前国会议员约翰·利奇领导的自由民主党将反对派议员增至3人，但2021年3月，议员格雷格·斯坦顿转投工党后，自由民主党席位又减至2席。

en.s: The 2021 Buckinghamshire Council election took place on 6 May 2021, alongside nationwide local elections. The election was originally due to take place in May 2020, but was postponed due to the COVID-19 pandemic. It was the inaugural election to Buckinghamshire Council, a unitary authority created on 1 April 2020 as part of structural changes to English local government. Buckinghamshire Council replaced Buckinghamshire County Council, last elected in 2017.

zh.s: 白金汉郡议会选举于2021年5月6日举行，与全国地方选举同时进行。选举原定于2020年5月举行，后因新冠疫情推迟。这是新成立的白金汉郡议会首次举行选举。该单一层级地方政府于2020年4月1日设立，是英格兰地方政府结构调整的一部分，取代了上次于2017年选举的白金汉郡郡议会。

en.s: Elections to Stevenage Borough Council took place on 6 May 2021. This was on the same day as other local elections across the United Kingdom. One third of the council was up for election, plus a by-election in Roebuck ward; the seats which were last contested in 2016. The Labour Party retained control of the council, which it has held continuously since 1973, but with a reduced majority.

zh.t: 2021年史蒂文尼奇自治市议会选举
zh.s: 史蒂文尼奇自治市议会选举于2021年5月6日举行，与英国其他地方选举同日进行。议会三分之一席位进行改选，罗巴克选区另举行补选；本次席位上次于2016年改选。工党继续掌控议会，自1973年以来一直如此，但多数席位有所减少。

en.s: The 2021 City of Lincoln Council election took place on 6 May 2021 to elect members of City of Lincoln Council in Lincolnshire, England. This was held on the same day as other local elections. One third of 33 seats were up for election, with one councillor in each of the 11 wards being elected.

zh.s: 2021年林肯市议会选举于5月6日举行，选出英格兰林肯郡林肯市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。议会33席中有三分之一参加改选，即11个选区各选出1名议员。

en.s: The 2021 Stroud District Council election took place on 6 May 2021 to elect members of Stroud District Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 2021年斯特劳区议会选举于5月6日举行，选出英格兰斯特劳区议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。

en.s: The 2021 West Lancashire Borough Council election took place on 6 May 2021 to elect members of West Lancashire Borough Council in Lancashire, England. This election was postponed from May 2020 due to the COVID-19 pandemic.

zh.t: 2021年西兰开夏自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2021年西兰开夏自治市议会选举于5月6日举行，选出英格兰兰开夏郡西兰开夏自治市议会议员。选举因新冠疫情从2020年5月推迟。

en.s: An election to Lancashire County Council took place on 6 May 2021, with counting on 8 May, as part of the 2021 United Kingdom local elections. All 84 councillors are elected from electoral divisions for a four-year term of office. The system of voting used is first-past-the-post. Elections are held in all electoral divisions across the present ceremonial county, excepting Blackpool and Blackburn with Darwen which are unitary authorities.

zh.s: 兰开夏郡议会选举于2021年5月6日举行，计票于5月8日进行，是2021年英国地方选举的一部分。议会全部84名议员从各选区选出，任期四年，采用“先到先得”制。选举覆盖现今礼仪郡内的所有选区，但不包括作为单一层级地方政府的布莱克浦和布莱克本达文。

en.s: The 2021 Wirral Metropolitan Borough Council election took place on 6 May 2021 to elect members of Wirral Metropolitan Borough Council in England. This election was held on the same day as other local elections. The election was originally due to take place in May 2020, but was postponed due to the COVID-19 pandemic. This delay meant those elected (excluding the by-election) would serve only a three-year term.

zh.t: 2021年威勒尔都市自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2021年威勒尔都市自治市议会选举于5月6日举行，选出英格兰威勒尔都市自治市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。选举原定于2020年5月举行，后因新冠疫情推迟。此次延后意味着当选议员（补选当选者除外）的任期只有三年。

en.s: The 2021 Bolton Metropolitan Borough Council election to elect members of Bolton Metropolitan Borough Council took place on 6 May 2021, on the same day as other local elections. 21 seats were contested, including a by election in Astley Bridge Ward, following the death of Cllr Paul Wild. The Conservative Party won 10 seats, the Labour Party won 7 seats, Farnworth and Kearsley First won 2 seats, Horwich and Blackrod First won 1 seat, and the Liberal Democrats won 1 seat.

zh.t: 2021年博尔顿都市自治市议会选举
zh.s: 博尔顿都市自治市议会选举于2021年5月6日举行，选出博尔顿都市自治市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。共有21席参加选举，其中包括因议员保罗·怀尔德去世而在阿斯特利桥选区举行的补选。保守党赢得10席，工党7席，法恩沃思和基尔斯利优先党2席，霍里奇和布莱克罗德优先党1席，自由民主党1席。

en.s: An election for the Scottish Parliament was held on 6 May 2021 under the provisions of the Scotland Act 1998. It was the sixth Scottish Parliament election since the devolved parliament was established in 1999. 129 Members of the Scottish Parliament were elected. The election was held alongside the Senedd election in Wales, English local elections, London Assembly and mayoral election and the Hartlepool by-election.

zh.s: 苏格兰议会选举于2021年5月6日举行，依据《1998年苏格兰法》进行。这是1999年地方自治议会成立以来的第六次苏格兰议会选举，共选出129名苏格兰议会议员。选举与威尔士议会选举、英格兰地方选举、伦敦议会及市长选举和哈特尔浦补选同时举行。

en.s: The 2021 Salford City Council election to elect members of Salford City Council in England took place on 6 May 2021, on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 索尔福德市议会选举于2021年5月6日举行，选出英格兰索尔福德市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。

en.s: The 2021 West Sussex County Council election took place on 6 May 2021 alongside other local elections. All 70 seats to West Sussex County Council were elected. Labour gained 4 seats in the Worthing division, while the Green Party and Local Alliance gained their first ever seats on the council.

zh.s: 西萨塞克斯郡议会选举于2021年5月6日与其他地方选举同时举行。议会全部70席都进行改选。工党在沃辛选区增加4席，绿党和地方联盟则首次在议会赢得席位。

en.t: 2021 Blackburn with Darwen Borough Council election
en.s: The 2021 Blackburn with Darwen Borough Council election took place on 6 May 2021 to elect members of Blackburn with Darwen Borough Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. One-third of the seats were up for election.

zh.t: 2021年布莱克本达文都市自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2021年布莱克本达文都市自治市议会选举于5月6日举行，选出英格兰布莱克本达文都市自治市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。议会三分之一席位参加改选。

en.s: The 2021 Suffolk County Council election took place on 6 May 2021 as part of the 2021 local elections in the United Kingdom. All 75 councillors were elected from 63 electoral divisions, which return either one or two county councillors each, by first-past-the-post voting, for a four-year term of office.

zh.s: 萨福克郡议会选举于2021年5月6日举行，是2021年英国地方选举的一部分。议会全部75名议员从63个选区选出，各选区按“先到先得”制选出1名或2名议员，任期四年。

en.s: The 2021 Basildon Borough Council election took place on 6 May 2021 to elect members of Basildon Borough Council in Essex. This was on the same day as other local elections. The Conservative Party regained control of the council from no overall control.

zh.t: 2021年巴西尔登自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2021年巴西尔登自治市议会选举于5月6日举行，选出埃塞克斯郡巴西尔登自治市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。保守党从原本没有任何政党占据多数的状态中重新取得议会控制权。

en.s: Council elections for the Borough of Chorley were held on 6 May 2021 as part of the 2021 United Kingdom local elections. Due to new boundaries for the district, all wards elected three councillors at this election before returning to its normal cycle of electing a third of councillors each year. The result was a hold for the ruling Labour group.

zh.s: 乔利自治市议会选举于2021年5月6日举行，是2021年英国地方选举的一部分。由于区内选区边界调整，所有选区在本次选举中各选出3名议员，之后再恢复每年改选三分之一议员的常规周期。执政的工党继续掌控议会。

en.s: The 2021 Lincolnshire County Council election was held on 6 May 2021, alongside other local elections.

zh.s: 林肯郡议会选举于2021年5月6日举行，与其他地方选举同时进行。

en.s: The 2021 Oxfordshire County Council election took place on 6 May 2021 alongside the other local elections. All 63 seats of the Oxfordshire County Council were contested. The council is composed of 61 divisions, each electing either one or two councillors, all elected by FPTP. Since the last election in 2017, there had been some changes in seat composition. In April 2018, Cllr.

zh.s: 2021 年牛津郡郡议会选举于 5 月 6 日与其他地方选举同时举行。郡议会的 63 个席位全部改选，共设 61 个选区，各选区选出一名或两名议员，均采用简单多数制。自上次 2017 年选举以来，席位构成有所变化。2018 年 4 月，议员皮特·汉德利因称另一名议员时使用侮辱性称呼而被保守党停职。

en.s: The 2021 Bristol City Council election took place on 6 May 2021 to elect members of Bristol City Council in England. It coincided with nationwide local elections. Voters in the city also voted for the mayor of Bristol, the mayor of the West of England and for Avon and Somerset's police and crime commissioner. The election was originally due to take place in May 2020, but was postponed due to the COVID-19 pandemic.

zh.s: 2021年布里斯托市议会选举于5月6日举行，选出英格兰布里斯托市议会议员，与全国地方选举同日进行。市民也投票选出布里斯托市长、西英格兰市长和雅芳与萨默塞特警察与犯罪专员。选举原定于2020年5月举行，后因新冠疫情推迟。

en.s: The 2021 Wokingham Borough Council election took place on 6 May 2021 to elect members of Wokingham Borough Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections and had been postponed from May 2020, due to the COVID-19 pandemic. The composition of the council before the election was as follows: There was one vacancy.

zh.t: 2021年沃金厄姆自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2021年沃金厄姆自治市议会选举于5月6日举行，选出英格兰沃金厄姆自治市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。选举因新冠疫情从2020年5月推迟。选举前的议会组成如下：有1席空缺。

en.s: Elections to Hertfordshire County Council took place on 6 May 2021 alongside other local elections in the United Kingdom. All 78 seats to the council were elected. The Conservative Party won 46 of the 78 seats, winning a majority and thus retaining control of the council, despite making a net loss of five seats, with leader David Williams losing his seat of Harpenden North East.

zh.s: 赫特福德郡议会选举于2021年5月6日与英国其他地方选举同时举行。议会全部78席都进行改选。保守党赢得78席中的46席，取得多数并继续掌控议会，尽管净失去5席；党领袖戴维·威廉姆斯也失去了他在哈彭登东北选区的席位。

en.s: The 2021 Plymouth City Council election was held on 6 May 2021 to elect members of Plymouth City Council in England. The Labour Party took control of the council after the 2018 election, with thirty-one members and a working majority that they held in the 2019 election. Labour defended eleven seats and the Conservatives defended eight seats.

zh.s: 普利茅斯市议会选举于2021年5月6日举行，选出英格兰普利茅斯市议会议员。工党在2018年选举后掌控议会，拥有31名议员，并在2019年选举中保住可运作的多数。工党守住11个席位，保守党守住8席。

en.s: The 2021 Calderdale Metropolitan Borough Council election took place on 6 May 2021 to elect members of Calderdale Metropolitan Borough Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. One-third of the seats were up for election. The election was originally scheduled for 7 May 2020, alongside the later cancelled 2020 West Yorkshire Police and Crime Commissioner election and other local elections across the UK, but was delayed for a year due to the COVID-19 pandemic.

zh.t: 2021年卡尔德代尔都市自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2021年卡尔德代尔都市自治市议会选举于5月6日举行，选出英格兰卡尔德代尔都市自治市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。议会三分之一席位参加改选。选举原定于2020年5月7日举行，与后来取消的2020年西约克郡警察与犯罪专员选举及英国其他地方选举同时进行，后因新冠疫情推迟一年。

en.s: An election for the Senedd (Welsh Parliament; Welsh: Senedd Cymru) took place on Thursday 6 May 2021 to elect 60 members to the Senedd. It was the sixth devolved general election since the Senedd (formerly the National Assembly for Wales) was established in 1999. The election was held alongside the Scottish Parliament election, English local elections, London Assembly and mayoral election and the Hartlepool by-election.

zh.s: 威尔士议会（威尔士语：Senedd Cymru）选举于2021年5月6日（星期四）举行，选出议会60名议员。这是1999年威尔士议会（原名威尔士国民议会）成立以来第六次自治议会大选。选举与苏格兰议会选举、英格兰地方选举、伦敦议会及市长选举和哈特尔浦补选同时举行。

en.s: The 2021 West Northamptonshire Council election took place on 6 May 2021, alongside nationwide local elections. The election was originally due to take place in May 2020, but was postponed due to the COVID-19 pandemic. A total of 93 councillors were elected, with the 31 wards electing 3 councillors each. The election was held concurrently with the Northamptonshire Police, Fire and Crime Commissioner election.

zh.s: 西北安普敦郡议会选举于2021年5月6日举行，与全国地方选举同时进行。选举原定于2020年5月举行，后因新冠疫情推迟。共选出93名议员，31个选区各选出3人。选举与北安普敦郡警察、消防与犯罪专员选举同日举行。

en.s: The 2021 Warwickshire County Council election was held on 6 May 2021 alongside other local elections across England. All 57 seats on Warwickshire County Council were contested returning one councillor for each division by first-past-the-post voting for a four-year term in office. The electoral divisions were the same as those used at the previous election held in 2017.

zh.s: 沃里克郡议会选举于2021年5月6日举行，与英格兰各地其他地方选举同日进行。议会全部57席都进行改选，各选区按“先到先得”制选出1名议员，任期四年。选区边界与2017年上次选举时相同。

en.s: The 2021 West Midlands mayoral election was held on 6 May 2021 to elect the mayor of the West Midlands, on the same day as other local elections across England and Wales, including councillors in six of its seven boroughs and the police and crime commissioner for the West Midlands city region. This was the second election for the post, which had its first election in 2017 due to the Cities and Local Government Devolution Act 2016.

zh.s: 西米德兰兹市长选举于2021年5月6日举行，选出西米德兰兹市长，与英格兰和威尔士其他地方选举同日进行。选举也在该地区7个自治市中的6个选出议员，并选出西米德兰兹城市区域警察与犯罪专员。这是该职位的第二次选举；首次选举于2017年举行，依据的是《2016年城市与地方政府权力下放法》。

en.s: The 2021 Northampton Town Council election was held on 6 May 2021 to elect councillors to Northampton Town Council. This was the inaugural election for the newly established town council and the first since the abolition of the previous Northampton Borough Council.

zh.s: 北安普敦镇议会选举于2021年5月6日举行，选出北安普敦镇议会的议员。这是新设镇议会的首次选举，也是原北安普敦自治市议会撤销后的首次选举。

en.s: Elections to Rushmoor Borough Council took place on 6 May 2021 as part of the 2021 United Kingdom local elections. This took place at the same time as the elections for Hampshire County Council and the Hampshire Police and Crime Commissioner.

zh.t: 2021年拉什穆尔自治市议会选举
zh.s: 拉什穆尔自治市议会选举于2021年5月6日举行，是2021年英国地方选举的一部分。选举与汉普郡郡议会和汉普郡警察与犯罪专员选举同时举行。

en.s: Elections to Rotherham Metropolitan Borough Council were held on 6 May 2021. Although Labour retained control of the council, the Conservatives went from zero to 20 seats at this election.

zh.t: 2021年罗瑟勒姆都市自治市议会选举
zh.s: 罗瑟勒姆都市自治市议会选举于2021年5月6日举行。工党继续掌控议会，但保守党这次从零席增加到20席。

en.s: The inaugural West Yorkshire mayoral election was held on Thursday 6 May 2021 to elect the Mayor of West Yorkshire. It took place simultaneously on the same day as other local elections across the United Kingdom, including council elections in each of the five metropolitan boroughs of West Yorkshire. It was conducted using the supplementary vote (SV) electoral system.

zh.s: 西约克郡首次市长选举于2021年5月6日（星期四）举行，选出西约克郡市长。选举与英国其他地方选举同日进行，包括西约克郡五个都市自治市的议会选举。市长采用补充投票制选出。

en.s: The 2021 London Assembly election was held on 6 May 2021 to elect the members of the London Assembly, alongside the 2021 London mayoral election. The mayoral and Assembly elections were originally to be held on 7 May 2020, but on 13 March 2020 it was announced the election would be postponed until 2021 due to the COVID-19 pandemic.

zh.s: 伦敦议会选举于2021年5月6日举行，与2021年伦敦市长选举同时进行。市长和议会选举原定于2020年5月7日举行，但2020年3月13日宣布因新冠疫情推迟至2021年。

en.s: The PFL 3 mixed martial arts event for the 2021 season of the Professional Fighters League was held on May 6, 2021. This was the third regular season event of the tournament and included fights in the Heavyweight and women's Lightweight divisions. After the previous two events aired on ESPN2, this was the first event airing on ESPN.

zh.t: 2021年职业格斗联盟第三场赛事
zh.s: 职业格斗联盟2021赛季的第三场综合格斗赛事于2021年5月6日举行。这是该赛事的第三场常规赛，设重量级和女子轻量级比赛。前两场赛事在ESPN2播出，这场比赛首次在ESPN播出。

en.s: The 2021 London mayoral election was held on 6 May 2021 to elect the mayor of London. It was held simultaneously with elections for the London Assembly, other local elections across England and Wales, and devolved elections in Scotland and Wales. The mayoral and Assembly elections were to be held on 7 May 2020, but in March 2020 the government announced the election would be postponed until 2021 due to the COVID-19 pandemic.

zh.s: 伦敦市长选举于2021年5月6日举行，选出伦敦市长。选举与伦敦议会选举、英格兰和威尔士其他地方选举，以及苏格兰和威尔士的自治议会选举同时举行。市长和议会选举原定于2020年5月7日举行，但政府于2020年3月宣布因新冠疫情推迟至2021年。

en.s: The 2021 West of England mayoral election was held on 6 May 2021 to elect the mayor of the West of England, on the same day as other local elections across the country. It was the second election for the role. The mayor was elected by the supplementary vote system. The election was won by Dan Norris of the Labour Party.

zh.s: 西英格兰市长选举于2021年5月6日举行，与全国其他地方选举同日进行。这是该职位的第二次选举。市长采用补充投票制选出。工党候选人丹·诺里斯赢得选举。

en.s: The 2021 Shropshire Council election took place on 6 May 2021 as part of the 2021 United Kingdom local elections. All 74 councillors were elected from 63 electoral divisions which return either one, two or three councillors each by first-past-the-post voting for a four-year term of office.

zh.s: 什罗普郡议会选举于2021年5月6日举行，是2021年英国地方选举的一部分。全部74名议员从63个选区选出，各区按“先到先得”制选出1至3名议员，任期四年。

en.s: Elections to Hart District Council took place on 6 May 2021 as part of the 2021 United Kingdom local elections. This took place at the same time as the elections for Hampshire County Council and the Hampshire Police and Crime Commissioner.

zh.s: 哈特区议会选举于2021年5月6日举行，是2021年英国地方选举的一部分。选举与汉普郡郡议会和汉普郡警察与犯罪专员选举同时举行。

en.s: The 2021 Greater Manchester mayoral election was held on 6 May 2021 to elect the mayor of Greater Manchester. This election, alongside other local and mayoral elections across England and Wales, was originally scheduled to take place on 7 May 2020, but was delayed by the UK Government on 13 March 2020, due to the unfolding COVID-19 pandemic.

zh.s: 大曼彻斯特市长选举于2021年5月6日举行，选出大曼彻斯特市长。这次选举与英格兰和威尔士其他地方选举及市长选举原定于2020年5月7日举行，但英国政府于2020年3月13日因新冠疫情发展而将选举推迟。

en.s: Elections to Portsmouth City Council took place on Thursday 6 May 2021, alongside other local elections across the country. The seats contested in this election were last contested in 2016. The election was originally due to take place on 7 May 2020, but was postponed due to the COVID-19 pandemic. One seat from each ward was up for election.

zh.s: 朴茨茅斯市议会选举于2021年5月6日（星期四）举行，与全国其他地方选举同日进行。本次改选席位上一次于2016年参加选举。选举原定于2020年5月7日举行，后因新冠疫情推迟。每个选区各改选1席。

en.s: Elections to Gosport Borough Council took place on 6 May 2021 as part of the 2021 United Kingdom local elections. These took place at the same time as the elections for Hampshire County Council and the Hampshire Police and Crime Commissioner.

zh.t: 2021年戈斯波特自治市议会选举
zh.s: 戈斯波特自治市议会选举于2021年5月6日举行，是2021年英国地方选举的一部分。选举与汉普郡郡议会和汉普郡警察与犯罪专员选举同时举行。

en.s: The 2021 Eastleigh Borough Council election took place on 6 May 2021 to elect 12 councillors to Eastleigh Borough Council. Every ward apart from the two member wards of West End North and West End South elected one councillor each. This took place at the same time as the elections for Hampshire County Council and the Hampshire Police and Crime Commissioner.

zh.t: 2021年伊斯特利自治市议会选举
zh.s: 伊斯特利自治市议会选举于2021年5月6日举行，选出12名议员。除西区北和西区南两个双议员选区外，其他选区各选出1名议员。选举与汉普郡郡议会和汉普郡警察与犯罪专员选举同时举行。

en.s: The 2021 Surrey County Council election took place on 6 May 2021, alongside other English and Welsh local elections. Councillors were elected for all 81 single-member electoral divisions of Surrey County Council for a four-year term. The electoral system used was first-past-the-post voting. The result was that Conservative councillors formed a significantly decreased majority on the council, losing a net 14 seats.

zh.s: 萨里郡议会选举于2021年5月6日举行，与英格兰和威尔士其他地方选举同日进行。议会全部81个单席选区都进行改选，议员任期四年，采用“先到先得”制。保守党继续以明显减少的多数掌控议会，净失去14席。

en.s: Elections to Fareham Borough Council took place on 6 May 2021, as part of the 2021 United Kingdom local elections. These elections were originally scheduled for 2020 but were suspended for a year due to the COVID-19 pandemic. Following the previous elections, in 2018 the council consisted of 24 Conservatives, 5 Liberal Democrats, 1 Independent member and 1 UKIP member.

zh.s: 费勒姆自治市议会选举于2021年5月6日举行，是2021年英国地方选举的一部分。选举原定于2020年举行，后因新冠疫情推迟一年。上次选举后，即2018年，议会有24名保守党议员、5名自由民主党议员、1名无党籍议员和1名英国独立党议员。

en.s: The 2021 Oxford City Council election took place on 6 May 2021, due to the postponement of local elections due to be held in 2020, and was to elect all 48 members of Oxford City Council. This was on the same day as the other local elections in England. Each of Oxford's 24 wards elect two councillors.

zh.s: 牛津市议会选举于2021年5月6日举行。由于原定于2020年的地方选举推迟，牛津市议会全部48席都进行改选，与英格兰其他地方选举同日进行。牛津24个选区各选出2名议员。

en.s: The 2021 Wakefield Metropolitan Borough Council election took take place during 2021 to elect members of Wakefield Metropolitan District Council in England. The election was held on the same day as other local elections. The election was originally due to take place in May 2020, but was postponed due to the COVID-19 pandemic.

zh.t: 2021年韦克菲尔德都市区议会选举
zh.s: 2021年韦克菲尔德都市区议会选举于2021年举行，选出英格兰韦克菲尔德都市区议会议员。选举与其他地方选举同日进行。选举原定于2020年5月举行，后因新冠疫情推迟。

en.s: The 2021 North Northamptonshire Council election took place alongside nationwide local elections. The election was originally due to take place in May 2020, but was postponed due to the COVID-19 pandemic. It was the inaugural election for the unitary authority, which was created one month before in April 2021, after the merger of the four existing non-metropolitan districts of Corby, East Northamptonshire, Kettering, and Wellingborough.

zh.s: 2021年北安普敦郡议会选举与全国地方选举同时举行。选举原定于2020年5月举行，后因新冠疫情推迟。新成立的单一层级地方政府共选出93名议员，辖下31个选区各选出3人。该议会于2021年4月设立，由科比、东北安普敦郡、凯特林和韦灵伯勒4个原非都市区合并而成。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 2021 Reading Council election took place in 2021 to elect members of Reading Borough Council. This was on the same day as other local elections. The election was originally due to take place in May 2020, but was postponed due to the COVID-19 pandemic. Council elections for the Reading Borough Council were last held on 2 May 2019 as part of the 2019 United Kingdom local elections.

zh.s: 雷丁议会选举于2021年举行，选出雷丁自治市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。选举原定于2020年5月举行，后因新冠疫情推迟。雷丁自治市议会上一次选举于2019年5月2日举行，是2019年英国地方选举的一部分。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 2021 Leicestershire County Council election took place alongside the other local elections. All councilors were elected from electoral divisions by first-past-the-post voting for a four-year term of office.

zh.s: 莱斯特郡议会选举与其他地方选举同时举行。议会全部议员按“先到先得”制从各选区选出，任期四年。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 2021 Derbyshire County Council election took place alongside the other 2021 local elections. All 64 seats to Derbyshire County Council were contested. The Conservatives retained control of the council with an increased majority. In addition, the Green Party gained representation for the first time.

zh.s: 德比郡议会选举与2021年其他地方选举同时举行。议会全部64席都进行改选。保守党继续掌控议会，并扩大多数。绿党也首次在议会赢得席位。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 2021 Devon County Council election took place alongside the other local elections. All 60 councillors to Devon County Council were elected. A total of 256,974 votes were cast including spoiled ballots.

zh.s: 德文郡议会选举与其他地方选举同时举行。议会全部60名议员都进行改选，共有256,974张选票，包括废票。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 2021 elections to Amber Valley Borough Council were held on Wednesday 5th May 2021, 16 seats in the council were up for election. The Conservative Party retook control of the council from The Labour Party after losing control in 2019. These seats were due to have been contested in 2020, but the elections were delayed by a year due to the COVID-19 pandemic along with other elections.

zh.s: 安伯谷区议会选举于2021年5月5日星期三举行，议会16个席位参与改选。保守党从工党手中重新取得议会控制权；保守党曾在2019年失去控制权。这些席位原定于2020年改选，但受新冠疫情影响，选举与其他选举一同推迟了一年。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 2021 Milton Keynes Council election took place May 6 to elect members of Milton Keynes Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. One third of the council was up for election, plus two by-elections following resignations in the Central Milton Keynes and Woughton and Fishermead wards.

zh.s: 米尔顿凯恩斯议会选举于2021年5月6日举行，选出英格兰米尔顿凯恩斯议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。议会三分之一席位参加改选，中央米尔顿凯恩斯及伍顿和费舍尔米德选区另有两席因议员辞职而举行补选。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 2021 Liverpool City Region mayoral election was held in May 2021 to elect the mayor of the Liverpool City Region, alongside other local elections across England and Wales, to elect councillors, the mayor of Liverpool, and police and crime commissioners across the city region. The election was originally due to take place in May 2020, but was postponed due to the COVID-19 pandemic.

zh.t: 2021年利物浦城市区域市长选举
zh.s: 利物浦城市区域市长选举于2021年5月举行，选出利物浦城市区域市长，并与英格兰和威尔士其他地方选举同时举行，当天也选出议员、利物浦市长以及城市区域内的警察与犯罪专员。选举原定于2020年5月举行，后因新冠疫情推迟。

en.s: The 2021 Cambridgeshire and Peterborough mayoral election was held on 6 May 2021 to elect the mayor of Cambridgeshire and Peterborough.

zh.t: 2021年剑桥郡和彼得伯勒市长选举
zh.s: 剑桥郡和彼得伯勒市长选举于2021年5月6日举行，选出剑桥郡和彼得伯勒市长。

en.s: The 2021 Doncaster mayoral election was held on 6 May 2021 to elect the mayor of Doncaster.

zh.s: 唐卡斯特市长选举于2021年5月6日举行，选出唐卡斯特市长。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: A by-thirds Hyndburn Borough Council local election (postponed since March 2020, due to the Coronavirus outbreak), was held on Thursday 6 May 2021. Approximately one third of the local council's 35 seats fell up for election on that day. This election, postponed for 12 months since 2020, took place at the same time as the regularly scheduled 2021 Lancashire County Council elections and the rescheduled Lancashire Police & Crime Commissioner elections.

zh.s: 欣德本自治市议会选举原定于2020年3月举行，后因新冠疫情推迟，于2021年5月6日（星期四）举行。35个地方议会席位中约三分之一参加改选。此次选举与按计划举行的2021年兰开夏郡议会选举及重新安排的兰开夏郡警察与犯罪专员选举同时举行。

en.s: On 6 May 2021, at least 29 people were killed in a shootout between police and drug traffickers in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. The raid occurred in Jacarezinho, Rio de Janeiro, a favela notable for its high crime rate. The raid occurred at approximately 11 a.m. local time, following reports that a local drug gang was recruiting children.

zh.s: 2021年5月6日，巴西里约热内卢警方与毒贩发生枪战，至少29人死亡。突袭行动发生在里约热内卢的雅卡雷济纽贫民区，该地区以犯罪率高而闻名。当地时间上午约11时，警方接到当地毒品帮派招募儿童的报告后展开突袭。

loc: 美国得克萨斯州阿灵顿

en.s: The PFL 3 mixed martial arts event for the 2022 season of the Professional Fighters League was held on May 6, 2022, at the Esports Stadium Arlington in Arlington, Texas. It was the third regular season event of the tournament and included fights in the Women's Lightweight and Welterweight divisions.

zh.t: 2022年职业格斗联盟第三场赛事
zh.s: 职业格斗联盟2022赛季的第三场综合格斗赛事于2022年5月6日在得克萨斯州阿灵顿的电子竞技体育场举行。这是该赛事的第三场常规赛，设女子轻量级和次中量级比赛。

en.s: Between April 24 and May 6, 2022, clashes broke out between the 400 Mawozo gang and the Chen Mechan gang in Plaine du Cul-de-Sac, Port-au-Prince, Haiti. Nearly 200 people were killed, many of whom were civilians.

zh.t: 普兰杜库尔德萨克战役
zh.s: 2022年4月24日至5月6日，400马沃佐帮派与陈梅肯帮派在海地太子港普兰杜库尔德萨克地区爆发冲突。近200人丧生，其中许多是平民。

en.s: Bellator 280: Bader vs. Kongo 2 was a mixed martial arts event produced by Bellator MMA that took place on May 6, 2022, at AccorHotels Arena in Paris, France.

zh.s: Bellator 280：巴德尔对阵孔戈二番战是一场由Bellator MMA主办的综合格斗赛事，于2022年5月6日在法国巴黎雅高体育馆举行。

en.s: On May 6, 2023, a mass shooting occurred at Allen Premium Outlets, an outlet center in Allen, Texas, United States. Nine people, including the perpetrator, were killed during the shooting, the youngest of whom was a three-year-old boy, and seven others were injured. The perpetrator was fatally shot by a police officer already in the area on an unrelated call.

zh.t: 2023年得克萨斯州艾伦市购物中心枪击案
zh.s: 2023年5月6日，美国得克萨斯州艾伦市的艾伦名品折扣中心发生大规模枪击事件，造成9人死亡，其中包括枪手。遇难者中最年幼的是一名3岁男孩，另有7人受伤。一名警员当时因处理另一宗无关警情而在附近，随后开枪击毙了枪手。

en.s: The 2023 Backlash was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) and livestreaming event produced by the American company WWE, held for wrestlers from the promotion's main roster brands, Raw and SmackDown. It was the 18th Backlash and took place on May 6, 2023, at the Coliseo de Puerto Rico José Miguel Agrelot in San Juan, Puerto Rico.

zh.s: 2023年Backlash是一场由美国公司WWE主办的职业摔角按次付费及流媒体赛事，参赛者来自该推广品牌Raw和SmackDown的主力阵容。这是第18届Backlash，于2023年5月6日在波多黎各圣胡安的何塞·米格尔·阿格雷洛体育馆举行。

en.s: The 2023 Plano municipal election was an election to the Plano City Council in the city of Plano, Texas on May 6, 2023. Two seats were contested for Places 3 and 5, while other two seats for Places 1 and 7 ran unopposed.

zh.s: 2023年普莱诺市政选举于2023年5月6日举行，选出美国得克萨斯州普莱诺市议会议员。第3和第5席位举行选举，第1和第7席位则只有一名候选人参选，未经竞争当选。

en.s: The 2023 Dallas mayoral election was held on May 6, 2023, to elect the mayor of Dallas, Texas. Incumbent mayor Eric Johnson ran for re-election to a second term in office. One other candidate qualified, declared write-in candidate Kendal Richardson, whom Johnson defeated with 98.7% of the vote, breaking a record set in 1909 by former Dallas mayor Stephen J.

zh.s: 2023 年 5 月 6 日举行达拉斯市长选举。现任市长埃里克·约翰逊竞选连任第二个任期。另一名候选人是宣布以写入选票方式参选的肯德尔·理查森；约翰逊以 98.7% 的得票率击败对手，打破了 1909 年达拉斯前市长斯蒂芬·J·海伊所创下的纪录，成为达拉斯历史上面对任何竞争对手时得票率最高的市长候选人。

en.s: UFC 288: Sterling vs. Cejudo was a mixed martial arts event produced by the Ultimate Fighting Championship that took place on May 6, 2023, at the Prudential Center in Newark, New Jersey.

zh.s: UFC 288：斯特林对阵塞胡多是一场由终极格斗冠军赛主办的综合格斗赛事，于2023年5月6日在新泽西州纽瓦克的保德信中心举行。

en.t: Coronation of Charles III and Camilla
en.s: The coronation of Charles III and his wife, Camilla, as king and queen of the United Kingdom and the 14 other Commonwealth realms, took place on Saturday, 6 May 2023 at Westminster Abbey. Charles acceded to the throne on 8 September 2022 upon the death of his mother, Elizabeth II. The ceremony was structured around an Anglican service of Holy Communion.

zh.t: 查理三世与卡米拉加冕礼
zh.s: 查理三世与妻子卡米拉于2023年5月6日（星期六）在威斯敏斯特教堂加冕，分别成为英国及其他14个英联邦王国的国王和王后。查理于2022年9月8日母亲伊丽莎白二世去世后继承王位。加冕仪式按英国圣公会圣餐礼的形式举行。

en.s: The 2023 Fort Worth mayoral election was held on May 6, 2023, to elect the mayor of Fort Worth, Texas. The election was officially nonpartisan. Incumbent Republican mayor Mattie Parker won re-election to a second two-year term in office.

zh.s: 2023年沃思堡市长选举于2023年5月6日举行，选出得克萨斯州沃思堡市长。选举正式上为无党派选举。共和党籍现任市长马蒂·帕克竞选连任，并赢得第二个两年任期。

en.s: The 2023 Copa del Rey final was a football match that decided the winner of the 2022–23 Copa del Rey, the 121st edition of Spain's primary football cup (including two seasons where two rival editions were played). The match was played on 6 May 2023 at the Estadio de La Cartuja in Seville between Real Madrid and Osasuna.

zh.s: 2023年西班牙国王杯决赛于2023年5月6日举行，决出2022至2023赛季国王杯冠军。这是该赛事第121届（其中有两个赛季曾同时举办两个彼此竞争的版本）。皇家马德里和奥萨苏纳在塞维利亚卡артуха体育场交锋。

en.s: Periodic elections for the Tasmanian Legislative Council were held on 6 May 2023. Three seats were up for a regularly scheduled vote; Launceston, Murchison and Rumney. All three incumbents were reelected.

zh.t: 2023年塔斯马尼亚立法委员会定期选举
zh.s: 塔斯马尼亚立法委员会定期选举于2023年5月6日举行，按计划改选3席，分别属于朗塞斯顿、默奇森和拉姆尼选区。3名现任议员全部连任。

en.s: The 2023 San Antonio mayoral election was held on May 6, 2023, to elect the mayor of San Antonio, Texas. The election is officially nonpartisan under Texas law. Incumbent mayor Ron Nirenberg ran for re-election to a fourth term in office. Due to term limits, if Nirenberg won, it would be his last term. He was facing minimal opposition and was expected to win re-election.

zh.s: 2023年圣安东尼奥市长选举于2023年5月6日举行，选出得克萨斯州圣安东尼奥市长。根据得州法律，选举正式上为无党派选举。现任市长罗恩·尼伦伯格竞选第四个任期。由于任期限制，如果尼伦伯格胜选，这将是他的最后一个任期。他面对的竞争不强，预计会赢得连任。

en.s: The 2023 Tajik Supercup is the 14th Tajik Supercup, an annual Tajik football match played between the winners of the previous season's Tajikistan Higher League and Tajikistan Cup. The match was contested by 2022 League champions Istiklol, and the 2022 Cup champions Ravshan Kulob.

zh.s: 2023年塔吉克斯坦超级杯是第14届塔吉克斯坦超级杯。这项年度足球赛事由上赛季塔吉克斯坦超级联赛冠军与塔吉克斯坦杯冠军对阵。本届比赛的两支球队是2022年联赛冠军伊斯蒂克洛尔和2022年杯赛冠军拉夫尚库洛布。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Chad on 6 May 2024. The elections followed a constitutional referendum held on 17 December 2023, following the death of President Idriss Déby in 2021. Incumbent transitional president Mahamat Déby, the son of Idriss Déby, ran as the candidate of the Patriotic Salvation Movement, winning the election and leading to another extension of 34 years of rule by the Déby family.

zh.s: 乍得于2024年5月6日举行总统选举。此前，乍得于2021年伊德里斯·代比去世后举行过渡安排，并于2023年12月17日举行宪法公投。过渡总统、伊德里斯·代比之子马哈马特·代比代表爱国拯救运动参选并赢得选举，使代比家族的统治再延长34年。

en.s: The 2024 Scottish National Party leadership election took place to choose the leader of the Scottish National Party (SNP) following the resignation of Humza Yousaf on 29 April 2024, amid a government crisis. Nominations closed on 6 May, with John Swinney emerging as the only candidate and was subsequently elected unopposed as the party's new leader.

zh.s: 2024年苏格兰民族党党魁选举是在汉姆扎·优素福于2024年4月29日辞职、政府陷入危机后举行的党魁选举。提名于5月6日截止，约翰·斯温尼成为唯一候选人，随后未经竞争当选新任党魁。

en.s: Local elections were held in Sri Lanka on 6 May 2025 According to the Election Commission of Sri Lanka, of the 17,296,330 registered voters nationwide, 17,156,338 were eligible to vote in this election. Voters elected 8,793 members for a four-year term to 339 of the 341 local authorities in the country, comprising 28 municipal councils, 36 urban councils, and 275 pradeshiya sabhas.

zh.s: 斯里兰卡地方选举于2025年5月6日举行。根据斯里兰卡选举委员会的数据，全国登记选民为17,296,330人，其中17,156,338人具备本次选举的投票资格。选民选出8,793名议员，任期四年，分别进入全国341个地方政府中的339个，包括28个市政议会、36个城市议会和275个地方议会。
